```ts
import {isGeoRefusal} from '../../../../core/geo/fetch';
import {RequestUnreachable, RpcHttpError, RpcMalformed, RpcResponseError, SYSTEM_PROGRAM_ID, type SimulatedAccount, type SimulationOutcome, type TokenAccountEntry} from '../../../../core/solana/rpc';
import type {Prices} from '../../../../core/portfolio/value';

/**
 * B1d §3.3, §3.4 (approach A): a presale purchase as an intent of B1b's send pipeline — kind `presale-buy`. This module
 * owns the kind: its intent and digest, #10's description of its challenge, and the prepare — build with core/presale,
 * simulate, check the simulation exactly, decide re-authentication, store the prepared entry. Signing is the shared
 * pipeline's (send.ts), reached only through presale.buy (D17).
 */
export const PRESALE_BUY_KIND = 'presale-buy';

/** §1.4: what the user asked for — the currency, the amount in its base units (decimal string) and the stage they saw (C27). */
export interface PurchaseIntent {
  currency: PresaleCurrency;
  amount: string;
  stage: number;
}

/** §5: the refusals of a purchase (presale/ only — the shared SendRefusal is unchanged). */
export type PurchaseRefusal =
  | 'locked'
  | 'unknown-account'
  | 'in-flight'
  | 'presale-unavailable'
  | 'coordinator-refused'
  | 'presale-closed'
  | 'blocked'
  | 'geo-closed'
  | 'price-changed'
  | 'state-changed'
  | LimitCode
  | 'above-limit'
  | BalanceCode
  | 'no-sol-price'
  | 'simulation-failed'
  | 'simulation-mismatch'
  | 'presale-busy';

export class PurchaseRefused extends Error {
  readonly code: PurchaseRefusal;
  readonly detail: string;
  constructor(code: PurchaseRefusal, detail = '') {
    super(detail === '' ? code : `${code}: ${detail}`);
    this.name = 'PurchaseRefused';
    this.code = code;
    this.detail = detail;
  }
}

const AMOUNT = /^[1-9]\d{0,19}$/;
const MAX_U64 = 2n ** 64n - 1n;
const INTENT_KEYS = ['currency', 'amount', 'stage'];

/** Untrusted or stored input → the intent rebuilt key by key, or null: exactly three keys, a known currency, a positive u64, a stage 0–9. */
export function parsePurchaseIntent(x: unknown): PurchaseIntent | null {
  if (typeof x !== 'object' || x === null || Array.isArray(x)) return null;
  const o = x as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (Object.keys(o).length !== INTENT_KEYS.length || !INTENT_KEYS.every(k => Object.hasOwn(o, k))) return null;
  const {currency, amount, stage} = o;
  if (typeof currency !== 'string' || !(PRESALE_CURRENCIES as readonly string[]).includes(currency)) return null;
  if (typeof amount !== 'string' || !AMOUNT.test(amount) || BigInt(amount) > MAX_U64) return null;
  if (typeof stage !== 'number' || !Number.isInteger(stage) || stage < 0 || stage >= STAGE_PRICE_TICKS.length) return null;
  return {currency: currency as PresaleCurrency, amount, stage};
}

/** §3.3 step 6: a purchase's re-authentication is bound to who buys what at which stage (B1d-2 adds the referrer). */
function purchaseDigestValue(account: string, intent: PurchaseIntent): {account: string; currency: string; amount: string; stage: number} {
  return {account, currency: intent.currency, amount: intent.amount, stage: intent.stage};
}

/** §3.4 (D3): B1b's 5 % and dollar rules plus the first purchase; B1b's first-send and whole-balance-to-new do not apply (C5). */
export type PresaleReauthReason = 'first-purchase' | 'over-5-percent' | 'over-usd-threshold';
const REASONS: readonly PresaleReauthReason[] = ['first-purchase', 'over-5-percent', 'over-usd-threshold'];

/** C36: the larger of two valuations in micro-dollars; unknown only when both are. */
export function largerValue(a: bigint | null, b: bigint | null): bigint | null {
  if (a === null) return b;
  if (b === null) return a;
  return a > b ? a : b;
}

/**
 * Which re-authentication triggers a purchase meets. Fail closed as B1b: a zero balance is above 5 %, an unknown value
 * above the threshold. `balance` is the paying token's total held; `usdMicros` the larger valuation (largerValue).
 */
export function presaleReauthReasons(i: {firstPurchase: boolean; amount: bigint; balance: bigint; usdMicros: bigint | null; thresholdCents: number}): PresaleReauthReason[] {
  if (i.amount < 0n) throw new RangeError('presaleReauthReasons: negative amount');
  const out: PresaleReauthReason[] = [];
  if (i.firstPurchase) out.push('first-purchase');
  if (i.balance <= 0n || i.amount * 100n > i.balance * REAUTH_PERCENT) out.push('over-5-percent');
  if (i.usdMicros === null || i.usdMicros > BigInt(i.thresholdCents) * 10_000n) out.push('over-usd-threshold');
  return out;
}

/**
 * §1.3 `describe` (E3's rule for a send, kept): what #10 shows for a purchase challenge, written by the prepare that binds
 * the digest, from the same values. Amounts are base-unit decimal strings; `stage` is the program's 0-indexed stage.
 */
export interface PurchaseAbout {
  kind: typeof PRESALE_BUY_KIND;
  account: string;
  currency: PresaleCurrency;
  amount: string;
  stage: number;
  priceTicks: string;
  /** The simulated NOC (Δtotal_tokens) and cents (Δtotal_spent_cents). */
  nocBase: string;
  spentCents: string;
  /** The pinned treasury (SOL) or the pinned vault ATA (a stablecoin) the payment lands on. */
  destination: string;
  networkLamports: string;
  priorityLamports: string;
  rentLamports: string;
  reasons: PresaleReauthReason[];
  thresholdCents: number;
}
const ABOUT_KEYS = ['kind', 'account', 'currency', 'amount', 'stage', 'priceTicks', 'nocBase', 'spentCents', 'destination', 'networkLamports', 'priorityLamports', 'rentLamports', 'reasons', 'thresholdCents'];
const DIGITS = /^\d{1,20}$/;
const ADDRESS = /^[1-9A-HJ-NP-Za-km-z]{32,44}$/;

/** The exact shape this module issues: a stored description with any other shape is dropped by the challenge store. */
export function isPurchaseAbout(x: KindAbout): boolean {
  const a = x as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (Object.keys(a).length !== ABOUT_KEYS.length || !ABOUT_KEYS.every(k => Object.hasOwn(a, k))) return false;
  if (a.kind !== PRESALE_BUY_KIND || parsePurchaseIntent({currency: a.currency, amount: a.amount, stage: a.stage}) === null) return false;
  if (typeof a.account !== 'string' || !ADDRESS.test(a.account) || typeof a.destination !== 'string' || !ADDRESS.test(a.destination)) return false;
  const numbers = [a.priceTicks, a.nocBase, a.spentCents, a.networkLamports, a.priorityLamports, a.rentLamports];
  if (!numbers.every(v => typeof v === 'string' && DIGITS.test(v))) return false;
  // The priority is a part of the network fee, never more.
  if (BigInt(a.priorityLamports as string) > BigInt(a.networkLamports as string)) return false;
  const reasons = a.reasons;
  if (!Array.isArray(reasons) || reasons.length === 0 || new Set(reasons).size !== reasons.length) return false;
  if (!(reasons as unknown[]).every(r => typeof r === 'string' && (REASONS as readonly string[]).includes(r))) return false;
  return typeof a.thresholdCents === 'number' && Number.isSafeInteger(a.thresholdCents);
}

/** A re-prepare of the same purchase: the identity fields from the stored description, everything recomputed from `fresh`. */
function rebasePurchaseAbout(stored: KindAbout, fresh: KindAbout): KindAbout | null {
  if (!isPurchaseAbout(stored) || !isPurchaseAbout(fresh)) return null;
  const s = stored as unknown as PurchaseAbout;
  const f = fresh as unknown as PurchaseAbout;
  if (s.account !== f.account || s.currency !== f.currency || s.amount !== f.amount || s.stage !== f.stage || s.destination !== f.destination) return null;
  const about: PurchaseAbout = {
    kind: PRESALE_BUY_KIND,
    account: s.account,
    currency: s.currency,
    amount: s.amount,
    stage: s.stage,
    priceTicks: f.priceTicks,
    nocBase: f.nocBase,
    spentCents: f.spentCents,
    destination: s.destination,
    networkLamports: f.networkLamports,
    priorityLamports: f.priorityLamports,
    rentLamports: f.rentLamports,
    reasons: f.reasons,
    thresholdCents: f.thresholdCents,
  };
  return about as unknown as KindAbout;
}

/**
 * B1d §1.3 (C19, D17): the purchase kind, registered when this module loads — only the presale entry module imports it,
 * so the build without presale has no such kind. Its `beforeSign` refuses every entry until the sign-time checks of
 * §3.3 (C12's geo check, C22's state re-read) are part of it: no purchase can be signed from what this module prepares.
 */
export const PRESALE_BUY_INTENT: IntentKind<PurchaseIntent> = {
  kind: PRESALE_BUY_KIND,
  parseIntent: parsePurchaseIntent,
  digestValue: purchaseDigestValue,
  beforeSign: async () => {
    throw new SendRefused('prepared-invalid', 'a purchase is signed only with its sign-time checks');
  },
  isAbout: isPurchaseAbout,
  rebaseAbout: rebasePurchaseAbout,
};
registerIntentKind(PRESALE_BUY_INTENT);

/** The gate never throws (deps.ts); if it ever did, that is no check — closed. */
export async function gateAnswer(deps: WalletDeps): Promise<GeoAnswer> {
  try {
    const g = await deps.geo();
    return {open: g.open, reason: g.reason, countryCode: g.countryCode};
  } catch {
    return {open: false, reason: 'no_check', countryCode: null};
  }
}

/** A failed network read: a 403 (or the latch's cool-down) is the coordinator refusing; any other RPC failure, unavailable. */
function readFailure(e: unknown): PurchaseRefused | null {
  if (isGeoRefusal(e)) return new PurchaseRefused('coordinator-refused');
  if (e instanceof RequestUnreachable || e instanceof RpcHttpError || e instanceof RpcResponseError || e instanceof RpcMalformed) return new PurchaseRefused('presale-unavailable', e.message);
  return null;
}
async function read<T>(p: Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  try {
    return await p;
  } catch (e) {
    throw readFailure(e) ?? e;
  }
}

/** /wallet/prices for the re-authentication's valuation and the SOL limit, or null (C8: never an invented price). A 403 is never swallowed. */
async function pricesOrNull(deps: WalletDeps): Promise<Prices | null> {
  try {
    return await deps.prices();
  } catch (e) {
    if (isGeoRefusal(e)) throw new PurchaseRefused('coordinator-refused');
    return null;
  }
}
const usable = (p: number | undefined): number | null => (typeof p === 'number' && Number.isFinite(p) && p > 0 ? p : null);
const priceOf = (prices: Prices | null, currency: PresaleCurrency): number | null =>
  prices === null ? null : usable(currency === 'SOL' ? prices.solana : currency === 'USDC' ? prices.usdc : prices.usdt);

/** A state read as a purchase needs it: open, at the stage the user saw — else the refusal its answer means (§5). */
function openSnapshot(state: PresaleState, intent: PurchaseIntent): PresaleSnapshot {
  if (state.kind === 'unavailable') throw new PurchaseRefused(state.code === 'refused' ? 'coordinator-refused' : 'presale-unavailable', state.code);
  if (state.kind !== 'open') throw new PurchaseRefused(state.kind === 'blocked' ? 'blocked' : 'presale-closed');
  if (state.snapshot.stage.stage !== intent.stage) throw new PurchaseRefused('price-changed', `stage ${state.snapshot.stage.stage}, the intent's ${intent.stage}`);
  return state.snapshot;
}

const MINTS: Record<'USDC' | 'USDT', string> = {USDC: MAINNET_USDC_MINT, USDT: MAINNET_USDT_MINT};
const PURCHASE_DISCRIMINATORS: Record<PresaleCurrency, readonly number[]> = {
  SOL: [161, 153, 65, 238, 160, 236, 43, 165],
  USDC: [150, 34, 181, 239, 229, 123, 187, 128],
  USDT: [209, 3, 170, 172, 219, 182, 149, 89],
};

/** What the purchase instruction must name, in the IDL's order (§3.3, C37) — the destination the state pinned, never one derived here. */
export function expectedPurchaseAccounts(i: {account: string; currency: PresaleCurrency; referrerAllocation: string; destination: string; source: string | null}): string[] {
  const pdas = derivePresalePdas(new PublicKey(i.account));
  const head = [pdas.config.toBase58(), pdas.userAccount.toBase58(), pdas.userAllocation.toBase58(), i.referrerAllocation];
  if (i.currency === 'SOL') return [...head, PYTH_SOL_USD_ACCOUNT, i.account, i.destination, SYSTEM_PROGRAM_ID];
  if (i.source === null) throw new Error('a stablecoin purchase without its paying account');
  return [...head, i.source, i.destination, MINTS[i.currency], i.account, SPL_TOKEN_PROGRAM, SYSTEM_PROGRAM_ID];
}

/**
 * The compiled message is exactly the purchase this module meant: one signer (the account, the payer), the two
 * compute-budget instructions, then the purchase — its discriminator, its amount and its accounts as
 * expectedPurchaseAccounts names them. Anything else is an engine bug: thrown, never shown or simulated.
 */
export function assertPurchaseMessage(message: MessageV0, i: Parameters<typeof expectedPurchaseAccounts>[0] & {amount: bigint}): number {
  const keys = message.staticAccountKeys.map(k => k.toBase58());
  if (keys[0] !== i.account || message.header.numRequiredSignatures !== 1 || message.addressTableLookups.length !== 0) throw new Error('the purchase message is not signed by the account alone');
  const ixs = message.compiledInstructions;
  const programs = ixs.map(ix => keys[ix.programIdIndex]);
  if (ixs.length !== 3 || programs[0] !== COMPUTE_BUDGET_PROGRAM || programs[1] !== COMPUTE_BUDGET_PROGRAM || programs[2] !== MAINNET_PROGRAM_ID) {
    throw new Error(`the purchase message has unexpected instructions: ${programs.join(', ')}`);
  }
  const purchase = ixs[2] as (typeof ixs)[number];
  const named = purchase.accountKeyIndexes.map(k => keys[k]);
  const expected = expectedPurchaseAccounts(i);
  if (named.length !== expected.length || named.some((k, n) => k !== expected[n])) throw new Error(`the purchase names ${named.join(', ')}; expected ${expected.join(', ')}`);
  const data = [...PURCHASE_DISCRIMINATORS[i.currency], ...encodeU64LE(i.amount)];
  if (purchase.data.length !== data.length || purchase.data.some((b, n) => b !== data[n])) throw new Error('the purchase instruction data is not this purchase');
  return 2;
}

/** §3.3 step 5 (C23): the program's own refusal of the purchase instruction → its code. */
function programRefusal(err: unknown, purchaseIndex: number): PurchaseRefusal | null {
  if (typeof err !== 'object' || err === null || Array.isArray(err)) return null;
  const ie = (err as Record<string, unknown>).InstructionError;
  if (!Array.isArray(ie) || ie.length !== 2 || ie[0] !== purchaseIndex) return null;
  const custom = typeof ie[1] === 'object' && ie[1] !== null ? (ie[1] as Record<string, unknown>).Custom : undefined;
  if (custom === 6022) return 'below-min';
  if (custom === 6023) return 'above-limit';
  if (custom === 6002) return 'blocked';
  if (custom === 6020 || custom === 6021 || custom === 6024) return 'presale-closed';
  return null;
}

/** Bytes of a layout's account: the program's, exactly its length, its discriminator. */
function isLayout(a: SimulatedAccount | null, layout: {readonly length: number; readonly discriminator: readonly number[]}): a is SimulatedAccount {
  return a !== null && a.owner === MAINNET_PROGRAM_ID && a.data.length === layout.length && layout.discriminator.every((b, i) => a.data[i] === b);
}

/** An initialized SPL Token account's mint, owner and amount, or null. */
function tokenOf(a: SimulatedAccount | null): {mint: string; owner: string; amount: bigint} | null {
  if (a === null) return null;
  const info = tokenAccountInfo(a.data, a.owner);
  return info === null || info.program !== 'token' || info.state !== 'initialized' ? null : {mint: info.mint, owner: info.owner, amount: info.amount};
}

const A = PRESALE_ALLOCATION_LAYOUT.fields;
const u32At = (d: Uint8Array, offset: number): number => ((d[offset] as number) | ((d[offset + 1] as number) << 8) | ((d[offset + 2] as number) << 16)) + (d[offset + 3] as number) * 2 ** 24;

/** What prepare simulated against: the snapshot and the reads beside it. */
interface Basis {
  account: string;
  currency: PresaleCurrency;
  amount: bigint;
  snapshot: PresaleSnapshot;
  solBefore: bigint;
  source: {address: string; before: bigint} | null;
  destination: string;
  networkLamports: bigint;
  purchaseIndex: number;
  keys: readonly string[];
}

/** The simulation's verdict: every check passed (with what it measured), a refusal, or only the destination's Δ differs. */
type Verdict = {kind: 'ok'; rent: bigint; nocBase: bigint; spentCents: bigint} | {kind: 'refuse'; code: PurchaseRefusal; detail: string} | {kind: 'destination'; detail: string};
const refuse = (code: PurchaseRefusal, detail: string): Verdict => ({kind: 'refuse', code, detail});

/** The simulation's accounts, in this order (§3.3 step 5): payer, allocation, destination, the paying token account, the user account when absent. */
function simulationAccounts(b: Pick<Basis, 'account' | 'snapshot' | 'destination' | 'source'>): string[] {
  const pdas = derivePresalePdas(new PublicKey(b.account));
  return [b.account, pdas.userAllocation.toBase58(), b.destination, ...(b.source === null ? [] : [b.source.address]), ...(b.snapshot.userAccountExists ? [] : [pdas.userAccount.toBase58()])];
}

/** A created PDA's post-state: the program's, its layout, rent > 0 and ≤ its §2.1 upper bound — its lamports, or null. */
function createdRent(a: SimulatedAccount | null, layout: {readonly length: number; readonly discriminator: readonly number[]}, bound: bigint): bigint | null {
  return isLayout(a, layout) && a.lamports > 0n && a.lamports <= bound ? a.lamports : null;
}

/** §3.3 step 5: every check, on one simulation, against one snapshot. */
function judge(sim: SimulationOutcome, b: Basis): Verdict {
  if (sim.err !== null) {
    const program = programRefusal(sim.err, b.purchaseIndex);
    if (program !== null) return refuse(program, JSON.stringify(sim.err));
    if (rentRefusal(sim.err, b.keys, b.account, b.destination, false) === 'sender-below-rent') return refuse('sender-below-rent', JSON.stringify(sim.err));
    return refuse('simulation-failed', JSON.stringify(sim.err));
  }
  const wanted = simulationAccounts(b).length;
  const accounts = sim.accounts;
  if (accounts === null || accounts.length !== wanted) return refuse('simulation-mismatch', 'the simulation does not show the purchase accounts');
  const [payer, allocation, destination] = accounts as (SimulatedAccount | null)[];
  const sourceAfter = b.source === null ? null : (accounts[3] ?? null);
  const userAfter = b.snapshot.userAccountExists ? null : (accounts[wanted - 1] ?? null);
  const s = b.snapshot;

  // The rent of each PDA this purchase creates, from the simulation (§2.1 rent ruling) — within its bound, never 0.
  let rent = 0n;
  if (!s.allocation.exists) {
    const r = createdRent(allocation ?? null, PRESALE_ALLOCATION_LAYOUT, PRESALE_ALLOCATION_RENT_LAMPORTS);
    if (r === null) return refuse('simulation-mismatch', 'the new allocation is not a PresaleAllocation with its rent within the bound');
    rent += r;
  }
  if (!s.userAccountExists) {
    const r = createdRent(userAfter, USER_ACCOUNT_LAYOUT, PRESALE_USER_ACCOUNT_RENT_LAMPORTS);
    if (r === null) return refuse('simulation-mismatch', 'the new user account is not a UserAccount with its rent within the bound');
    rent += r;
  }

  // SOL out: the amount (SOL), the created PDAs' rent and the network fee — or that without the fee (B1b's two readings).
  if (payer === null || payer === undefined) return refuse('simulation-mismatch', 'the simulation does not show the paying account');
  const spent = b.solBefore - payer.lamports;
  const expected = (b.currency === 'SOL' ? b.amount : 0n) + rent + b.networkLamports;
  if (spent !== expected && spent !== expected - b.networkLamports) return refuse('simulation-mismatch', `the account pays ${spent} lamports; this purchase costs ${expected}`);

  // The paying token account loses exactly the amount and stays the account's.
  if (b.source !== null) {
    const t = tokenOf(sourceAfter);
    if (t === null || t.mint !== MINTS[b.currency as 'USDC' | 'USDT'] || t.owner !== b.account || b.source.before - t.amount !== b.amount) {
      return refuse('simulation-mismatch', `the paying account does not lose exactly ${b.amount}`);
    }
  }

  // The allocation: this account's PresaleAllocation, one more purchase, the cents and the NOC the program computes.
  if (!isLayout(allocation ?? null, PRESALE_ALLOCATION_LAYOUT)) return refuse('simulation-mismatch', 'the allocation after is not a PresaleAllocation');
  const d = (allocation as SimulatedAccount).data;
  const claimed = d[A.claimed.offset];
  if (new PublicKey(d.subarray(A.user.offset, A.user.offset + 32)).toBase58() !== b.account || (claimed !== 0 && claimed !== 1)) {
    return refuse('simulation-mismatch', 'the allocation after is not this account’s');
  }
  const count = u32At(d, A.purchase_count.offset) - s.allocation.purchaseCount;
  const spentCents = readU64LE(d, A.total_spent_cents.offset) - s.allocation.spentCents;
  const nocBase = readU64LE(d, A.total_tokens.offset) - s.allocation.totalBase;
  if (count !== 1) return refuse('simulation-mismatch', `the allocation records ${count} purchases`);
  if (b.currency !== 'SOL' && spentCents !== usdCentsForStable(b.amount)) return refuse('simulation-mismatch', `the allocation records ${spentCents} cents for ${b.amount}`);
  // The program's own limits on its own valuation — and with them Δc > 0 (the minimum is never 0, limits.ts).
  const limit = checkLimits({cents: spentCents, ...s.limits});
  if (limit !== null) return refuse('simulation-mismatch', `the simulated purchase is ${limit}`);
  if (nocBase !== tokensFor(spentCents, s.stage.stage)) {
    // Review L3: NOC at another stage's price is the stage moving between the read and the simulation.
    const other = STAGE_PRICE_TICKS.findIndex((_, stage) => stage !== s.stage.stage && nocBase === tokensFor(spentCents, stage));
    if (other !== -1) return refuse('price-changed', `the simulation priced at stage ${other}`);
    return refuse('simulation-mismatch', `the allocation gains ${nocBase} NOC base units for ${spentCents} cents`);
  }

  // C28: the payment lands on the pinned destination, exactly.
  if (destination === null || destination === undefined) return refuse('simulation-mismatch', 'the simulation does not show the destination');
  if (b.currency === 'SOL') {
    if (destination.owner !== SYSTEM_PROGRAM_ID || destination.data.length !== 0) return refuse('simulation-mismatch', 'the treasury after is not a system account');
    const gained = destination.lamports - s.treasuryLamports;
    if (gained !== b.amount) return {kind: 'destination', detail: `the treasury gains ${gained} lamports, not ${b.amount}`};
  } else {
    const t = tokenOf(destination);
    if (t === null || t.mint !== MINTS[b.currency] || t.owner !== MAINNET_SOL_TREASURY) return refuse('simulation-mismatch', 'the vault after is not the treasury’s token account of this mint');
    const gained = t.amount - s.vaults[b.currency].amount;
    if (gained !== b.amount) return {kind: 'destination', detail: `the vault gains ${gained}, not ${b.amount}`};
  }
  return {kind: 'ok', rent, nocBase, spentCents};
}

/** The reads a quote line needs, from this prepare's own reads (§3.2's rule, the same as presale.quote's). */
function balancesOf(solBefore: bigint, currency: PresaleCurrency, own: readonly TokenAccountEntry[]): PresaleBalances {
  const empty = {largest: 0n, total: 0n};
  const held = {largest: 0n, total: 0n};
  for (const h of own) {
    held.total += h.amount;
    if (h.amount > held.largest) held.largest = h.amount;
  }
  return {SOL: solBefore, USDC: currency === 'USDC' ? held : empty, USDT: currency === 'USDT' ? held : empty};
}

/** §3.3 step 7. Every amount a base-unit decimal string. */
export interface PurchaseView {
  id: string;
  currency: PresaleCurrency;
  amount: string;
  stage: number;
  priceTicks: string;
  nocBase: string;
  spentCents: string;
  destination: string;
  /** The on-chain referrer the purchase credits; `registers` is B1d-2's (always false here). */
  referrer: {address: string; registers: boolean} | null;
  fees: {networkLamports: string; priorityLamports: string; rentLamports: string};
  reauth: {challengeId: string; reasons: PresaleReauthReason[]; proven: boolean} | null;
  validUntil: number;
  simulation: {slot: number; elapsedMs: number; programs: ['compute-budget', 'presale']; instructionCount: number};
}

/** A prepared purchase: B1b's entry of kind `presale-buy`; `shown` keeps the view and the facts the sign-time re-read compares (C22). */
export interface PreparedPurchase extends PreparedEntry {
  kind: typeof PRESALE_BUY_KIND;
  intent: PurchaseIntent;
  shown: {
    fees: {networkLamports: string; markupLamports: '0'};
    simulation: PurchaseView['simulation'];
    view: Omit<PurchaseView, 'id' | 'reauth' | 'validUntil' | 'simulation'> & {reasons: PresaleReauthReason[]};
    basis: {allocationExists: boolean; purchaseCount: number; referrer: string | null; userAccountExists: boolean};
  };
}

/**
 * presale.prepareBuy (§3.3 steps 1–7): the session, the account and C10; a fresh state read and gate answer; the stage
 * the user saw; the limits and balances (§3.2's lines); the build; the simulation with every check and the one retry
 * (C39); re-authentication (§3.4); the prepared entry. Nothing is signed. `opts.challengeId`: a live challenge of the
 * same intent is renewed instead of issuing a new one (as prepareSend).
 */
export async function preparePurchase(ext: Ext, deps: WalletDeps, account: string, intent: PurchaseIntent, opts: {challengeId?: string} = {}): Promise<PurchaseView> {
  // 1. The session, the account, and one in-flight transaction per account — a send or a purchase (C10).
  const session = await getSession(ext);
  if (session === null) throw new PurchaseRefused('locked');
  if (!session.some(a => a.publicKey === account)) throw new PurchaseRefused('unknown-account');
  if (inFlightFor(await readPending(ext), account) !== undefined) throw new PurchaseRefused('in-flight');

  // 2. A fresh snapshot and a fresh gate answer; the gate closed decides first, as the view.
  const [first, geo] = await Promise.all([readPresaleStateAt(deps.reader, account, deps.now()), gateAnswer(deps)]);
  if (!geo.open) throw new PurchaseRefused('geo-closed', geo.reason ?? '');
  let snapshot = openSnapshot(first.state, intent);
  let snapshotSlot = first.slot;

  // 3. Limits and balances: the quote's lines with this prepare's own reads. A stablecoin pays from the account that
  // holds it (C2): the largest holding of that mint owned by the account.
  const amount = BigInt(intent.amount);
  const currency = intent.currency;
  const mint = currency === 'SOL' ? null : MINTS[currency];
  const [solBefore, holdings, prices] = await Promise.all([
    read(deps.reader.getBalance(account)),
    mint === null ? Promise.resolve<TokenAccountEntry[]>([]) : read(deps.reader.getTokenAccountsByOwner(account, {mint})),
    pricesOrNull(deps),
  ]);
  const own = holdings.filter(h => h.mint === mint && h.owner === account);
  const balances = balancesOf(solBefore, currency, own);
  const line = (s: PresaleSnapshot) => quote({snapshot: s, balances, solUsd: priceOf(prices, 'SOL')}, currency, amount).line;
  const limitLine = line(snapshot);
  if (limitLine !== null) throw new PurchaseRefused(limitLine);
  const sourceAddress = mint === null ? null : selectSourceTokenAccount(own, amount);
  if (mint !== null && sourceAddress === null) throw new PurchaseRefused('insufficient-token');
  const source = sourceAddress === null ? null : {address: sourceAddress, before: own.find(h => h.pubkey === sourceAddress)?.amount ?? 0n};

  // 4. Build at the normal tier (its fee within PRESALE_FEE_BOUND_LAMPORTS, which the quote assumed). The destination is
  // the one the state pinned; the referrer allocation is the snapshot's (the state accepted this account).
  const destination = currency === 'SOL' ? MAINNET_SOL_TREASURY : snapshot.vaults[currency].address;
  const resolved = await referrerAllocationOf(snapshot, account);
  if (resolved.registerReferrer !== null) throw new Error('B1d-1b registers no referrer');
  const [price, latest] = await Promise.all([read(estimatePriorityFee(deps.reader, 'normal')), read(deps.reader.getLatestBlockhash())]);
  const user = new PublicKey(account);
  const treasury = new PublicKey(MAINNET_SOL_TREASURY);
  const instructions =
    currency === 'SOL'
      ? buildBuyInstructions(user, amount, price, resolved, treasury)
      : buildStablecoinBuyInstructions(user, currency, amount, price, resolved, treasury, new PublicKey((source as {address: string}).address));
  const message = new TransactionMessage({payerKey: user, recentBlockhash: latest.blockhash, instructions}).compileToV0Message();
  const referrerAllocation = resolved.referrerAllocation.toBase58();
  const purchaseIndex = assertPurchaseMessage(message, {account, currency, referrerAllocation, destination, source: source?.address ?? null, amount});
  const networkLamports = networkFeeLamports(message.header.numRequiredSignatures, price, COMPUTE_UNIT_LIMIT);
  const priorityLamports = priorityFeeLamports(price, COMPUTE_UNIT_LIMIT);
  if (networkLamports > PRESALE_FEE_BOUND_LAMPORTS) throw new Error(`the purchase's network fee ${networkLamports} exceeds its bound`);

  // 5. Simulate the bytes, check everything; one retry, the same bytes, for a destination-only mismatch (C39).
  const wire = base64.encode(new VersionedTransaction(message).serialize());
  const keys = message.staticAccountKeys.map(k => k.toBase58());
  const basisOf = (s: PresaleSnapshot): Basis => ({account, currency, amount, snapshot: s, solBefore, source, destination, networkLamports, purchaseIndex, keys});
  const simulate = async (s: PresaleSnapshot) => {
    const started = deps.now();
    const sim = await read(deps.reader.simulateTransaction(wire, {accounts: simulationAccounts(basisOf(s))}));
    return {sim, elapsedMs: Math.max(0, deps.now() - started)};
  };
  let run = await simulate(snapshot);
  let verdict = judge(run.sim, basisOf(snapshot));
  if (verdict.kind === 'destination') {
    // A simulation older than the snapshot is a stale answer, not a race (review 2 L1).
    if (snapshotSlot === null || run.sim.slot < snapshotSlot) throw new PurchaseRefused('simulation-mismatch', `${verdict.detail}; simulated at slot ${run.sim.slot}, read at ${snapshotSlot}`);
    const again = await readPresaleStateAt(deps.reader, account, deps.now());
    const fresh = openSnapshot(again.state, intent);
    // The fresh snapshot replaces the first for everything; what the bytes were built from must not have moved.
    if (fresh.userAccountExists !== snapshot.userAccountExists || fresh.allocation.exists !== snapshot.allocation.exists) throw new PurchaseRefused('state-changed', 'the accounts this purchase creates changed');
    if ((await referrerAllocationOf(fresh, account)).referrerAllocation.toBase58() !== referrerAllocation) throw new PurchaseRefused('state-changed', 'the referrer changed');
    const freshLine = line(fresh);
    if (freshLine !== null) throw new PurchaseRefused(freshLine);
    snapshot = fresh;
    snapshotSlot = again.slot;
    run = await simulate(snapshot);
    verdict = judge(run.sim, basisOf(snapshot));
    if (verdict.kind === 'destination') throw new PurchaseRefused('presale-busy', verdict.detail);
  }
  if (verdict.kind === 'refuse') throw new PurchaseRefused(verdict.code, verdict.detail);
  const measured = verdict;

  // 6. Re-authentication (§3.4) and its challenge, bound to the intent digest (the kind, account, currency, amount, stage).
  const settings = await readSettings(ext);
  const decimals = currency === 'SOL' ? 9 : 6;
  const reasons = presaleReauthReasons({
    firstPurchase: snapshot.limits.firstPurchase,
    amount,
    balance: currency === 'SOL' ? solBefore : balances[currency].total,
    usdMicros: largerValue(usdMicros(amount, decimals, priceOf(prices, currency) ?? undefined), measured.spentCents * 10_000n),
    thresholdCents: settings.reauthUsdCents,
  });
  const digest = intentDigest(PRESALE_BUY_INTENT, account, intent);
  const view = {
    currency,
    amount: intent.amount,
    stage: intent.stage,
    priceTicks: snapshot.stage.priceTicks.toString(),
    nocBase: measured.nocBase.toString(),
    spentCents: measured.spentCents.toString(),
    destination,
    referrer: snapshot.allocation.referrer === null ? null : {address: snapshot.allocation.referrer, registers: false},
    fees: {networkLamports: networkLamports.toString(), priorityLamports: priorityLamports.toString(), rentLamports: measured.rent.toString()},
  };
  let challengeId: string | null = null;
  if (reasons.length > 0) {
    const about: PurchaseAbout = {
      kind: PRESALE_BUY_KIND,
      account,
      currency,
      amount: intent.amount,
      stage: intent.stage,
      priceTicks: view.priceTicks,
      nocBase: view.nocBase,
      spentCents: view.spentCents,
      destination,
      networkLamports: view.fees.networkLamports,
      priorityLamports: view.fees.priorityLamports,
      rentLamports: view.fees.rentLamports,
      reasons,
      thresholdCents: settings.reauthUsdCents,
    };
    const fresh = about as unknown as KindAbout;
    const carried = opts.challengeId;
    const renewed = carried !== undefined && (await rebaseKindChallenge(ext, deps.now(), carried, digest, fresh));
    challengeId = renewed ? (carried as string) : await issueChallenge(ext, deps, digest, fresh);
  }

  // 7. The prepared entry (B1b's shape, this kind), replacing every entry of the account.
  const simulation: PurchaseView['simulation'] = {slot: run.sim.slot, elapsedMs: run.elapsedMs, programs: ['compute-budget', 'presale'], instructionCount: message.compiledInstructions.length};
  const bound = {
    id: randomId(deps.randomBytes),
    account,
    kind: PRESALE_BUY_KIND,
    intent,
    message: base64.encode(message.serialize()),
    lastValidBlockHeight: latest.lastValidBlockHeight,
    createdAt: deps.now(),
    intentDigest: digest,
    challengeId,
  };
  const prepared: PreparedPurchase = {
    ...bound,
    kind: PRESALE_BUY_KIND,
    integrity: preparedIntegrity(bound),
    shown: {
      fees: {networkLamports: view.fees.networkLamports, markupLamports: '0'},
      simulation,
      view: {...view, reasons},
      basis: {allocationExists: snapshot.allocation.exists, purchaseCount: snapshot.allocation.purchaseCount, referrer: snapshot.allocation.referrer, userAccountExists: snapshot.userAccountExists},
    },
  };
  await storePrepared(ext, deps, prepared);
  const proven = challengeId !== null && (await challengeSatisfied(ext, deps.now(), challengeId, digest));
  return {
    id: prepared.id,
    ...view,
    reauth: challengeId === null ? null : {challengeId, reasons, proven},
    validUntil: prepared.createdAt + PREPARED_TTL_MS,
    simulation,
  };
}
```

53 mutations (rev 2: + R10), all red, every one compiling. **The first sweep found four survivors and five non-compiling forms, all fixed before this sweep:** B7 (`spentCents < 0n`) survived because the separate `Δc > 0` clause was dead — `checkLimits` already refuses 0 cents (the minimum is never 0): the clause was removed and a row (SOL credited 0 cents) pins the property; B8 and B9 survived because the cents rows changed the cents without the NOC, so the NOC check refused them first — the rows now credit the NOC the program gives for those cents (`credited`), so each check is the only one that refuses its row; R6 survived because the only row created both PDAs at once — rows for one PDA each, and the referrer (R9), were added. A6, A7, C3, I1 and P7 did not compile in their first forms (an unused import or a lost narrowing) — the forms above. B15's first form changed nothing reachable and was replaced by the form above. Each mutant ran alone in a fresh `git archive HEAD` copy of `67bfaab` (`runmut.py`, four at a time); counts are the named files together (`BT` 62; C1 = IT + BT 91; K1 = CB + BT 77; S1 = ST + BT 166).

#### Dry-run notes (Task 2)

- **Ruling: the purchase kind registers itself when `buy.ts` loads** (as `prepare.ts` registers `send`), not inside `registerPresale` — why: `registerIntentKind` throws on a second registration and tests call `registerPresale` more than once; only `api.ts` imports `buy.ts`, so the kind exists exactly in the build with presale (`intents.test.ts` proves both builds) — cost if wrong: none (spec §1.3's "presale/api.ts registers presale-buy" holds through the import).
- **Ruling: #10's description of a purchase challenge is the kind's own `KindAbout`, validated by the kind** (`IntentKind.isAbout`, asked by `reauthChallenges.ts`'s `isAbout` for any kind outside `send` / `settings` / `dapp`) — why: shared code must not name `presale-buy` (a marker), and a stored record of a kind the build does not have must be dropped, not trusted (the off build drops it; a test in both builds) — cost if wrong: Task 5's #10 reads `PurchaseAbout`'s 14 fields; changing them later changes one validator.
- **Ruling: `rebaseChallenge` stays send-only; a purchase re-prepare renews its challenge through `rebaseKindChallenge`** with the kind's `rebaseAbout` (identity — account, currency, amount, stage, destination — from the stored record only; fees, NOC, cents, rent, reasons, threshold refreshed; the same `CHALLENGE_MAX_LIFE_MS` cap) — why: §3.3 step 6 "issued / re-based exactly as `prepareSend`", and C29's re-prepare must not ask for a second re-authentication — cost if wrong: one more re-authentication per 30 s re-prepare.
- **Ruling: `SolanaReader.getAccountsDataAt` (core) and `readPresaleStateAt`** — why: C39's "simulation slot not below the snapshot's" needs the snapshot's slot, which `getAccountsData` drops; a separate reader keeps 1a's state rules and their 100+ tests and the view untouched (the eight rules moved verbatim into one `stateFrom` both readers call) — cost if wrong: none (same RPC method, already on the proxy list).
- **Ruling: the stablecoin builder's `sourceTokenAccount` is required** (spec §3.3 step 4); the app and the web pass `derivedStablecoinAccount(user, token)` — byte-identical to before. This task therefore touches `core/`, the root `src/` and `web/` (root `tsc` + `jest`, web `verify` all run) — cost if wrong: none.
- **Ruling: prepare refuses with the quote's own line before building** (`quote()` on the fresh snapshot with this prepare's reads: the fee BOUND, the rent BOUND, ≥ 890 880 left — Task 1's rule), stricter than `prepareSend`'s exact remainder; the exact rule is the simulation's (rent from the post-state) — why: one rule for what #23 says and what prepare does; the bounds are the safe side — cost if wrong: an account cannot be emptied to exactly 0 by a purchase.
- **Ruling: SOL without a usable `/wallet/prices` SOL price is refused `no-sol-price` at prepare (C8); a stablecoin prepares without prices** — its dollar value is then the simulation's cents (C36) — cost if wrong: none.
- **Ruling (possible tension, flagged): the dollar re-auth rule takes the larger of the price's value and the simulation's `Δtotal_spent_cents` (spec C36); after a successful simulation the cents always exist, so D3's "a missing price counts as above" only decides when both are missing** (`presaleReauthReasons` with `usdMicros: null` → above, tested; unreachable through prepare). The brief restates D3 literally; the approved spec's C36 refines it — I followed the spec. Cost if the owner meant "a missing /wallet/prices price is above regardless": a stablecoin purchase ≤ $100 with prices down would also re-authenticate (stricter, one line: `?? null` → treat a null price as above).
- **Ruling: "destination-only" = every other check passed and the destination is well-formed** (SOL: a System account with no data; a stablecoin: the treasury's token account of that mint) **but its gain differs**; a destination of the wrong shape (a look-alike owner, another mint) is `simulation-mismatch` at once — why: a race changes an amount, never an owner — cost if wrong: none (refused either way).
- **Ruling: in the retry, "what the bytes were built from" is the user account's and the allocation's existence (the simulation's account list and the rent) and the referrer allocation → `state-changed` (Q43)**; the stage → `price-changed`; the state's own closures → their codes; the limits re-run through the quote's line. The payer's SOL and the paying token account's "before" are this prepare's own reads, not the snapshot's, and are not re-read (C39 lists the snapshot's values) — cost if wrong: a balance that moved between the two simulations fails the second's outflow check (`simulation-mismatch`, fail closed).
- **Ruling: the gate is asked once per prepare** (with the first snapshot), not again in the retry — C12 says "every prepare"; the sign-time check is Task 3's — cost if wrong: none.
- **Ruling: no separate `Δc > 0` test in `judge`**: `checkLimits` on the simulated cents refuses 0 (and less) because the minimum is never 0 (`purchaseLimits` falls back to 2 500); the first sweep's mutant `spentCents < 0n` survived, so the redundant clause was removed and a row (SOL credited 0 cents → mismatch) pins the property through the limit check — cost if wrong: none.
- **Ruling: engine bugs are thrown plain `Error`s** (an unexpected program, account, data or signer in the compiled message; a network fee above `PRESALE_FEE_BOUND_LAMPORTS`; a `register_referrer` resolved in 1b) → the handler's `failed`, never shown as a refusal and never simulated — spec §3.3 step 4 ("thrown, never shown").
- **Ruling: `PurchaseRefused` is presale's own class** (`SendRefusal` unchanged — spec §5 "presale/ only"); `presale.prepareBuy` answers `{ok: false, error: code, data?: {detail}}` as `wallet.prepareSend` does. 1a's ledger expected `SendRefusal` to widen for `beforeSign`; a `beforeSign` throwing `PurchaseRefused` propagates through `sendPrepared` unchanged, so Task 3 needs no widening either.
- **Ruling: `MARKERS` gains `presale.prepareBuy` and `presale-buy` now** (Task 1's notes deferred `presale-buy` to Task 8; `buy.ts` puts it in the on build here, and shared code carries it only in comments, which the build strips) — cost if wrong: none.
- **Deviation (stated, fail closed): `PRESALE_BUY_INTENT.beforeSign` refuses every entry (`prepared-invalid`) and the kind has no `pendingData` yet** — brief item 3 puts sign-time checks and the record in Task 3; a test proves nothing signs a purchase prepared by this task (wallet.send → `unknown-prepared`; `sendPrepared(…, 'presale-buy')` → `prepared-invalid`, the entry and the proof kept).
- **Deviation (stated): only `presale.prepareBuy` is added.** `presale.preparedFor`, `presale.discardPrepared` and `presale.buy` (§1.4) belong to the sign/resume task (Task 3); B1b's `discardPrepared` already drops every kind's entry of the account.
- **For Task 3:** sign with `sendPrepared(ext, deps, id, PRESALE_BUY_KIND)`; replace `beforeSign` (C12: `gateAnswer(deps)`; C22: `readPresaleStateAt` again, compare with `entry.shown.basis` and `intent.stage`, the prepared `spentCents` against the fresh remainder) and add `pendingData` from `entry.shown.view` (exactly §2.3's eight fields; `shown` is not integrity-bound, so read it defensively); `presale.preparedFor` needs a kind-filtered reader beside `preparedFor` (which returns sends only). The vault page still describes no purchase (`describePresale` → null, 1a): Task 5 renders `PurchaseAbout` (#10 rows, Q17, Q18).
- **(rev 2) Review 1 M3: the retry's limit re-check has its row.** A fresh snapshot whose configured minimum rose above the amount answers `below-min`, one whose per-user remainder shrank below it `above-user-limit` — each before the second simulation (two reads, one simulation). Without the line, `judge` would still refuse such a purchase, but as `simulation-mismatch` (Q16) for a limit the program names; the row keeps C39's promise. Rev 1's sweep did not reach the line (the review's M06 survived 127/127); R10 is red now. — cost if wrong: none.

  ```ts
  export interface PurchasePendingData {currency: PresaleCurrency; amount: string; stage: string; priceTicks: string; nocBase: string; spentCents: string; destination: string; referrer: string | null}
  // PRESALE_BUY_INTENT.beforeSign — refuses (throws) with: SendRefused 'prepared-invalid' (shown does not read back; rev 2: the entry not
  // under its integrity, or its message not exactly this purchase to the pinned destination); PurchaseRefused
  // 'in-flight' | 'geo-closed' (detail = the gate's reason) | 'presale-unavailable' | 'coordinator-refused' | 'presale-closed' | 'blocked'
  // | 'price-changed' | 'state-changed' | 'below-min' | 'above-max-tx' | 'above-user-limit'
  // PRESALE_BUY_INTENT.pendingData(entry, intent): PurchasePendingData | null
  export type ResumablePurchase = PurchaseView & {expired: boolean};
  export function purchasePreparedFor(ext: Ext, deps: Pick<WalletDeps, 'now'>, account: string): Promise<ResumablePurchase | null>;
  ```
- Produces (messages, popup and full tab only; `PRESALE_MESSAGE_TYPES` = `['presale.view', 'presale.banner', 'presale.quote', 'presale.prepareBuy', 'presale.pending', 'presale.preparedFor', 'presale.buy', 'presale.discardPrepared']`, the order pinned by four tests and `MARKERS`):
  - `presale.pending {account}` → `{ok: true, data: PendingView | null}` — the account's open `presale-buy` record; no network.
  - `presale.preparedFor {account}` → `{ok: true, data: ResumablePurchase | null}` — `reauth.proven` true once the vault page proved the challenge; `expired` past 30 s or once the challenge is gone; null past `CHALLENGE_TTL_MS`, for a send's entry, or for an entry whose `shown` does not read back.
  - `presale.buy {id}` (`id` 32 lowercase hex) → `{ok: true, data: PendingView}` (state `pending`, `intent: null`, `extra: {kind: 'presale-buy', data: PurchasePendingData}`), or `{ok: false, error}`: the purchase's codes above with `data: {detail}` when it has one; B1b's `reauth-required` (`data: {challengeId}`), `unknown-prepared` (also a send's id: D17), `prepared-expired`, `prepared-invalid`, `locked`, `unknown-account`, `in-flight` (submitSigned's), `check-pending` (`data: {id, signature}`), `coordinator-refused`, `unreachable`, `failed`.
  - `presale.discardPrepared {account}` → `{ok: true}` — B1b's `discardPrepared`: every entry of the account, of any kind, and their challenges.
  - Each: any key beyond its own, a non-address account → `malformed`; an account outside the unlocked session → `unknown-account`; locked → `locked`.
- **What later tasks rely on:** Task 4's 23b polls `presale.pending` (and `presale.view`'s `pending`, Task 1, reads the same record); Task 5's #20 purchase variant calls `presale.buy` / `presale.discardPrepared` / `presale.preparedFor` and translates the sign-time codes (§3.3: discard on `geo-closed`, `presale-closed`, `blocked`; keep and re-prepare carrying the challenge on `price-changed`, `state-changed`; the limit codes are #23's lines); Task 5's renderers parse `extra.data` = `PurchasePendingData` (all strings; `stage` the program's 0-indexed stage as a decimal string — display adds 1). **The popup half of §4.2's resume is Task 5's** (Writer notes): App.tsx's hook and the tab's `resume` route must ask `presale.preparedFor` when `wallet.preparedFor` is null, and push `presale-confirm` `resume`; today the vault page's hand-over `wallet.html#/send/resume?account=` lands on the send's #20, which finds no send for a purchase.

**Why the sign-time checks are in this order.** `sendPrepared` (1a) runs the kind's `beforeSign` after the challenge is found proven and before the single-use take, so each refusal here leaves the entry stored and the proof proven (C29); the popup re-prepares carrying the challenge id and is not asked to re-authenticate. First what needs no network: the entry's unbound `shown` must read back as exactly what `preparePurchase` wrote for this intent — it is not in the integrity digest, yet the sign-time comparison and the record take values from it — then C10 (a send recorded since the prepare refuses here, before the take; `submitSigned`'s own guard would refuse it only after the entry and the proof were spent). Then one gate answer and one read of the whole §2.1 snapshot together, the gate deciding first as at prepare; the snapshot's own rules carry C5's pins and rule 8's vault checks, `openSnapshot` the closed / blocked / unavailable / refused answers and C27's stage; then C22's identity of the account's presale accounts against the prepare's `basis` (allocation existence, `purchase_count`, referrer, user-account existence — what the bytes and the simulation were built from); **(rev 2, review 1 M1) between the two, the signed bytes themselves** (`signedPurchase`): the entry must read back under its integrity — so the message checked is the one `sendPrepared` signs after the take — and its message, deserialized, must pass `assertPurchaseMessage` for this intent against the destination the state pins and the referrer allocation the FRESH snapshot resolves; only that allocation differing (a referrer registered since prepare) is `state-changed`, anything else `prepared-invalid`. `shown.basis` is thus a claim the bytes confirm, not the evidence: a stored `shown` forged to name the new referrer is still refused; then the prepared cents against the fresh limits (the per-user remainder, and a configured minimum or maximum that moved). Nothing is simulated again at sign: the program prices at execution, and a stage that advances after this read is §5's accepted race ("(est.)").

```diff
+describe('a restart, a lock (B1b: never signed twice, never broadcast twice)', () => {
+  it('the worker stops between the record and the broadcast: the record is there, nothing sent; the next worker polls and never sends; the id never signs again', async () => {
+    const w = await world();

+    let recorded = (): void => undefined;
+    const atRecord = new Promise<void>(r => (recorded = r));
+    // The pending alarm is armed right after the record is written and before the broadcast: the worker stops there.
+    const create = w.ext.alarms.create;
+    w.ext.alarms.create = async () => {
+      recorded();
+      return new Promise<void>(() => undefined);
+    };
+    void buy(w, view.id);
+    await atRecord;

+    expect(w.deps.broadcasts).toEqual([]);
+
+    // The restarted worker: new deps over the same storage (the alarm API answers again).
+    w.ext.alarms.create = create;
+    const next = fakeDeps({reader: w.deps.reader});
+    next.broadcast = async wire => {
+      next.broadcasts.push(wire);
+      return firstSignature(wire);
+    };
+    next.clock.t = w.deps.now() + 2_000;
+    unseen(w, next);
+    expect(await pollOnce(w.ext, next)).toBe(true);
+    expect(await handleMessage(w.ext, {type: 'presale.buy', id: view.id}, POPUP_SENDER(w.ext), next)).toEqual({ok: false, error: 'unknown-prepared'});
+    expect([w.deps.broadcasts.length, next.broadcasts.length]).toEqual([0, 0]);
+    // #54's resend is the user's: the very bytes recorded, once.
+    const [record] = await records(w);
+    expect(await handleMessage(w.ext, {type: 'wallet.resend', id: record?.id}, POPUP_SENDER(w.ext), next)).toMatchObject({ok: true});
+    expect(next.broadcasts.map(b => base64.encode(b))).toEqual([record?.wire]);
+  });
+
+  it('the worker stops during the broadcast: one broadcast; the next worker sees it confirmed and sends nothing', async () => {
+    const w = await world();
+    const view = await provenPurchase(w, intent('SOL', SOL_2));
+    let handed = (): void => undefined;
+    const atBroadcast = new Promise<void>(r => (handed = r));
+    w.deps.broadcast = async wire => {
+      w.deps.broadcasts.push(wire);
+      handed();
+      return new Promise<string>(() => undefined);
+    };
+    void buy(w, view.id);
+    await atBroadcast;
+    const next = fakeDeps({reader: w.deps.reader});
+    next.clock.t = w.deps.now() + 2_000;
+    confirmAll(w, next);
+    expect(await pollOnce(w.ext, next)).toBe(false);
+    expect((await records(w))[0]).toMatchObject({state: 'confirmed', extra: {kind: 'presale-buy'}});
+    expect([w.deps.broadcasts.length, next.broadcasts.length]).toEqual([1, 0]);
+  });
+
+  it('a lock while the sign-time checks run: nothing signed, nothing recorded, the entry and the challenge gone with the session', async () => {
+    let release = (_: GeoAnswer): void => undefined;
+    let asked = (): void => undefined;
+    const atGate = new Promise<void>(r => (asked = r));
+    let calls = 0;
+    const w = await world({
+      geo: async () => {
+        calls += 1;
+        if (calls === 1) return OPEN;
+        asked();
+        return new Promise<GeoAnswer>(r => (release = r));

+    const view = await provenPurchase(w, intent('SOL', SOL_2));
+    const answer = buy(w, view.id);
+    await atGate;

+    expect([w.deps.broadcasts.length, (await records(w)).length]).toEqual([0, 0]);

+  it('a lock while the purchase is prepared (the simulation in flight): nothing stored, no challenge left', async () => {

+    w.deps.reader = {
+      ...w.deps.reader,
+      simulateTransaction: async (wire, opts) => {
+        asked();

+    const answer = ask(w, {type: 'presale.prepareBuy', account: ACCOUNT, intent: intent('SOL', SOL_2)});

+  });
```

```diff
+const exactKeys = (o: Record<string, unknown>, keys: readonly string[]): boolean => Object.keys(o).length === keys.length && keys.every(k => Object.hasOwn(o, k));
+const record = (x: unknown): Record<string, unknown> | null => (typeof x === 'object' && x !== null && !Array.isArray(x) ? (x as Record<string, unknown>) : null);

+const SHOWN_VIEW_KEYS = ['currency', 'amount', 'stage', 'priceTicks', 'nocBase', 'spentCents', 'destination', 'referrer', 'fees', 'reasons'];
+
+/**
+ * What prepare kept beside the bound fields, read back for this intent — `shown` is not in the integrity, so it is a
+ * claim like any stored value: exactly the shape preparePurchase writes, the intent's own currency, amount and stage,
+ * the stage's price and the destination the state pins for the currency. Rebuilt key by key (a fresh object), or null.
+ */
+function shownOf(entry: PreparedEntry, intent: PurchaseIntent): PreparedPurchase['shown'] | null {
+  const shown = record(entry.shown);
+  const fees = record(shown?.fees);
+  const sim = record(shown?.simulation);
+  const view = record(shown?.view);
+  const basis = record(shown?.basis);
+  if (shown === null || fees === null || sim === null || view === null || basis === null || !exactKeys(shown, ['fees', 'simulation', 'view', 'basis'])) return null;
+  if (!exactKeys(fees, ['networkLamports', 'markupLamports']) || !digits(fees.networkLamports) || fees.markupLamports !== '0') return null;
+  const programs = sim.programs;
+  if (!exactKeys(sim, ['slot', 'elapsedMs', 'programs', 'instructionCount']) || !count(sim.slot) || !count(sim.elapsedMs) || sim.instructionCount !== 3) return null;
+  if (!Array.isArray(programs) || programs.length !== 2 || programs[0] !== 'compute-budget' || programs[1] !== 'presale') return null;
+  if (!exactKeys(view, SHOWN_VIEW_KEYS) || view.currency !== intent.currency || view.amount !== intent.amount || view.stage !== intent.stage) return null;
+  if (view.priceTicks !== (STAGE_PRICE_TICKS[intent.stage] as bigint).toString() || !digits(view.nocBase) || !digits(view.spentCents) || view.destination !== PINNED_DESTINATION[intent.currency]) return null;
+  const referrer = view.referrer === null ? null : record(view.referrer);
+  if (view.referrer !== null && (referrer === null || !exactKeys(referrer, ['address', 'registers']) || typeof referrer.address !== 'string' || !ADDRESS.test(referrer.address) || referrer.registers !== false)) return null;
+  const vf = record(view.fees);
+  if (vf === null || !exactKeys(vf, ['networkLamports', 'priorityLamports', 'rentLamports']) || vf.networkLamports !== fees.networkLamports || !digits(vf.priorityLamports) || !digits(vf.rentLamports)) return null;
+  const reasons = view.reasons;
+  if (!Array.isArray(reasons) || new Set(reasons).size !== reasons.length || !(reasons as unknown[]).every(r => typeof r === 'string' && (REASONS as readonly string[]).includes(r))) return null;
+  if (!exactKeys(basis, ['allocationExists', 'purchaseCount', 'referrer', 'userAccountExists']) || typeof basis.allocationExists !== 'boolean' || !count(basis.purchaseCount) || typeof basis.userAccountExists !== 'boolean') return null;
+  if (basis.referrer !== null && (typeof basis.referrer !== 'string' || !ADDRESS.test(basis.referrer))) return null;
+  return {
+    fees: {networkLamports: fees.networkLamports, markupLamports: '0'},
+    simulation: {slot: sim.slot, elapsedMs: sim.elapsedMs, programs: ['compute-budget', 'presale'], instructionCount: 3},
+    view: {
+      currency: intent.currency,
+      amount: intent.amount,
+      stage: intent.stage,
+      priceTicks: view.priceTicks,
+      nocBase: view.nocBase,
+      spentCents: view.spentCents,
+      destination: view.destination,
+      referrer: referrer === null ? null : {address: referrer.address as string, registers: false},
+      fees: {networkLamports: vf.networkLamports, priorityLamports: vf.priorityLamports, rentLamports: vf.rentLamports},
+      reasons: [...(reasons as PresaleReauthReason[])],
+    },
+    basis: {allocationExists: basis.allocationExists, purchaseCount: basis.purchaseCount, referrer: basis.referrer, userAccountExists: basis.userAccountExists},
+  };
+}
+
+/**
+ * §3.3 (C12, C22, C10; C29 — sendPrepared runs this after the challenge check and before the single-use take, so a
+ * refusal burns neither the entry nor the proof): what must still hold when the user signs. Refused with §5's code: the
+ * entry's facts do not read back (`prepared-invalid`); a transaction of the account recorded since (`in-flight`); the gate
+ * not open (`geo-closed`) — decided first, as at prepare; the state (one read of the whole §2.1 snapshot) unavailable,

+async function purchaseBeforeSign({ext, deps}: KindHost, entry: PreparedEntry, intent: PurchaseIntent): Promise<void> {
+  const shown = shownOf(entry, intent);
+  if (shown === null) throw new SendRefused('prepared-invalid', 'the prepared purchase does not read back');
+  // Refused here, before the take, rather than by submitSigned's own in-flight guard after it.
+  if (inFlightFor(await readPending(ext), entry.account) !== undefined) throw new PurchaseRefused('in-flight');
```

#### Dry-run notes (Task 3)

- **Deviation (stated loudly): the popup half of §4.2's resume paths moves to Task 5.** Brief item 3 and §4.2 ask App.tsx's resume hook and the tab's `resume` hand-over to push `presale-confirm` `resume` for a purchase whose #10 was proven with the popup closed. There is no `presale-confirm` route and no #20 purchase screen until Task 5, and #10 cannot even describe a purchase challenge until then (`describePresale` → null, Task 2's notes) — pushing a route with no screen would be a placeholder (rule 1), and the hook cannot be tested end to end before the screen exists. This task builds and proves the background half: `presale.preparedFor` answers `proven: true` after the vault page proved the challenge, and `presale.buy` then signs with no second proof (BT “#10 proven with the popup closed …”); `expired` and the challenge carry-over as B1b. **Task 5 MUST:** add `presale.preparedFor` to App.tsx's popup hook (asked when `wallet.preparedFor` answers null — at most one entry per account, so whichever answers) and to the tab's `resume` route (`#/send/resume?account=` today renders the send's #20, which finds no send for a purchase), each pushing `presale-confirm` `resume`; and the §6.1 "Resume" component rows. Cost if wrong: none for funds (an unresumed purchase entry expires; nothing is signed without `presale.buy`).
- **Ruling: the sign-time state read is `readPresaleStateAt`** (the same one `getMultipleAccounts` of the six accounts as `readPresaleState`, its slot unused) — why: one reader for every purchase read, and the test world steers each successive snapshot by index (prepare, sign, re-prepare, sign) — cost if wrong: none.
- **Ruling: `beforeSign` re-checks C10 itself, before the take** — why: a send recorded between the prepare and the Buy is refused by `submitSigned`'s guard anyway, but only after the take and `consumeChallenge` (the entry and the proof spent); C29's "a refusal burns nothing" then holds for this case too (S11 proves the difference) — cost if wrong: one `readPending` per signature.
- **Ruling: the sign-time limits are all three of `checkLimits`** (the minimum, the per-transaction maximum, the per-user remainder) on the prepared `spentCents` against the fresh config — C22 names only the remainder (Q40c); a configured minimum or maximum moved between the prepare and the Buy (admin action) is the same kind of change and the program would refuse it with the fee paid — stricter, cost if wrong: none.
- **Ruling: C22's "the allocation's existence, `purchase_count` or referrer" also compares the user account's existence** (`state-changed`) — why: Task 2's retry treats both as "what the bytes were built from" (the simulation's accounts and the created rent); consistent — cost if wrong: none (refused, re-prepare).
- **Ruling: `shown` is read back strictly (`shownOf`) before anything uses it** — at sign (`prepared-invalid` when it does not read back, before any read), for the record (`pendingData` null → the record is still written, shown generically, Q42) and for the resume (null → not resumed). Why: `shown` is not in the integrity digest (1a), yet C22's comparison and §2.3's record take values from it; the reader requires exactly what `preparePurchase` writes for this intent — its currency, amount, stage, the stage's price and the destination the state pins for the currency (a look-alike treasury does not read back, S13) — cost if wrong: none (storage.session is the background's; this is defence in depth).
- **Ruling: §2.3's `stage` is the program's 0-indexed stage as a decimal string** ("all strings"); Task 1's `api.test.ts` fixture already wrote `stage: '0'`; the renderer adds 1 for "Stage N of 10" — cost if wrong: one renderer line in Task 5.
- **Ruling: `presale.pending` lands here, not with #23b** — it is a read of the record this task writes, no network, and Task 4's 23b consumes it — cost if wrong: none.
- **Ruling: `presale.discardPrepared` and `presale.preparedFor` check the session** (`locked` / `unknown-account`, §1.4's strict-payload paragraph), unlike B1b's `wallet.discardPrepared` / `wallet.preparedFor` — cost if wrong: none (storage.session is cleared by a lock anyway).
- **Accounted for (brief): `discardPrepared` drops every kind of the account.** An account holds at most one prepared entry (every prepare of any kind replaces the account's entries, 1a), so `presale.discardPrepared` drops this purchase or the send that already replaced it, and `wallet.discardPrepared` drops a purchase — both with their challenges (BT the two discard rows). The visible consequence: a #20 Cancel in a second window, for either kind, ends the other kind's review in the first (its next Buy is `unknown-prepared` → re-prepare) — fail closed.
- **In-flight exclusivity, both directions (brief, C10):** a purchase in flight refuses a second purchase's prepare, a send's prepare and a stored send's signing (`submitSigned`'s guard, B1b); a send in flight refuses a purchase's prepare (Task 2) and, recorded after the purchase's prepare, its signing (here, before the take). Closed records and other accounts' do not count (positive control).
- **The lock (brief "the lock hook"):** a lock while the sign-time checks run clears storage.session (`lockInSection`), so the take finds nothing — `unknown-prepared`, B1b's answer, nothing signed or recorded; a lock during a prepare stores nothing and leaves no challenge (`storePrepared`, 1a); a record outlives a lock (storage.local) and is polled to `confirmed`.
- **The restart (brief):** B1b's rule, unchanged — the wallet's own record is `firstBroadcast: 'done'` from its write, written before the broadcast; a worker stopped between the two leaves a record nobody re-sends (the poller only polls; #54's resend sends the very recorded bytes, once, on the user's tap); a worker stopped during the broadcast leaves one broadcast, polled to `confirmed`. The entry was taken, so the id never signs again.
- **Existing sends unchanged:** `preparedFor` now reads through `newestPrepared` (same filter, same newest rule — `send.test.ts`'s `preparedFor` rows and `intents.test.ts`'s captured 0b79442 replays green in both runs); `failure` is only exported.

Task 5's #20 must treat `presale.buy`'s `prepared-invalid` as B1b does (re-prepare), and per §3.3 discard on `geo-closed` / `presale-closed` / `blocked`, keep for `price-changed` / `state-changed`.

Only the allocation differing → `state-changed` (Q43, the popup re-prepares carrying the challenge); anything else → `prepared-invalid`. On rev 1's code a stored message re-pointed at a look-alike treasury with its integrity recomputed SIGNED (the rev 2 row is red there): storage.session is background-owned, so this was defence in depth, not a reachable hole — now closed from the bytes. Create `extension/src/background/presale/__tests__/simulation.ts` (the honest simulation and its two rents, moved from `buy.test.ts` lines 74–76 and 94–163 unchanged, exported; `PDAS` and the imports it needs repeated here):

```ts
import {PublicKey, VersionedTransaction} from '@solana/web3.js';
import {base64} from '@scure/base';
import {solCents} from '../quote';
import {CONFIG_LAYOUT, PRESALE_ALLOCATION_LAYOUT} from '../layouts';
import {scaledUsdPrice} from '../../reauthPolicy';
import {SIMULATED_SLOT} from '../../__tests__/fixtures';
import {PRESALE_INSTRUCTIONS} from '../../dapp/decode/presaleIdl';
import {MAINNET_PROGRAM_ID, MAINNET_USDC_MINT, MAINNET_USDT_MINT} from '../../../../../core/presale/addresses';
import {derivePresalePdas, readU64LE} from '../../../../../core/presale/allocation';
import {tokensFor, usdCentsForStable} from '../../../../../core/presale/limits';
import {SPL_TOKEN_PROGRAM} from '../../../../../core/solana/encoding';
import {SYSTEM_PROGRAM_ID, type AccountData, type SimulatedAccount, type SimulationOutcome, type TokenAccountEntry} from '../../../../../core/solana/rpc';
import {ACCOUNT, CONFIG_PDA, TREASURY_ADDRESS, USDC_VAULT, USDT_VAULT, allocationData, tokenAccountData, userData, vault} from './chain';

// B1d §3.3: the program's own effects on the accounts a purchase's prepare asks the simulation for — moved from
// buy.test.ts (B1d-1b Task 4) so #23's component tests prepare against the same simulation.
export const ALLOCATION_RENT = 1_244_600n;
export const USER_RENT = 944_880n;
const PDAS = derivePresalePdas(new PublicKey(ACCOUNT));

/** What the program does to the accounts a purchase touches, as a simulation reports them. */
export interface Effects {
  currency: 'SOL' | 'USDC' | 'USDT';
  amount: bigint;
  cents: bigint;
  stage: number;
}

export function effectsOf(wire: string, chain: Map<string, AccountData | null>, pythUsd: number): Effects {
  const message = VersionedTransaction.deserialize(base64.decode(wire)).message;
  const ix = message.compiledInstructions.at(-1);
  if (ix === undefined) throw new Error('no purchase');
  const disc = [...ix.data.subarray(0, 8)];
  const name = PRESALE_INSTRUCTIONS.find(i => i.discriminator.every((b, n) => b === disc[n]))?.name;
  const currency = name === 'presale_purchase_with_sol' ? 'SOL' : name === 'presale_purchase_with_usdc' ? 'USDC' : 'USDT';
  const amount = readU64LE(ix.data, 8);
  const config = chain.get(CONFIG_PDA)?.data ?? new Uint8Array(0);
  const stage = config[CONFIG_LAYOUT.fields.current_stage.offset] as number;
  const cents = currency === 'SOL' ? solCents(amount, scaledUsdPrice(pythUsd) as bigint) : usdCentsForStable(amount);
  return {currency, amount, cents, stage};
}

/** The simulation the program and an honest proxy give for `wire`, against `chain` as it is at that slot. */
export function honestSimulation(wire: string, addresses: readonly string[], chain: Map<string, AccountData | null>, sol: bigint, holdings: readonly TokenAccountEntry[], pythUsd: number): SimulationOutcome {
  const e = effectsOf(wire, chain, pythUsd);
  const allocation = chain.get(PDAS.userAllocation.toBase58()) ?? null;
  const user = chain.get(PDAS.userAccount.toBase58()) ?? null;
  const A = PRESALE_ALLOCATION_LAYOUT.fields;
  const before = allocation === null ? {total: 0n, spent: 0n, count: 0} : {total: readU64LE(allocation.data, A.total_tokens.offset), spent: readU64LE(allocation.data, A.total_spent_cents.offset), count: allocation.data[A.purchase_count.offset] as number};
  const referrer = allocation === null ? null : allocation.data.subarray(A.referrer.offset, A.referrer.offset + 32).every(b => b === 0) ? null : new PublicKey(allocation.data.subarray(A.referrer.offset, A.referrer.offset + 32)).toBase58();
  const allocationAfter: SimulatedAccount = {
    lamports: allocation?.lamports ?? ALLOCATION_RENT,
    owner: MAINNET_PROGRAM_ID,
    data: allocationData({totalTokens: before.total + tokensFor(e.cents, e.stage), spent: before.spent + e.cents, count: before.count + 1, referrer, bonus: 0n}),
  };
  const rent = (allocation === null ? ALLOCATION_RENT : 0n) + (user === null ? USER_RENT : 0n);
  const post = (address: string): SimulatedAccount | null => {
    if (address === ACCOUNT) return {lamports: sol - (e.currency === 'SOL' ? e.amount : 0n) - rent, owner: SYSTEM_PROGRAM_ID, data: new Uint8Array(0)};
    if (address === PDAS.userAllocation.toBase58()) return allocationAfter;
    if (address === PDAS.userAccount.toBase58()) return user ?? {lamports: USER_RENT, owner: MAINNET_PROGRAM_ID, data: userData()};
    const before = chain.get(address);
    if (address === TREASURY_ADDRESS && before) return {...before, lamports: before.lamports + (e.currency === 'SOL' ? e.amount : 0n)};
    if ((address === USDC_VAULT || address === USDT_VAULT) && before) {
      const mint = address === USDC_VAULT ? MAINNET_USDC_MINT : MAINNET_USDT_MINT;
      const gain = (e.currency === 'USDC' && address === USDC_VAULT) || (e.currency === 'USDT' && address === USDT_VAULT) ? e.amount : 0n;
      return vault({mint, amount: readU64LE(before.data, 64) + gain});
    }
    const h = holdings.find(x => x.pubkey === address);
    if (h !== undefined) return {lamports: 2_039_280n, owner: SPL_TOKEN_PROGRAM, data: tokenAccountData({mint: h.mint, owner: h.owner, amount: h.amount - e.amount})};
    return null;
  };
  return {err: null, logs: [], unitsConsumed: 61_000, slot: SIMULATED_SLOT, accounts: addresses.map(post)};
}
```

Create `extension/src/app/presale/__tests__/Presale.test.tsx` (#23 against the real background, rendered in happy-dom; every literal is the background's own answer for chain.ts's chain — computed by the background's `quote` once, then written down, so a wrong formatter cannot pass by being compared with itself):

```tsx
// @vitest-environment happy-dom
import {act, fireEvent, render, screen} from '@testing-library/react';
import {base64} from '@scure/base';
import {renderInWallet, setupWallet, type WalletOptions} from '../../__tests__/harness';
import {WalletProvider} from '../../WalletContext';
import {Presale} from '../Presale';
import {PRESALE_ROUTE} from '../routes';
import {UI_SHEETS, selectorsOf, unstyledClasses} from '../../../__tests__/styled';
import {registerPresale} from '../../../background/presale/api';
import {registerPresaleHandler} from '../../../background/messages';
import {PENDING_KEY, type PendingRecord} from '../../../background/pendingStore';
import type {GeoAnswer} from '../../../background/geo/gate';
import {fakeDeps} from '../../../background/__tests__/fakeDeps';
import {fakeExt} from '../../../background/__tests__/fakeExt';
import {BLOCKHASH, HOLDING_LARGE, HOLDING_SMALL, pendingRecord, signedWire} from '../../../background/__tests__/fixtures';
import {ACCOUNT, NOW_MS, TREASURY_ADDRESS, allocationData, chainMap, chainReader, configData, program, userData, type Chain} from '../../../background/presale/__tests__/chain';
import {honestSimulation} from '../../../background/presale/__tests__/simulation';
import {MAINNET_NOC_MINT, MAINNET_USDC_MINT, MAINNET_USDT_MINT} from '../../../../../core/presale/addresses';
import {firstSignature} from '../../../../../core/solana/broadcast';
import {RpcForbidden, type AccountData, type TokenAccountEntry} from '../../../../../core/solana/rpc';
import type {Prices} from '../../../../../core/portfolio/value';
import type {PurchaseView} from '../client';

registerPresale({ext: fakeExt(), deps: fakeDeps(), handle: registerPresaleHandler});

// B1d §4.1 (C3, C8, C17, C18, C30, C35, D5): #23 against the REAL background — handleMessage with the presale handlers,
// the program state from chain.ts's byte builders, the gate and the prices as deps — rendered in happy-dom. Every
// number on screen is the background's: these literals were computed by the background's own quote for this chain.
const SELECTORS = selectorsOf(UI_SHEETS);
const SOL_USD = 198.42;
const OPEN: GeoAnswer = {open: true, reason: null, countryCode: 'SI'};
const holding = (pubkey: string, mint: string, amount: bigint): TokenAccountEntry => ({pubkey, mint, owner: ACCOUNT, amount, decimals: mint === MAINNET_NOC_MINT ? 9 : 6});
const USDC_SMALL = '7xKXtg2CW87d97TXJSDpbD5jBkheTqA83TZRuJosgAsU';
const HOLDINGS: TokenAccountEntry[] = [holding(USDC_SMALL, MAINNET_USDC_MINT, 30_000_000n), holding(HOLDING_LARGE, MAINNET_USDC_MINT, 50_000_000n), holding(HOLDING_SMALL, MAINNET_USDT_MINT, 7_000_000n)];

interface Calls {
  accounts: string[][];
  balance: number;
  tokens: number;
  prices: number;
  geo: number;
}
interface World {
  chain: Map<string, AccountData | null>;
  calls: Calls;
  wallet: {sol: bigint};
  geo: {answer: GeoAnswer};
  prices: {answer: () => Promise<Prices>};
  options: WalletOptions;
}
/** The chain, the wallet's SOL and holdings, the gate and the prices — each mutable mid-test (a stage that moves, a gate that closes). */
function world(o: {chain?: Partial<Chain>; sol?: bigint; geo?: GeoAnswer; prices?: () => Promise<Prices>; before?: WalletOptions['before']; gate?: WalletOptions['gate']; read?: () => Promise<never>} = {}): World {
  const calls: Calls = {accounts: [], balance: 0, tokens: 0, prices: 0, geo: 0};
  const chain = chainMap(o.chain);
  const wallet = {sol: o.sol ?? 12_482_100_000n};
  const geo = {answer: o.geo ?? OPEN};
  const prices = {answer: o.prices ?? (async (): Promise<Prices> => ({solana: SOL_USD, usdc: 1, usdt: 1}))};
  const reader = chainReader(chain, calls.accounts, {
    ...(o.read === undefined ? {} : {getAccountsData: o.read}),
    getBalance: async () => {
      calls.balance += 1;
      return wallet.sol;
    },
    getTokenAccountsByOwner: async (_owner, filter) => {
      calls.tokens += 1;
      return HOLDINGS.filter(h => !('mint' in filter) || h.mint === filter.mint);
    },
    getSignaturesForAddress: async () => [],
    getRecentPrioritizationFees: async () => [],
    getLatestBlockhash: async () => ({blockhash: BLOCKHASH, lastValidBlockHeight: 1000}),
    simulateTransaction: async (wire, opts) => honestSimulation(wire, opts?.accounts ?? [], chain, wallet.sol, HOLDINGS, SOL_USD),
  });
  const deps = {
    geo: async () => {
      calls.geo += 1;
      return geo.answer;
    },
    prices: async () => {
      calls.prices += 1;
      return prices.answer();
    },
    now: () => NOW_MS,
  };
  return {chain, calls, wallet, geo, prices, options: {reader, deps, ...(o.before === undefined ? {} : {before: o.before}), ...(o.gate === undefined ? {} : {gate: o.gate})}};
}
const nav = {onBack: vi.fn(), onDone: vi.fn(), onPrepared: vi.fn(), onRegion: vi.fn()};
const presale = () => <Presale {...nav} />;
const show = (w: World) => renderInWallet(presale(), w.options);
const requests = (c: Calls) => ({accounts: c.accounts.length, balance: c.balance, tokens: c.tokens, prices: c.prices, geo: c.geo});
const text = (sel: string) => document.querySelector(sel)?.textContent ?? null;
const buyButton = () => document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('.sticky-bar .btn-primary');
const amountInput = () => screen.getByLabelText('YOU PAY') as HTMLInputElement;
const type = (value: string) => fireEvent.change(amountInput(), {target: {value}});
/** The rule-6 lock is 500 ms: a second Buy needs the button back. */
const settle = () => act(() => new Promise<void>(r => setTimeout(r, 600)));
/** Boolean, with neutral messages (public CI logs): no date and no countdown on the screen (D5, owner rule). */
function expectNoTgeDate() {
  const t = document.body.textContent ?? '';
  expect(/\b(19|20)\d{2}\b/.test(t)).toBe(false);
  expect(/\b(Jan|Feb|Mar|Apr|May|Jun|Jul|Aug|Sep|Oct|Nov|Dec)[a-z]*\.? \d/.test(t)).toBe(false);
  expect(/\b(in|ends|claimable in)\s+~?\d+\s*(d|h|days?|hours?|weeks?|months?)\b/i.test(t)).toBe(false);
}
const SIGNATURE = firstSignature(signedWire(7n));
const DATA = {currency: 'SOL', amount: '2000000000', stage: '0', priceTicks: '1501', nocBase: '2643837441705', spentCents: '39684', destination: TREASURY_ADDRESS, referrer: null};

    expect(screen.getByText('Paid')).toBeTruthy();

        },
      }),

    expect(screen.getByText('Presale unavailable — try again later.')).toBeTruthy();
  });

    await show(world({before: seed([purchase({account: HOLDING_LARGE}), purchase({id: 'b2', state: 'confirmed'}), pendingRecord({id: 's1', account: ACCOUNT, state: 'pending'})])}));
    expect(await screen.findByText('Stage 1 of 10 · live')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.queryByText('Order pending')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('23b reads its record every 6 s (no network); once it is no longer open, one full view: 23a with the allocation row', async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers({shouldAdvanceTime: true});
    const asked: string[] = [];

    const wallet = await show(w);
    await screen.findByText('Order pending');
    const reads = w.calls.accounts.length;
    await act(() => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(6_000));
    expect(asked.filter(t => t === 'presale.pending').length).toBe(1);
    expect(w.calls.accounts.length).toBe(reads);
    expect(screen.getByText('Order pending')).toBeTruthy();
    // It confirms: the record closes, the allocation exists on chain.
    await wallet.ext.local.set(PENDING_KEY, [purchase({state: 'confirmed'})]);
    w.chain.set([...w.chain.keys()][1] as string, program(userData()));
    w.chain.set([...w.chain.keys()][2] as string, program(allocationData()));
    await act(() => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(6_000));
    expect(await screen.findByText('Your allocation')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.queryByText('Order pending')).toBeNull();
    expect(w.calls.accounts.length).toBe(reads + 1);
  });
});
```
