```tsx
describe('the request budget (C35, review 2 M3): five requests a view, two a re-read, none while hidden', () => {
  /** #23 alone in a quiet provider: the wallet's own open sequence reads nothing, so every request counted is #23's. */
  async function quiet(w: World) {
    const wallet = await setupWallet(w.options);
    render(
      <WalletProvider engine={wallet.engine} platform={wallet.platform} surface="popup" quiet>
        {presale()}
      </WalletProvider>,
    );
    await screen.findByText('Stage 1 of 10 · live');
    return wallet;
  }
  const setVisibility = (state: 'visible' | 'hidden') => {
    Object.defineProperty(document, 'visibilityState', {configurable: true, get: () => state});
    act(() => void document.dispatchEvent(new Event('visibilitychange')));
  };
  afterEach(() => setVisibility('visible'));

  it('mount: the snapshot, the gate, the SOL balance, the holdings and the price — five; each 25 s: the snapshot and the gate — two', async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers({shouldAdvanceTime: true});
    const w = world();
    await quiet(w);
    expect(requests(w.calls)).toEqual({accounts: 1, geo: 1, balance: 1, tokens: 1, prices: 1});
    await act(() => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(25_000));
    expect(requests(w.calls)).toEqual({accounts: 2, geo: 2, balance: 1, tokens: 1, prices: 1});
    await act(() => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(25_000));
    expect(requests(w.calls)).toEqual({accounts: 3, geo: 3, balance: 1, tokens: 1, prices: 1});
  });

  it('hidden: no re-read at all; visible again: one full view, then the 25 s re-reads resume', async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers({shouldAdvanceTime: true});
    const w = world();
    await quiet(w);
    setVisibility('hidden');
    await act(() => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(75_000));
    expect(requests(w.calls)).toEqual({accounts: 1, geo: 1, balance: 1, tokens: 1, prices: 1});
    setVisibility('visible');
    await act(() => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(0));
    expect(requests(w.calls)).toEqual({accounts: 2, geo: 2, balance: 2, tokens: 2, prices: 2});
    await act(() => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(25_000));
    expect(requests(w.calls)).toEqual({accounts: 3, geo: 3, balance: 2, tokens: 2, prices: 2});
  });

  it('focus asks a full view; typing asks quotes, which read nothing', async () => {
    const w = world();
    await quiet(w);
    type('2');
    await screen.findByText('Buy 2,643.83 NOC');
    expect(requests(w.calls)).toEqual({accounts: 1, geo: 1, balance: 1, tokens: 1, prices: 1});
    act(() => void window.dispatchEvent(new Event('focus')));
    await act(() => new Promise<void>(r => setTimeout(r, 50)));
    expect(requests(w.calls)).toEqual({accounts: 2, geo: 2, balance: 2, tokens: 2, prices: 2});
  });

  it('23b does not re-read the view every 25 s (its record only, C30)', async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers({shouldAdvanceTime: true});
    const w = world({before: seed([purchase()])});
    const wallet = await setupWallet(w.options);
    render(
      <WalletProvider engine={wallet.engine} platform={wallet.platform} surface="popup" quiet>
        {presale()}
      </WalletProvider>,
    );
    await screen.findByText('Order pending');
    // The mount's one full view (C30: the record first, then the same view as 23a's); after it, nothing for 50 s.
    expect(requests(w.calls)).toEqual({accounts: 1, geo: 1, balance: 1, tokens: 1, prices: 1});
    await act(() => vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(50_000));
    expect(requests(w.calls)).toEqual({accounts: 1, geo: 1, balance: 1, tokens: 1, prices: 1});
  });
});
```

```ts
import type {GeoAnswer} from '../../../background/geo/gate';
import {fakeDeps} from '../../../background/__tests__/fakeDeps';
import {fakeExt} from '../../../background/__tests__/fakeExt';
import {HOLDING_LARGE, pendingRecord, unlocked} from '../../../background/__tests__/fixtures';

import {MAINNET_USDC_MINT} from '../../../../../core/presale/addresses';

registerPresale({ext: fakeExt(), deps: fakeDeps(), handle: registerPresaleHandler});

// B1d §1.4, §2.5, §3.2, §3.3 (C3): the popup's presale client — its shape checks on the REAL background's answers
// (positive controls), and every way a reply can be of another shape (failed, never shown).
const OPEN: GeoAnswer = {open: true, reason: null, countryCode: 'SI'};
function depsFor(o: {chain?: Partial<Chain>; geo?: GeoAnswer}) {
  const reader = chainReader(chainMap(o.chain), [], {
    getBalance: async () => 5_000_000_000n,
    getTokenAccountsByOwner: async owner => [{pubkey: HOLDING_LARGE, mint: MAINNET_USDC_MINT, owner, amount: 50_000_000n, decimals: 6}],
  });
  const deps = fakeDeps({reader, geo: async () => o.geo ?? OPEN, prices: async () => ({solana: 198.42, usdc: 1, usdt: 1})});
  deps.clock.t = NOW_MS;
  return deps;
}
const popupOf = (ext: ReturnType<typeof fakeExt>) => ({id: ext.runtimeId, origin: ext.extensionOrigin, url: `${ext.extensionOrigin}/popup.html`});
async function wired(o: {chain?: Partial<Chain>; geo?: GeoAnswer} = {}) {
  const ext = fakeExt();
  await unlocked(ext);
  const deps = depsFor(o);
  const sent: unknown[] = [];
  const transport: Transport = m => {
    sent.push(m);
    return handleMessage(ext, m, popupOf(ext), deps);
  };
  return {ext, sent, client: presaleClient(createEngine(transport, async () => undefined))};
}
/** The background's raw answer to a message, for the shape checks' negative rows. */
async function raw(m: Record<string, unknown>, o: {chain?: Partial<Chain>; geo?: GeoAnswer} = {}): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
  const ext = fakeExt();
  await unlocked(ext);
  const r = (await handleMessage(ext, m, popupOf(ext), depsFor(o))) as {data: Record<string, unknown>};
  return r.data;
}
const DATA = {currency: 'USDC', amount: '25000000', stage: '0', priceTicks: '1501', nocBase: '166555629580', spentCents: '2500', destination: TREASURY_ADDRESS, referrer: null};
const SIGNATURE = '5'.repeat(88);

describe('the client against the real background (positive controls)', () => {
  it('view: the open variant with bigints; the messages as the background parses them, `refresh` only when asked', async () => {
    const w = await wired();
    const r = await w.client.view(ACCOUNT);
    expect(r).toEqual({
      ok: true,
      data: {
        open: true,
        state: {stage: 0, priceTicks: 1501n, nextPriceTicks: 1723n, stageSoldBase: 1_312_240_123_017_711n, stageCapBase: 10_240_000_000_000_000n, raisedCents: 19_696_720n},
        limits: {minCents: 1000n, maxTxCents: 5_000_000n, userRemainingCents: 20_000_000n, firstPurchase: true},
        allocation: {exists: false, totalBase: 0n, bonusBase: 0n},
        balances: {SOL: 5_000_000_000n, USDC: {largest: 50_000_000n, total: 50_000_000n}, USDT: {largest: 0n, total: 0n}},
        solUsdMicros: 198_420_000n,
        countryCode: 'SI',
        pending: null,
      },
    });
    expect(await w.client.view(ACCOUNT, 'gate')).toMatchObject({ok: true, data: {open: true}});
    expect(w.sent).toEqual([
      {type: 'presale.view', account: ACCOUNT},
      {type: 'presale.view', account: ACCOUNT, refresh: 'gate'},
    ]);
  });

  it('view: the closed variants — inactive with its stage, geo with the gate’s answer and the stage, unavailable with its code', async () => {
    expect(await (await wired({chain: {config: program(configData({active: 0}))}})).client.view(ACCOUNT)).toMatchObject({ok: true, data: {open: false, why: 'inactive', state: {stage: 0, priceTicks: 1501n}, pending: null}});
    expect(await (await wired({geo: {open: false, reason: 'sanctioned', countryCode: 'KP'}})).client.view(ACCOUNT)).toMatchObject({
      ok: true,
      data: {open: false, why: 'geo', geo: {open: false, reason: 'sanctioned', countryCode: 'KP'}, state: {stage: 0}},
    });
    expect(await (await wired({chain: {config: null}})).client.view(ACCOUNT)).toEqual({ok: true, data: {open: false, why: 'unavailable', code: 'malformed', pending: null}});
  });

  it('view: an open purchase record rides in every variant, its data as stored', async () => {
    const w = await wired({chain: {config: null}});
    await w.ext.local.set(PENDING_KEY, [pendingRecord({id: 'b1', account: ACCOUNT, signature: SIGNATURE, intent: null, extra: {kind: 'presale-buy', data: DATA}})]);
    const r = await w.client.view(ACCOUNT);
    expect(r).toMatchObject({ok: true, data: {why: 'unavailable', pending: {id: 'b1', intent: null, extra: {kind: 'presale-buy', data: DATA}}}});
    expect(await w.client.pending(ACCOUNT)).toMatchObject({ok: true, data: {id: 'b1'}});
  });

  it('quote: amounts as bigint; MAX sent as "max"; stale before any view', async () => {
    const w = await wired();
    expect(await w.client.quote(ACCOUNT, 'USDC', 25_000_000n)).toEqual({ok: true, data: 'stale'});
    await w.client.view(ACCOUNT);
    expect(await w.client.quote(ACCOUNT, 'USDC', 25_000_000n)).toEqual({ok: true, data: {amount: 25_000_000n, cents: 2500n, nocBase: 166_555_629_580n, line: null}});
    expect(await w.client.quote(ACCOUNT, 'USDC', 'max')).toMatchObject({ok: true, data: {amount: 50_000_000n, line: null}});
    expect(await w.client.quote(ACCOUNT, 'SOL', 1n)).toMatchObject({ok: true, data: {line: 'below-min'}});
    expect(w.sent.slice(-2)).toEqual([
      {type: 'presale.quote', account: ACCOUNT, currency: 'USDC', amount: 'max'},
      {type: 'presale.quote', account: ACCOUNT, currency: 'SOL', amount: '1'},
    ]);
  });

  it('refusals come through typed: locked, unknown-account; prepareBuy’s own codes (a listed refusal)', async () => {
    const w = await wired();
    expect(await w.client.view(HOLDING_LARGE)).toEqual({ok: false, error: 'unknown-account'});
    expect(await w.client.prepareBuy(ACCOUNT, {currency: 'USDC', amount: 1n, stage: 0})).toEqual({ok: false, error: 'below-min'});
    expect(w.sent.at(-1)).toEqual({type: 'presale.prepareBuy', account: ACCOUNT, intent: {currency: 'USDC', amount: '1', stage: 0}});
    expect(PREPARE_REFUSALS).toContain('presale-busy');
    const locked = await wired();
    await locked.ext.session.clear();
    expect(await locked.client.view(ACCOUNT)).toEqual({ok: false, error: 'locked'});
  });
});

describe('the shape checks: anything else the background did not promise is failed', () => {
  it('view: an extra key anywhere, a stage outside 0–9, a zero price or cap, a zero SOL price, a geo answer open with a reason or a geo variant that is open, a record that is not a purchase', async () => {
    const open = await raw({type: 'presale.view', account: ACCOUNT});
    expect(presaleViewOf(open)).toBeDefined();
    const state = open.state as Record<string, unknown>;
    const bad: unknown[] = [
      {...open, extra: 1},
      {...open, state: {...state, extra: 1}},
      {...open, state: {...state, stage: 10}},
      {...open, state: {...state, priceTicks: '0'}},
      {...open, state: {...state, stageCapBase: '0'}},
      {...open, state: {...state, raisedCents: 196_967}},
      {...open, solUsdMicros: '0'},
      // D22: the gate's country as the gate gives it — two capital letters or null, and the key always there.
      {...open, countryCode: 'si'},
      {...open, countryCode: 'SVN'},
      {...open, countryCode: 386},
      Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(open).filter(([k]) => k !== 'countryCode')),
      {...open, limits: {...(open.limits as object), firstPurchase: 'yes'}},
      {...open, balances: {...(open.balances as object), USDC: {largest: '2', total: '1'}}},
      {...open, pending: pendingRecord({intent: null, signature: SIGNATURE, account: ACCOUNT, extra: {kind: 'other-kind', data: null}})},
      {...open, pending: pendingRecord({signature: SIGNATURE, account: ACCOUNT, intent: {token: 'SOL', recipient: TREASURY_ADDRESS, amount: '1'}})},
      {...open, open: 'yes'},
    ];
    for (const b of bad) expect([b, presaleViewOf(b)]).toEqual([b, undefined]);
    expect(presaleViewOf({...open, countryCode: null})).toMatchObject({open: true, countryCode: null});
    const geo = await raw({type: 'presale.view', account: ACCOUNT}, {geo: {open: false, reason: 'stale_list', countryCode: 'SI'}});
    expect(presaleViewOf(geo)).toBeDefined();
    for (const g of [{open: true, reason: 'stale_list', countryCode: 'SI'}, {open: false, reason: null, countryCode: 'SI'}, {open: false, reason: 'elsewhere', countryCode: null}, {open: false, reason: 'no_check', countryCode: 'si'}, {open: true, reason: null, countryCode: null}]) {
      expect([g, presaleViewOf({...geo, geo: g})]).toEqual([g, undefined]);
    }
    expect(presaleViewOf({open: false, why: 'unavailable', code: 'exploded', pending: null})).toBeUndefined();
    expect(presaleViewOf({open: false, why: 'closed', pending: null})).toBeUndefined();
    expect(presaleViewOf({open: false, why: 'unavailable', code: 'refused'})).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('quote: an estimate is missing exactly with no-sol-price; an unknown line; a float; stale only as {stale: true}', () => {
    expect(quoteOf({amount: '1', cents: '1', nocBase: '1', line: null})).toEqual({amount: 1n, cents: 1n, nocBase: 1n, line: null});
    expect(quoteOf({amount: '1', cents: null, nocBase: null, line: 'no-sol-price'})).toEqual({amount: 1n, cents: null, nocBase: null, line: 'no-sol-price'});
    expect(quoteOf({stale: true})).toBe('stale');
    for (const b of [
      {amount: '1', cents: null, nocBase: null, line: null},
      {amount: '1', cents: '1', nocBase: null, line: 'no-sol-price'},
      {amount: '1', cents: '1', nocBase: '1', line: 'no-sol-price'},
      {amount: '1', cents: '1', nocBase: '1', line: 'too-much'},
      {amount: 1, cents: '1', nocBase: '1', line: null},
      {amount: '1', cents: '1', nocBase: '1', line: null, extra: 1},
      {stale: false},
    ]) {
      expect([b, quoteOf(b)]).toEqual([b, undefined]);
    }
  });

  it('a purchase record’s data (§2.3): the eight strings; a stage outside 0–9, a non-address, an extra key are refused', () => {
    expect(purchaseDataOf(DATA)).toEqual({currency: 'USDC', amount: 25_000_000n, stage: 0, priceTicks: 1501n, nocBase: 166_555_629_580n, spentCents: 2500n, destination: TREASURY_ADDRESS, referrer: null});
    for (const b of [{...DATA, stage: '10'}, {...DATA, stage: 0}, {...DATA, currency: 'NOC'}, {...DATA, destination: 'D'}, {...DATA, referrer: 'x'}, {...DATA, extra: 1}, {...DATA, amount: '-1'}]) {
      expect([b, purchaseDataOf(b)]).toEqual([b, undefined]);
    }
  });

  it('a prepared purchase: the programs exactly compute-budget and presale; a bad id, a reason unknown, a fee not a string are refused', () => {
    const good = {
      id: 'ab'.repeat(16),
      currency: 'SOL',
      amount: '2000000000',
      stage: 0,
      priceTicks: '1501',
      nocBase: '2643837441705',
      spentCents: '39684',
      destination: TREASURY_ADDRESS,
      referrer: null,
      fees: {networkLamports: '5000', priorityLamports: '6000', rentLamports: '2189480'},
      reauth: {challengeId: 'cd'.repeat(16), reasons: ['first-purchase'], proven: false},
      validUntil: 1_000,
      simulation: {slot: 1, elapsedMs: 2, programs: ['compute-budget', 'presale'], instructionCount: 3},
    };
    expect(purchaseViewOf(good)).toMatchObject({amount: 2_000_000_000n, fees: {rentLamports: 2_189_480n}, reauth: {reasons: ['first-purchase']}});
    for (const b of [
      {...good, id: 'AB'.repeat(16)},
      {...good, simulation: {...good.simulation, programs: ['presale', 'compute-budget']}},
      {...good, simulation: {...good.simulation, programs: ['compute-budget', 'presale', 'system']}},
      {...good, reauth: {...good.reauth, reasons: ['first-send']}},
      {...good, fees: {...good.fees, networkLamports: 5000}},
      {...good, stage: 10},
    ]) {
      expect(purchaseViewOf(b)).toBeUndefined();
    }
  });
});
```

```ts
import {pendingOf, type Engine, type Pending, type Reply} from '../engine';

/**
 * B1d §1.4, §2.5, §3.2, §3.3: the popup's client for the presale messages #23 asks — through the shared engine's
 * transport (`Engine.request`), so shared code names none of them. Every reply is shape-checked here before #23 sees
 * it, as engine.ts checks its own: amounts are decimal strings of bigints and become bigint, enums are known, addresses
 * are base58; a reply of any other shape is `failed`. The popup renders what these answer and decides nothing (C3).
 */

export type PresaleCurrency = 'SOL' | 'USDC' | 'USDT';
export const PRESALE_CURRENCIES: readonly PresaleCurrency[] = ['SOL', 'USDC', 'USDT'];
export type GeoReason = 'refused' | 'no_check' | 'stale_list' | 'unknown_country' | 'sanctioned';
export interface GeoAnswer {
  open: boolean;
  reason: GeoReason | null;
  countryCode: string | null;
}
/** §2.5. `stage` is the program's 0-indexed stage (display adds 1). */
export interface StageView {
  stage: number;
  priceTicks: bigint;
  nextPriceTicks: bigint | null;
  stageSoldBase: bigint;
  stageCapBase: bigint;
  raisedCents: bigint;
}
export interface PresaleBalances {
  SOL: bigint;
  USDC: {largest: bigint; total: bigint};
  USDT: {largest: bigint; total: bigint};
}
export type PresaleView =
  | {open: false; why: 'unavailable'; code: 'read-failed' | 'refused' | 'malformed'; pending: Pending | null}
  | {open: false; why: 'inactive' | 'blocked'; state: StageView; pending: Pending | null}
  | {open: false; why: 'geo'; geo: GeoAnswer; state: StageView | null; pending: Pending | null}
  | {
      open: true;
      state: StageView;
      limits: {minCents: bigint; maxTxCents: bigint; userRemainingCents: bigint; firstPurchase: boolean};
      allocation: {exists: boolean; totalBase: bigint; bonusBase: bigint};
      balances: PresaleBalances;
      solUsdMicros: bigint | null;
      /** The country the gate detected (D22), or null when it named none. */
      countryCode: string | null;
      pending: Pending | null;
    };
export type LimitLine = 'below-min' | 'above-max-tx' | 'above-user-limit';
export type BalanceLine = 'insufficient-sol' | 'insufficient-token' | 'split-balance' | 'sender-below-rent';
export type QuoteLine = LimitLine | BalanceLine | 'no-sol-price';
/** §3.2: `cents` and `nocBase` are null only with `no-sol-price`. */
export interface Quote {
  amount: bigint;
  cents: bigint | null;
  nocBase: bigint | null;
  line: QuoteLine | null;
}
export type PresaleReauthReason = 'first-purchase' | 'over-5-percent' | 'over-usd-threshold';
/** §3.3 step 7. */
export interface PurchaseView {
  id: string;
  currency: PresaleCurrency;
  amount: bigint;
  stage: number;
  priceTicks: bigint;
  nocBase: bigint;
  spentCents: bigint;
  destination: string;
  referrer: {address: string; registers: boolean} | null;
  fees: {networkLamports: bigint; priorityLamports: bigint; rentLamports: bigint};
  reauth: {challengeId: string; reasons: PresaleReauthReason[]; proven: boolean} | null;
  validUntil: number;
  simulation: {slot: number; elapsedMs: number; programs: ['compute-budget', 'presale']; instructionCount: number};
}
/** §2.3: what a purchase record carries for display — every value as the background stored it, never used to decide. */
export interface PurchaseData {
  currency: PresaleCurrency;
  amount: bigint;
  stage: number;
  priceTicks: bigint;
  nocBase: bigint;
  spentCents: bigint;
  destination: string;
  referrer: string | null;
}

/** The refusals of presale.prepareBuy (§5) the popup translates; anything else is `failed`. */
export const PREPARE_REFUSALS = [
  'malformed',
  'locked',
  'unknown-account',
  'in-flight',
  'presale-unavailable',
  'coordinator-refused',
  'unreachable',
  'presale-closed',
  'blocked',
  'geo-closed',
  'price-changed',
  'state-changed',
  'below-min',
  'above-max-tx',
  'above-user-limit',
  'above-limit',
  'insufficient-sol',
  'insufficient-token',
  'split-balance',
  'sender-below-rent',
  'no-sol-price',
  'simulation-failed',
  'simulation-mismatch',
  'presale-busy',
] as const;
export type PrepareRefusal = (typeof PREPARE_REFUSALS)[number];
const SESSION = ['malformed', 'locked', 'unknown-account', 'unavailable'] as const;
type SessionRefusal = (typeof SESSION)[number];

export interface PresaleClient {
  view(account: string, refresh?: 'gate'): Promise<Reply<PresaleView, SessionRefusal>>;
  /** `stale`: the account's last view is older than the quote's 30 s (§1.4) — ask a view, then again. */
  quote(account: string, currency: PresaleCurrency, amount: bigint | 'max'): Promise<Reply<Quote | 'stale', SessionRefusal>>;
  pending(account: string): Promise<Reply<Pending | null, SessionRefusal>>;
  prepareBuy(account: string, intent: {currency: PresaleCurrency; amount: bigint; stage: number}): Promise<Reply<PurchaseView, PrepareRefusal>>;
}

type J = Record<string, unknown>;
const obj = (x: unknown): J | undefined => (typeof x === 'object' && x !== null && !Array.isArray(x) ? (x as J) : undefined);
const UNITS = /^\d{1,20}$/;
const ADDRESS = /^[1-9A-HJ-NP-Za-km-z]{32,44}$/;
const HEX32 = /^[0-9a-f]{32}$/;
const units = (x: unknown): bigint | undefined => (typeof x === 'string' && UNITS.test(x) ? BigInt(x) : undefined);
const isInt = (x: unknown): x is number => typeof x === 'number' && Number.isSafeInteger(x) && x >= 0;
const isStage = (x: unknown): x is number => isInt(x) && x <= 9;
const isAddress = (x: unknown): x is string => typeof x === 'string' && ADDRESS.test(x);
const isCurrency = (x: unknown): x is PresaleCurrency => typeof x === 'string' && (PRESALE_CURRENCIES as readonly string[]).includes(x);
const oneOf = <T extends string>(x: unknown, values: readonly T[]): T | undefined => (typeof x === 'string' && (values as readonly string[]).includes(x) ? (x as T) : undefined);
/** Exactly these keys: a reply that carries more than the background promised is not this shape. */
const exactly = (o: J, keys: readonly string[]): boolean => Object.keys(o).length === keys.length && keys.every(k => k in o);

function stageOf(x: unknown): StageView | undefined {
  const o = obj(x);
  if (o === undefined || !exactly(o, ['stage', 'priceTicks', 'nextPriceTicks', 'stageSoldBase', 'stageCapBase', 'raisedCents']) || !isStage(o.stage)) return undefined;
  const [priceTicks, stageSoldBase, stageCapBase, raisedCents] = [units(o.priceTicks), units(o.stageSoldBase), units(o.stageCapBase), units(o.raisedCents)];
  const nextPriceTicks = o.nextPriceTicks === null ? null : units(o.nextPriceTicks);
  if (priceTicks === undefined || priceTicks === 0n || stageSoldBase === undefined || stageCapBase === undefined || stageCapBase === 0n || raisedCents === undefined || nextPriceTicks === undefined) return undefined;
  return {stage: o.stage, priceTicks, nextPriceTicks, stageSoldBase, stageCapBase, raisedCents};
}

const GEO_REASONS = ['refused', 'no_check', 'stale_list', 'unknown_country', 'sanctioned'] as const;
/** A country code as the gate gives one: two capital letters, or null. */
const countryOf = (x: unknown): string | null | undefined => (x === null ? null : typeof x === 'string' && /^[A-Z]{2}$/.test(x) ? x : undefined);

function geoOf(x: unknown): GeoAnswer | undefined {
  const o = obj(x);
  if (o === undefined || !exactly(o, ['open', 'reason', 'countryCode']) || typeof o.open !== 'boolean') return undefined;
  const reason = o.reason === null ? null : oneOf(o.reason, GEO_REASONS);
  const countryCode = countryOf(o.countryCode);
  // Open exactly when there is no reason (gate.ts): any other pairing is not an answer the gate gives.
  if (reason === undefined || countryCode === undefined || o.open !== (reason === null)) return undefined;
  return {open: o.open, reason, countryCode};
}

function pair(x: unknown): {largest: bigint; total: bigint} | undefined {
  const o = obj(x);
  const [largest, total] = [units(o?.largest), units(o?.total)];
  return o === undefined || !exactly(o, ['largest', 'total']) || largest === undefined || total === undefined || largest > total ? undefined : {largest, total};
}

/** The kind of a purchase record (§2.3). */
export const PURCHASE_KIND = 'presale-buy';

/** The open purchase record a view carries (C30): null, or a record of this kind. */
function pendingIn(x: unknown): Pending | null | undefined {
  if (x === null) return null;
  const p = pendingOf(x);
  return p === undefined || p.intent !== null || p.extra?.kind !== PURCHASE_KIND ? undefined : p;
}

export function presaleViewOf(x: unknown): PresaleView | undefined {
  const o = obj(x);
  if (o === undefined || !('pending' in o)) return undefined;
  const pending = pendingIn(o.pending);
  if (pending === undefined) return undefined;
  if (o.open === true) {
    if (!exactly(o, ['open', 'state', 'limits', 'allocation', 'balances', 'solUsdMicros', 'countryCode', 'pending'])) return undefined;
    const state = stageOf(o.state);
    const l = obj(o.limits);
    const a = obj(o.allocation);
    const b = obj(o.balances);
    if (state === undefined || l === undefined || a === undefined || b === undefined || !exactly(l, ['minCents', 'maxTxCents', 'userRemainingCents', 'firstPurchase']) || !exactly(a, ['exists', 'totalBase', 'bonusBase']) || !exactly(b, ['SOL', 'USDC', 'USDT'])) return undefined;
    const [minCents, maxTxCents, userRemainingCents] = [units(l.minCents), units(l.maxTxCents), units(l.userRemainingCents)];
    const [totalBase, bonusBase, sol] = [units(a.totalBase), units(a.bonusBase), units(b.SOL)];
    const [usdc, usdt] = [pair(b.USDC), pair(b.USDT)];
    const solUsdMicros = o.solUsdMicros === null ? null : units(o.solUsdMicros);
    const countryCode = countryOf(o.countryCode);
    if (minCents === undefined || maxTxCents === undefined || userRemainingCents === undefined || typeof l.firstPurchase !== 'boolean') return undefined;
    if (typeof a.exists !== 'boolean' || totalBase === undefined || bonusBase === undefined || sol === undefined || usdc === undefined || usdt === undefined || solUsdMicros === undefined || solUsdMicros === 0n || countryCode === undefined) return undefined;
    return {
      open: true,
      state,
      limits: {minCents, maxTxCents, userRemainingCents, firstPurchase: l.firstPurchase},
      allocation: {exists: a.exists, totalBase, bonusBase},
      balances: {SOL: sol, USDC: usdc, USDT: usdt},
      solUsdMicros,
      countryCode,
      pending,
    };
  }
  if (o.open !== false) return undefined;
  if (o.why === 'unavailable') {
    const code = oneOf(o.code, ['read-failed', 'refused', 'malformed'] as const);
    return exactly(o, ['open', 'why', 'code', 'pending']) && code !== undefined ? {open: false, why: 'unavailable', code, pending} : undefined;
  }
  if (o.why === 'inactive' || o.why === 'blocked') {
    const state = stageOf(o.state);
    return exactly(o, ['open', 'why', 'state', 'pending']) && state !== undefined ? {open: false, why: o.why, state, pending} : undefined;
  }
  if (o.why === 'geo') {
    const geo = geoOf(o.geo);
    const state = o.state === null ? null : stageOf(o.state);
    return exactly(o, ['open', 'why', 'geo', 'state', 'pending']) && geo !== undefined && !geo.open && state !== undefined ? {open: false, why: 'geo', geo, state, pending} : undefined;
  }
  return undefined;
}

const LINES = ['below-min', 'above-max-tx', 'above-user-limit', 'insufficient-sol', 'insufficient-token', 'split-balance', 'sender-below-rent', 'no-sol-price'] as const;
export function quoteOf(x: unknown): Quote | 'stale' | undefined {
  const o = obj(x);
  if (o === undefined) return undefined;
  if (exactly(o, ['stale'])) return o.stale === true ? 'stale' : undefined;
  if (!exactly(o, ['amount', 'cents', 'nocBase', 'line'])) return undefined;
  const amount = units(o.amount);
  const line = o.line === null ? null : oneOf(o.line, LINES);
  const cents = o.cents === null ? null : units(o.cents);
  const nocBase = o.nocBase === null ? null : units(o.nocBase);
  if (amount === undefined || line === undefined || cents === undefined || nocBase === undefined) return undefined;
  // §3.2: no estimate only without a SOL price, and then never one.
  if ((cents === null || nocBase === null) !== (line === 'no-sol-price') || (cents === null) !== (nocBase === null)) return undefined;
  return {amount, cents, nocBase, line};
}

export function purchaseDataOf(x: unknown): PurchaseData | undefined {
  const o = obj(x);
  if (o === undefined || !exactly(o, ['currency', 'amount', 'stage', 'priceTicks', 'nocBase', 'spentCents', 'destination', 'referrer']) || !isCurrency(o.currency)) return undefined;
  const [amount, stage, priceTicks, nocBase, spentCents] = [units(o.amount), units(o.stage), units(o.priceTicks), units(o.nocBase), units(o.spentCents)];
  const referrer = o.referrer === null ? null : isAddress(o.referrer) ? o.referrer : undefined;
  if (amount === undefined || stage === undefined || stage > 9n || priceTicks === undefined || nocBase === undefined || spentCents === undefined || !isAddress(o.destination) || referrer === undefined) return undefined;
  return {currency: o.currency, amount, stage: Number(stage), priceTicks, nocBase, spentCents, destination: o.destination, referrer};
}

const REASONS = ['first-purchase', 'over-5-percent', 'over-usd-threshold'] as const;
export function purchaseViewOf(x: unknown): PurchaseView | undefined {
  const o = obj(x);
  const f = obj(o?.fees);
  const s = obj(o?.simulation);
  if (o === undefined || f === undefined || s === undefined || typeof o.id !== 'string' || !HEX32.test(o.id) || !isCurrency(o.currency) || !isStage(o.stage) || !isAddress(o.destination) || !isInt(o.validUntil)) return undefined;
  const [amount, priceTicks, nocBase, spentCents] = [units(o.amount), units(o.priceTicks), units(o.nocBase), units(o.spentCents)];
  const [networkLamports, priorityLamports, rentLamports] = [units(f.networkLamports), units(f.priorityLamports), units(f.rentLamports)];
  if (amount === undefined || priceTicks === undefined || nocBase === undefined || spentCents === undefined || networkLamports === undefined || priorityLamports === undefined || rentLamports === undefined) return undefined;
  const programs = s.programs;
  if (!isInt(s.slot) || !isInt(s.elapsedMs) || !isInt(s.instructionCount) || !Array.isArray(programs) || programs.length !== 2 || programs[0] !== 'compute-budget' || programs[1] !== 'presale') return undefined;
  let referrer: PurchaseView['referrer'] = null;
  if (o.referrer !== null) {
    const r = obj(o.referrer);
    if (r === undefined || !isAddress(r.address) || typeof r.registers !== 'boolean') return undefined;
    referrer = {address: r.address, registers: r.registers};
  }
  let reauth: PurchaseView['reauth'] = null;
  if (o.reauth !== null) {
    const r = obj(o.reauth);
    const reasons: PresaleReauthReason[] = [];
    if (r === undefined || typeof r.challengeId !== 'string' || !HEX32.test(r.challengeId) || typeof r.proven !== 'boolean' || !Array.isArray(r.reasons)) return undefined;
    for (const v of r.reasons as unknown[]) {
      const reason = oneOf(v, REASONS);
      if (reason === undefined) return undefined;
      reasons.push(reason);
    }
    reauth = {challengeId: r.challengeId, reasons, proven: r.proven};
  }
  return {
    id: o.id,
    currency: o.currency,
    amount,
    stage: o.stage,
    priceTicks,
    nocBase,
    spentCents,
    destination: o.destination,
    referrer,
    fees: {networkLamports, priorityLamports, rentLamports},
    reauth,
    validUntil: o.validUntil,
    simulation: {slot: s.slot, elapsedMs: s.elapsedMs, programs: ['compute-budget', 'presale'], instructionCount: s.instructionCount},
  };
}

export function presaleClient(engine: Engine): PresaleClient {
  return {
    view: (account, refresh) => engine.request({type: 'presale.view', account, ...(refresh === undefined ? {} : {refresh})}, SESSION, presaleViewOf),
    quote: (account, currency, amount) => engine.request({type: 'presale.quote', account, currency, amount: amount === 'max' ? 'max' : amount.toString()}, SESSION, quoteOf),
    pending: (account: string) => engine.request({type: 'presale.pending', account}, SESSION, x => (x === null ? null : pendingIn(x))),
    prepareBuy: (account, intent) =>
      engine.request({type: 'presale.prepareBuy', account, intent: {currency: intent.currency, amount: intent.amount.toString(), stage: intent.stage}}, PREPARE_REFUSALS, purchaseViewOf),
  };
}
```

```ts
import {formatAmount} from '../../shared/amount';
import type {GeoReason, PresaleCurrency} from './client';

/**
 * #23's strings (B1d §4.1, §10 — controller copy, owner-delegated 2026-10-19; the design's own where §4.1 keeps it) and
 * its number formats. Integer arithmetic on what the background answered, every division floored (cardinal rule 2):
 * the popup formats, it never prices, limits or estimates.
 */
export const PRESALE_TEXT = {
  title: 'NOC presale',
  liveEyebrow: (stage: number): string => `Stage ${stage} of 10 · live`,
  closedEyebrow: (stage: number): string => `Stage ${stage} of 10`,
  perNoc: '/ NOC',
  raised: ' raised',
  /** Q01's words after the cap ("10.24 M NOC stage cap"). */
  stageCap: ' stage cap',
  nextStage: 'Next stage ',
  youPay: 'YOU PAY',
  available: 'Available ',
  youReceive: 'YOU RECEIVE (EST.)',
  /** Q02 / Q03. */
  receiveSol: (price: string, sol: string): string => `@ ${price} · 1 SOL ≈ ${sol}`,
  receiveStable: (price: string): string => `@ ${price}`,
  /** Q04, and D5's only TGE copy. */
  allocation: 'Your allocation',
  claimable: 'Claimable after TGE',
  region: 'Not available in your region?',
  buy: (estimate: string): string => `Buy ${estimate} NOC`,
  buyPlain: 'Buy NOC',
  max: 'MAX',
  currency: (c: PresaleCurrency): string => `Currency: ${c}`,
  orderPending: 'Order pending',
  /** Q05. */
  waiting: 'Waiting for confirmation. Claimable after TGE.',
  paid: 'Paid',
  estimated: 'Estimated NOC',
  stage: 'Stage',
  stageRow: (stage: number, price: string): string => `Stage ${stage} of 10 · @ ${price}`,
  txHash: 'Tx hash',
  /** Q06. */
  closeNote: 'You can close the popup — Noctura keeps watching this purchase. Funds are non-refundable per presale terms.',
  explorer: 'View on Solana explorer',
  done: 'Done',
  /** Q11–Q16, Q19, Q43, Q52. */
  unavailable: 'Presale unavailable — try again later.',
  refused: 'The presale service refused this network.',
  inactive: 'The presale is not open.',
  blocked: "This account can't buy in the presale.",
  priceChanged: 'Price changed — review again',
  notSimulated: 'The purchase could not be simulated.',
  noSolPrice: 'SOL price unavailable — pay with USDC or USDT, or try again later.',
  accountChanged: 'Your presale account changed — review again',
  busy: 'The presale is busy right now — try again.',
  /** Q40 a–c. */
  belowMin: (min: string): string => `Minimum ${min}`,
  aboveMaxTx: (max: string): string => `Maximum ${max} per transaction`,
  aboveUser: (remaining: string): string => `Above your presale limit — you can buy up to ${remaining} more`,
  /** Q41 a–d. */
  insufficient: (c: PresaleCurrency): string => `Insufficient ${c} balance`,
  feeSol: 'Need a little SOL for the network fee',
  split: (c: PresaleCurrency, most: string): string => `Your ${c} is split across accounts — at most ${most} ${c} in one purchase`,
  keepRent: 'Keep at least 0.00089088 SOL, or buy with less',
  /** §4.1's closed line for a region answer, "Not available here — <reason>" (the reason in #50b's own words, §4.3). */
  regionLine: (reason: string): string => `Not available here — ${reason}`,
} as const;

/** The reason of a closed region answer, as #50b's sub says it (§4.3; for `sanctioned`, Q21's first sentence). */
export const GEO_REASON_TEXT: Record<GeoReason, string> = {
  sanctioned: "This wallet doesn't offer the presale in your region.",
  stale_list: 'The restricted-region list is out of date.',
  unknown_country: 'Your region could not be determined from your IP.',
  no_check: 'The region check is unavailable — try again later.',
  refused: 'The presale service refused this network.',
};

const group = (v: bigint): string => v.toString().replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ',');

/** The program's price, ten-thousandths of a dollar, to its four places: "$ 0.1501". */
export const priceText = (ticks: bigint): string => `$ ${formatAmount(ticks, 4, {min: 4, max: 4})}`;

/** §4.1's raised figure, floored: "$ 1.55 M" from a million dollars on, "$ 12,345" below. */
export function raisedText(cents: bigint): string {
  const dollars = cents / 100n;
  return dollars >= 1_000_000n ? `$ ${formatAmount(dollars / 10_000n, 2, {min: 2, max: 2})} M` : `$ ${group(dollars)}`;
}

/** A NOC amount in millions, floored: "10.24 M NOC" (Q01's cap). */
export const millionsNoc = (base: bigint): string => `${formatAmount(base / 10n ** 13n, 2, {min: 2, max: 2})} M NOC`;

/** A limit in dollars, as core's lines write it: "$10", "$50,000", "$199,700.50" — whole dollars without cents. */
export const dollarsText = (cents: bigint): string => (cents % 100n === 0n ? `$${group(cents / 100n)}` : `$${formatAmount(cents, 2, {min: 2, max: 2})}`);

/** USD per SOL from the view's micro-dollars, floored to the cent: "$ 198.42". */
export const solPriceText = (micros: bigint): string => `$ ${formatAmount(micros / 10_000n, 2, {min: 2, max: 2})}`;

/** The stage bar's fill, a CSS width: sold / cap, floored to a hundredth of a percent, at most 100 %. */
export function fillWidth(sold: bigint, cap: bigint): string {
  const bp = (sold * 10_000n) / cap;
  const clamped = bp > 10_000n ? 10_000n : bp;
  return `${formatAmount(clamped, 2, {min: 0, max: 2})}%`;
}

/** 23b's Tx hash as drawn: the first 4 and the last 6 characters ("5x9k…u3Dj2P"). */
export const shortSignature = (signature: string): string => `${signature.slice(0, 4)}…${signature.slice(-6)}`;
```

```tsx
import {useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState} from 'react';
import {useWallet} from '../WalletContext';
import {parseAmount} from '../../shared/amount';
import {TOKEN_INFO, showAmount} from '../format';
import {plainAmount} from '../send/rules';
import {TopBar} from '../ui/TopBar';
import {ExtIcon} from '../ui/ExtIcon';
import {Banner} from '../ui/Banner';
import {LockedButton} from '../ui/LockedButton';
import {SkelLine} from '../ui/Skeleton';
import {TokenSheet} from '../screens/TokenSheet';
import {ExplorerLink} from '../screens/TxDetail';
import {SEND_TEXT} from '../screens/Send';
import type {Pending, Reply, Token} from '../engine';
import {
  PRESALE_CURRENCIES,
  presaleClient,
  purchaseDataOf,
  type PrepareRefusal,
  type PresaleCurrency,
  type PresaleView,
  type PurchaseView,
  type Quote,
  type QuoteLine,
  type StageView,
} from './client';
import {GEO_REASON_TEXT, PRESALE_TEXT, dollarsText, fillWidth, millionsNoc, priceText, raisedText, shortSignature, solPriceText} from './text';

/** C35: #23a re-reads the snapshot and the gate this often while it is visible. */
export const REREAD_MS = 25_000;
/** §4.1: 23b reads its record (no network) this often, the design's interval. */
export const PENDING_POLL_MS = 6_000;
/** §4.1: typing asks a quote this long after the last keystroke. */
export const QUOTE_DEBOUNCE_MS = 250;

type ViewReply = Reply<PresaleView, 'malformed' | 'locked' | 'unknown-account' | 'unavailable'>;
type OpenView = Extract<PresaleView, {open: true}>;
/** A line under the amount (§3.2, §5): a quote's own, or a prepare's limit and balance refusals. */
type Line = QuoteLine | 'above-limit';
const LINES: readonly string[] = ['below-min', 'above-max-tx', 'above-user-limit', 'above-limit', 'insufficient-sol', 'insufficient-token', 'split-balance', 'sender-below-rent', 'no-sol-price'];
const isLine = (code: string): code is Line => LINES.includes(code);

const visible = (): boolean => typeof document === 'undefined' || document.visibilityState === 'visible';

/** The words of a line (Q19, Q40 a–c, Q41 a–d) for the background's code, from the view's own numbers. */
function lineText(line: Line, currency: PresaleCurrency, v: OpenView): string {
  switch (line) {
    case 'below-min':
      return PRESALE_TEXT.belowMin(dollarsText(v.limits.minCents));
    case 'above-max-tx':
    case 'above-limit':
      return PRESALE_TEXT.aboveMaxTx(dollarsText(v.limits.maxTxCents));
    case 'above-user-limit':
      return PRESALE_TEXT.aboveUser(dollarsText(v.limits.userRemainingCents));
    case 'insufficient-sol':
      return currency === 'SOL' ? PRESALE_TEXT.insufficient('SOL') : PRESALE_TEXT.feeSol;
    case 'insufficient-token':
      return PRESALE_TEXT.insufficient(currency);
    case 'split-balance':
      return PRESALE_TEXT.split(currency, showAmount(currency, currency === 'SOL' ? v.balances.SOL : v.balances[currency].largest));
    case 'sender-below-rent':
      return PRESALE_TEXT.keepRent;
    case 'no-sol-price':
      return PRESALE_TEXT.noSolPrice;
  }
}

/** A prepare refusal that is not a line: the notice it shows (null: none), and whether the view is read again. */
function refusalOf(code: PrepareRefusal | 'failed'): {notice: string | null; reread: boolean} {
  switch (code) {
    case 'price-changed':
      return {notice: PRESALE_TEXT.priceChanged, reread: true};
    case 'state-changed':
      return {notice: PRESALE_TEXT.accountChanged, reread: true};
    case 'simulation-failed':
    case 'simulation-mismatch':
      return {notice: PRESALE_TEXT.notSimulated, reread: false};
    case 'presale-busy':
      return {notice: PRESALE_TEXT.busy, reread: false};
    case 'coordinator-refused':
      return {notice: PRESALE_TEXT.refused, reread: false};
    case 'presale-closed':
      return {notice: PRESALE_TEXT.inactive, reread: true};
    case 'blocked':
      return {notice: PRESALE_TEXT.blocked, reread: true};
    // C10: a purchase in flight is 23b once the view is read again; a send in flight keeps #23a, with B1b's line.
    case 'in-flight':
      return {notice: SEND_TEXT.pending, reread: true};
    case 'geo-closed':
    case 'unknown-account':
      return {notice: null, reread: true};
    default:
      return {notice: PRESALE_TEXT.unavailable, reread: true};
  }
}

function StageCard({state, live}: {state: StageView; live: boolean}) {
  const n = state.stage + 1;
  return (
    <div className="stage-card">
      <span className="eyebrow noc-overline">
        <ExtIcon name="rocket" size={14} /> {live ? PRESALE_TEXT.liveEyebrow(n) : PRESALE_TEXT.closedEyebrow(n)}
      </span>
      <div className="price">
        <span className="noc-balance-lg noc-numeral">{priceText(state.priceTicks)}</span>
        <span className="unit noc-body-lg">{PRESALE_TEXT.perNoc}</span>
      </div>
      <div className="progress" aria-label="Presale progress">
        <i style={{width: fillWidth(state.stageSoldBase, state.stageCapBase)}} />
      </div>
      <div className="meta">
        <span className="noc-caption">
          <b>
            <span className="noc-numeral">{raisedText(state.raisedCents)}</span>
          </b>
          {PRESALE_TEXT.raised}
        </span>
        <span className="noc-caption">
          <b>
            <span className="noc-numeral">{millionsNoc(state.stageCapBase)}</span>
          </b>
          {PRESALE_TEXT.stageCap}
        </span>
      </div>
      {state.nextPriceTicks === null ? null : (
        <div className="meta app-pre-meta2">
          <span className="noc-caption">
            {PRESALE_TEXT.nextStage}
            <span className="noc-numeral">{priceText(state.nextPriceTicks)}</span>
          </span>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/** The closed line of an answer (§4.1): Q11 / Q12 / Q13 / Q14, or the region line; null when the answer is open. */
function closedLine(v: PresaleView): string | null {
  if (v.open) return null;
  if (v.why === 'unavailable') return v.code === 'refused' ? PRESALE_TEXT.refused : PRESALE_TEXT.unavailable;
  if (v.why === 'geo') return PRESALE_TEXT.regionLine(GEO_REASON_TEXT[v.geo.reason ?? 'no_check']);
  return v.why === 'inactive' ? PRESALE_TEXT.inactive : PRESALE_TEXT.blocked;
}

/** 23b (§4.1, C17, C30): the open purchase, from its record — never hidden; the answer's closed line beneath. */
function Pending23b({record, line}: {record: Pending; line: string | null}) {
  const data = record.extra === null ? undefined : purchaseDataOf(record.extra.data);
  return (
    <>
      <div className="pending-card">
        <div className="head">
          <div className="ring" aria-hidden="true" />
          <div className="copy">
            <h3 className="noc-h3">{PRESALE_TEXT.orderPending}</h3>
            <p className="noc-body-sm">{PRESALE_TEXT.waiting}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        {data === undefined ? null : (
          <>
            <div className="row">
              <span className="l noc-body-sm">{PRESALE_TEXT.paid}</span>
              <span className="r noc-body-lg noc-numeral">{`${showAmount(data.currency, data.amount)} ${data.currency}`}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="row">
              <span className="l noc-body-sm">{PRESALE_TEXT.estimated}</span>
              <span className="r noc-body-lg noc-numeral">{`${showAmount('NOC', data.nocBase)} NOC`}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="row">
              <span className="l noc-body-sm">{PRESALE_TEXT.stage}</span>
              <span className="r noc-body-sm">{PRESALE_TEXT.stageRow(data.stage + 1, priceText(data.priceTicks))}</span>
            </div>
          </>
        )}
        <div className="row">
          <span className="l noc-body-sm">{PRESALE_TEXT.txHash}</span>
          <span className="r mono noc-mono" title={record.signature}>
            {shortSignature(record.signature)}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
      {/* index.html #23b's info banner: one regular-weight line (B1b's Banner would set it as a semibold title). */}
      <div className="banner info" role="status">
        <ExtIcon name="info" size={16} />
        <div>
          <span className="noc-body-sm">{PRESALE_TEXT.closeNote}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      {line === null ? null : <Banner tone="warning" title={line} />}
      <ExplorerLink signature={record.signature} label={PRESALE_TEXT.explorer} icon={false} className="geo-link noc-body-sm" />
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * #23 presale (B1d §4.1; index.html #23 ix 10603-10902): 23a active, 23b pending and the allocation row. Everything it
 * shows is what the background answered — `presale.view`, `presale.quote`, `presale.pending` — formatted, never
 * computed: the estimate, MAX, the limit and balance lines and the stage are the background's (C3). Claim (23c) and
 * done (23d) are not built (D1): there is no on-chain source before TGE.
 *
 * Reads (C35): a full view on mount, on focus, on a currency change, when the screen becomes visible again and once
 * when 23b's record closes; while 23a is visible, the snapshot and the gate every 25 s (`refresh: 'gate'`, the balances
 * of the last full view kept); nothing while hidden. 23b reads only its record, every 6 s and on focus (no network).
 * Buy (rule 6, a LockedButton) hands the background's prepared purchase to `onPrepared`.
 */
export function Presale({
  onBack,
  onDone,
  onPrepared,
  onRegion,
}: {
  onBack: () => void;
  /** 23b's [Done] → #11. */
  onDone: () => void;
  /** §4.1: the purchase the background prepared — #20's purchase variant (`presale-confirm`, `flow`). */
  onPrepared: (account: string, view: PurchaseView) => void;
  /** C18: "Not available in your region?" → #50b. */
  onRegion: () => void;
}) {
  const m = useWallet();
  const account = m.account?.publicKey ?? null;
  const client = useMemo(() => presaleClient(m.engine), [m.engine]);
  const {reload, report} = m;
  const [view, setView] = useState<{account: string; reply: ViewReply} | null>(null);
  /** 23b's record as its own poll last read it, for the record the view showed. */
  const [polled, setPolled] = useState<{id: string; record: Pending} | null>(null);
  const [currency, setCurrency] = useState<PresaleCurrency>('SOL');
  const [text, setText] = useState('');
  /** The text MAX wrote: while the field still holds it, the quote asked is MAX's (`'max'`), not the number. */
  const [maxText, setMaxText] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [quoted, setQuoted] = useState<{key: string; quote: Quote | 'stale'} | null>(null);
  /** A prepare's line (§5: limit and balance codes), for the amount it was asked for. */
  const [refusal, setRefusal] = useState<{key: string; line: Line} | null>(null);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [sheet, setSheet] = useState(false);
  const [shown, setShown] = useState(visible);

  const generation = useRef(0);
  const read = useCallback(
    async (refresh?: 'gate') => {
      if (account === null) return;
      const mine = ++generation.current;
      const reply = await client.view(account, refresh);
      // A later read, or the screen gone: this answer is dropped (the newest read decides).
      if (generation.current !== mine) return;
      if (!reply.ok && reply.error === 'locked') {
        void reload();
        return;
      }
      if (reply.ok && !reply.data.open && reply.data.why === 'unavailable' && reply.data.code === 'refused') report('coordinator-refused');
      setView({account, reply});
    },
    [account, client, reload, report],
  );
  /** False once the screen is gone: a prepare that answers after it hands nothing on. */
  const alive = useRef(true);
  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
      generation.current += 1;
    };
  }, []);

  // A full view on mount, for another account, and on a currency change (C35).
  useEffect(() => {
    void read();
  }, [read, currency]);

  const current = view !== null && view.account === account && view.reply.ok ? view.reply.data : null;
  const failed = view !== null && view.account === account && !view.reply.ok;
  const record = current === null ? null : polled !== null && current.pending !== null && polled.id === current.pending.id ? polled.record : current.pending;
  const open = current !== null && current.open && record === null ? current : null;

  // Visibility (C35): hidden pauses the re-read; visible again resumes it with a full view. Focus asks a full view.
  useEffect(() => {
    const onVisibility = () => {
      const now = visible();
      setShown(now);
      if (now) void read();
    };
    const onFocus = () => void read();
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisibility);
    window.addEventListener('focus', onFocus);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisibility);
      window.removeEventListener('focus', onFocus);
    };
  }, [read]);

  // 23a's re-read: the snapshot and the gate only, every 25 s while visible (C35, review 2 M3).
  const rereading = open !== null && shown;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!rereading) return;
    const i = setInterval(() => void read('gate'), REREAD_MS);
    return () => clearInterval(i);
  }, [rereading, read]);

  // 23b: the record every 6 s and on focus — no network (C30); when it is no longer open, one full view.
  const watching = record === null ? null : record.id;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (watching === null || account === null) return;
    let alive = true;
    const poll = async () => {
      const r = await client.pending(account);
      if (!alive || !r.ok) return;
      if (r.data === null || r.data.id !== watching) void read();
      else setPolled({id: watching, record: r.data});
    };
    const i = setInterval(() => void poll(), PENDING_POLL_MS);
    const onFocus = () => void poll();
    window.addEventListener('focus', onFocus);
    return () => {
      alive = false;
      clearInterval(i);
      window.removeEventListener('focus', onFocus);
    };
  }, [watching, account, client, read]);

  const decimals = TOKEN_INFO[currency].decimals;
  const parsed = parseAmount(text, decimals);
  const amount = parsed !== null && parsed > 0n ? parsed : null;
  const isMax = maxText !== null && text === maxText;
  const key = `${currency}|${text}`;

  // The quote (§3.2): 250 ms after the last keystroke, again for each new view; MAX's own while the field holds it.
  // Empty or zero asks nothing (the popup's own `{line: null}`, Buy disabled).
  const quoteGeneration = useRef(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    const mine = ++quoteGeneration.current;
    if (account === null || open === null || (amount === null && !isMax)) return;
    const t = setTimeout(() => {
      void client.quote(account, currency, isMax ? 'max' : (amount ?? 0n)).then(r => {
        if (quoteGeneration.current !== mine) return;
        if (!r.ok) {
          if (r.error === 'locked') void reload();
          return;
        }
        if (r.data === 'stale') {
          setQuoted({key, quote: 'stale'});
          void read();
          return;
        }
        if (isMax) {
          // MAX's amount as the background answered it; the field shows it, and it stays MAX's while unedited.
          const next = plainAmount(r.data.amount, decimals);
          setText(next);
          setMaxText(next);
          setQuoted({key: `${currency}|${next}`, quote: r.data});
        } else setQuoted({key, quote: r.data});
      });
    }, QUOTE_DEBOUNCE_MS);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [account, open, amount, isMax, currency, key, decimals, client, read, reload]);

  const quote = quoted !== null && quoted.key === key && quoted.quote !== 'stale' ? quoted.quote : null;
  const stale = quoted !== null && quoted.key === key && quoted.quote === 'stale';
  const noPrice = open !== null && currency === 'SOL' && open.solUsdMicros === null;
  const line: Line | null = refusal !== null && refusal.key === key ? refusal.line : noPrice ? 'no-sol-price' : (quote?.line ?? null);
  const estimate = quote?.nocBase ?? null;
  const ready = open !== null && account !== null && amount !== null && quote !== null && quote.amount === amount && line === null && !stale && m.net.mode !== 'refused';

  const edit = (next: string) => {
    setText(next);
    setRefusal(null);
    setNotice(null);
  };
  const choose = (t: Token) => {
    const c = PRESALE_CURRENCIES.find(x => x === t);
    if (c === undefined || c === currency) return;
    setCurrency(c);
    setText('');
    setMaxText(null);
    setRefusal(null);
    setNotice(null);
  };
  const max = () => {
    setRefusal(null);
    setNotice(null);
    // The field holds MAX's text from the answer; '' until it lands, so the quote below asks 'max'.
    setText('');
    setMaxText('');
  };

  const buy = async () => {
    if (!ready || open === null || account === null || amount === null) return;
    setNotice(null);
    const asked = key;
    const r = await client.prepareBuy(account, {currency, amount, stage: open.state.stage});
    if (!alive.current) return;
    if (r.ok) {
      onPrepared(account, r.data);
      return;
    }
    if (r.error === 'locked') {
      void reload();
      return;
    }
    if (isLine(r.error)) {
      setRefusal({key: asked, line: r.error});
      return;
    }
    if (r.error === 'coordinator-refused') report('coordinator-refused');
    const what = refusalOf(r.error);
    setNotice(what.notice);
    if (what.reread) void read();
  };

  const loading = current === null && !failed;
  const balance = open === null ? null : currency === 'SOL' ? open.balances.SOL : open.balances[currency].largest;
  const sub =
    open === null
      ? null
      : currency === 'SOL'
        ? open.solUsdMicros === null
          ? PRESALE_TEXT.receiveStable(priceText(open.state.priceTicks))
          : PRESALE_TEXT.receiveSol(priceText(open.state.priceTicks), solPriceText(open.solUsdMicros))
        : PRESALE_TEXT.receiveStable(priceText(open.state.priceTicks));

  let body;
  if (loading) {
    body = (
      <>
        <div className="stage-card" aria-busy="true">
          <SkelLine width={140} />
          <SkelLine width={180} height={28} />
          <SkelLine width={320} height={6} />
          <SkelLine width={260} />
        </div>
        <div className="input-card" aria-busy="true">
          <SkelLine width={200} />
          <SkelLine width={240} height={28} />
          <SkelLine width={200} />
          <SkelLine width={160} height={22} />
        </div>
      </>
    );
  } else if (current === null) {
    body = <Banner tone="warning" title={PRESALE_TEXT.unavailable} />;
  } else if (record !== null) {
    body = <Pending23b record={record} line={closedLine(current)} />;
  } else if (!current.open) {
    const closed = closedLine(current);
    body = (
      <>
        {current.why === 'inactive' || current.why === 'blocked' ? <StageCard state={current.state} live={current.why === 'blocked'} /> : null}
        {closed === null ? null : <Banner tone="warning" title={closed} />}
      </>
    );
  } else {
    const v = current;
    body = (
      <>
        {notice === null ? null : <Banner tone="warning" title={notice} />}
        <StageCard state={v.state} live />
        <div className="input-card">
          <div className="lbl-row">
            <b className="noc-overline">{PRESALE_TEXT.youPay}</b>
            <span className="noc-caption">
              {PRESALE_TEXT.available}
              <span className="noc-numeral">{balance === null ? '—' : showAmount(currency, balance)}</span> {currency}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="row">
            <input
              className="input noc-balance-lg noc-numeral"
              aria-label={PRESALE_TEXT.youPay}
              placeholder="0.0"
              inputMode="decimal"
              autoComplete="off"
              spellCheck={false}
              value={text}
              onChange={e => edit(e.target.value.trim())}
            />
            <button type="button" className="ticker" aria-label={PRESALE_TEXT.currency(currency)} onClick={() => setSheet(true)}>
              {currency}
              <ExtIcon name="chevron-down" size={16} />
            </button>
            <button type="button" className="max" onClick={max}>
              {PRESALE_TEXT.max}
            </button>
          </div>
          {line === null ? null : (
            <div className="helper error" role="alert">
              <ExtIcon name="alert" size={12} /> {lineText(line, currency, v)}
            </div>
          )}
          <hr />
          <div className="lbl-row">
            <b className="noc-overline">{PRESALE_TEXT.youReceive}</b>
            <span className="noc-caption">{sub}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="est">
            <span className="noc-balance-md noc-numeral">{estimate === null ? '—' : showAmount('NOC', estimate)}</span>
            <span className="ticker">NOC</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        {v.allocation.exists && v.allocation.totalBase > 0n ? (
          <div className="receipt">
            <div className="row">
              <span className="l noc-body-sm">{PRESALE_TEXT.allocation}</span>
              <span className="r app-pre-stack">
                <span className="noc-body-sm noc-numeral">{`${showAmount('NOC', v.allocation.totalBase)} NOC`}</span>
                <span className="noc-caption app-pre-claimable">{PRESALE_TEXT.claimable}</span>
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : null}
        <button type="button" className="geo-link noc-body-sm" onClick={onRegion}>
          {PRESALE_TEXT.region}
        </button>
      </>
    );
  }

  const showBuy = loading || open !== null;
  return (
    <>
      <div className="screen s-pre">
        <TopBar title={PRESALE_TEXT.title} titleClass="noc-h3" onBack={onBack} />
        <div className="scroll">{body}</div>
        {record !== null ? (
          <div className="sticky-bar">
            <button type="button" className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={onDone}>
              {PRESALE_TEXT.done}
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : showBuy ? (
          <div className="sticky-bar">
            <LockedButton className="btn btn-primary" disabled={!ready} onPress={buy}>
              <ExtIcon name="buy" size={18} />
              {estimate === null || open === null ? PRESALE_TEXT.buyPlain : PRESALE_TEXT.buy(showAmount('NOC', estimate))}
            </LockedButton>
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </div>
      {sheet ? <TokenSheet balances={m.balances} prices={m.prices} selected={currency} tokens={PRESALE_CURRENCIES} onSelect={choose} onClose={() => setSheet(false)} /> : null}
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type {PresaleRoute} from '../router';
import {Presale} from './Presale';

/**
 * B1d §4: #23 — the route `presale`, carrying nothing (it reads `presale.view` itself). Its exits: back, [Done] → #11,
 * Buy → #20's purchase variant (`presale-confirm`, `flow`, the prepared id — B1d-1b Task 5 registers that route) and
 * "Not available in your region?" → #50b (`geo`, carrying nothing — Task 6 registers it). The reducer decides every
 * push by the target's own validator: until a route is registered, the push leaves the stack as it is.
 */
export const PRESALE_ROUTE: PresaleRoute = {
  screen: 'presale',
  isRoute: o => Object.keys(o).length === 1 && o.screen === 'presale',
  render: (_route, nav) => (
    <Presale
      onBack={nav.pop}
      onDone={nav.home}
      onPrepared={(account, view) => nav.push({screen: 'presale-confirm', account, entry: 'flow', preparedId: view.id})}
      onRegion={() => nav.push({screen: 'geo'})}
    />
  ),
};
```

Then regenerate the design's classes — never by hand: `node scripts/extract-design-css.mjs` (the owner's design file), then `node scripts/extract-design-css.mjs --check` → `design-ext.css is the extraction output`; `sha256sum src/styles/design-ext.css` → `cfd89588d498b84b76f82c9955a5f975b4dae7b52c29440c180defe93ead35b3` (the hash `designExt2b.test.ts` pins). #### Dry-run notes (Task 4)

- **Deviation (stated loudly): #23's two exits land in later tasks.** Buy calls `presale.prepareBuy` and hands the purchase to `nav.push({screen: 'presale-confirm', account, entry: 'flow', preparedId})`; "Not available in your region?" pushes `{screen: 'geo'}`. Neither route exists until Task 5 (#20's purchase variant) and Task 6 (#50b), so the reducer refuses both pushes and the stack stays on #23 ("stop at prepare", the brief) — the code is the final code, not a stub, and nothing in the UI pushes `presale` before Task 6 (#11's banner and Buy), so no build shows a Buy or a link that leads nowhere. **Task 5 MUST** register `presale-confirm` in `presaleRoutes`; **Task 6 MUST** register `geo`, push `{screen: 'presale'}` from #11, replace #23's closed region answer (no open record) by #50b, and make 23b's region line a link to #50b. Until Task 6, the region answer is the line "Not available here — <reason>" in place of the cards (the controller's "show the unavailable line, leave the routing to Task 6"). Cost if wrong: none for funds (a prepared entry nobody signs expires in 30 s).
- **Ruling: the popup's presale client goes through a generic `Engine.request(message, codes, parse)`** (shared, both builds) rather than named engine methods — why: `engine.ts` is shared code and every `presale.*` type is an off-build marker (§6.2); the presale client (`src/app/presale/client.ts`) names its types and does its own strict shape checks. Same transport, one retry, reply rule — cost if wrong: none (B1b's named calls are unchanged; `Switcher.test.tsx`'s self-contained stub engine gained one line).
- **Ruling: `PresaleRoute` gains `render(route, nav)`; App asks `presaleRouteOf(route)` before its own screens and gives it `presaleNav(go, HOME)`** — pop, a reset to #11, and a push the reducer decides (a presale route never claims a SCREENS name — 1a's rule — and `presaleRouteOf` repeats it). Shared code still imports only the entry. App's one line that calls `render` is exercised end to end only once something pushes a presale route (Task 6's #11 Buy); here the two helpers and the route's own render are tested. Cost if wrong: Task 6's App test is the first end-to-end proof.
- **Ruling (copy, flagged): the closed region line is "Not available here — " + #50b's own sub for the reason** (§4.3: stale list, unknown country = Q26, no check, refused; for `sanctioned`, Q21's first sentence "This wallet doesn't offer the presale in your region.", because §4.3's sanctioned sub is the long Q21). §4.1 names the form "Not available here — <reason>" without the reason's words. Cost if wrong: one table in `text.ts` (`GEO_REASON_TEXT`).
- **Ruling: Q19 shows for SOL as soon as the view says there is no SOL price** (`solUsdMicros: null`), before any amount — C8 "SOL is not offered"; a quote would answer `no-sol-price` anyway. Cost if wrong: none.
- **Ruling: the line words** — `insufficient-sol` is Q41a ("Insufficient SOL balance") when paying with SOL and Q41b ("Need a little SOL for the network fee") when paying with a stablecoin (core's `canBuy` split); `above-limit` (the program's 6023, per-transaction or per-user) is Q40b with the configured maximum; Q40's dollars are core's form ("$10", "$50,000", cents only when not whole). Cost if wrong: one switch in `Presale.tsx`.
- **Ruling: prepare refusals that are not lines show as one warning banner above the stage card** (Q15, Q16, Q43, Q52, Q11–Q14) until the user edits the amount or the currency; `price-changed`, `state-changed`, `presale-closed`, `blocked`, `presale-unavailable`, `geo-closed`, `in-flight`, `unknown-account` also read the view again (§5: "the popup re-reads the view"); `coordinator-refused` reports the D26 state; `in-flight` shows B1b's line "A send from this account is still pending. Wait until it confirms or expires." (a purchase in flight becomes 23b on the re-read and the banner is not drawn there). §4.1 names no place for these lines. Cost if wrong: placement only.
- **Ruling: the 25 s re-read runs on 23a only** (C35 "#23a re-reads"); closed answers re-read on focus and on becoming visible; 23b reads only its record (C30). A view whose state is `refused` also reports `coordinator-refused` to the provider (D26: Send disabled for the cool-down, which the latch imposes anyway). Cost if wrong: a closed #23 left open does not lift by itself until focus.
- **Ruling: the quote is asked again for every new view** (the 25 s re-read included — no network, Task 1's snapshot cache), and while the field holds MAX's text the quote asked is `'max'`, so a balance change on a full view moves MAX's amount with it. A stale quote disables Buy and asks a full view. Cost if wrong: none.
- **Ruling: the currency choice reuses #43 (`TokenSheet`) with a new `tokens` prop**, showing the wallet's balances as #43 always does (`m.balances`); "Available" on #23 is the view's own figure (SOL, or the stablecoin's largest holding). Cost if wrong: none.
- **Ruling: 23b's Q06 is the design's own banner markup** (one regular-weight `.noc-body-sm` line), not B1b's `Banner` (a semibold title) — found in the visual check. "presale terms" stays unlinked (§9). 23b with an unreadable `extra.data` keeps its head and the Tx hash row (the record is never hidden; no Paid / Estimated / Stage rows from data that does not read back).
- **Ruling: `rocket` and `buy` join `ExtIcon`** (shared — glyph names, no presale string), path-for-path from the sprite; Task 6's #11 Buy uses `buy`.
- **Ruling: `.s-pre` joins the extractor's prefixes; `design-ext.css` is regenerated (171 lines, the design's #23 block incl. the unused 23c/23d rules) and its hash re-pinned.** The extractor drops `@media`, so the ring's reduced-motion rule lives in `app.css`. The off build carries the `.s-pre` CSS (both builds share the stylesheets); it contains no marker (the gate scans it). Cost if wrong: ~2 KB of CSS in the off build.
- **Ruling: markers armed now for what #23 renders** (23 strings: §6.2's named "NOC presale", "YOU RECEIVE (EST.)", "Claimable after TGE", "Order pending", "Not available here", and the literal parts ≥ 8 characters of Q01, Q02, Q04–Q06, Q11–Q16, Q19, Q40c, Q41c, Q41d, Q43, Q52). Q40a/b and Q41a/b are core-sourced and their parts occur in shared code — not markers (§6.2 limits markers to new / approved / app). Task 8 adds the rest (route names, #50b, #20, F12). `ON_BUILD` gains `src/app/presale/{routes.tsx,Presale.tsx,client.ts,text.ts}` (the on build's module map spells them so).
- **Moved, not changed: the honest simulation** (`effectsOf`, `honestSimulation`, the two rents) from `buy.test.ts` to `presale/__tests__/simulation.ts`, so #23's Buy rows prepare against the same program effects; `buy.test.ts`'s 127 rows green before and after (the red run proves it on Task 3's tree).
- **Not built here (stated):** 23c / 23d (D1, §9); the referral field (B1d-2); #20, #10, #21 for a purchase (Task 5); #50b and #11's entry (Task 6). The request budget is proven with a quiet provider (the wallet's own open sequence reads its balances and prices besides #23's; a quiet provider isolates #23's five).
- **(rev 2) D22: the client parses the open view's `countryCode`** (`countryOf`, shared with the geo answer's parse: two capital letters or null; the key required). Without it the popup refuses every open view of rev 2's background as `failed` — the rev 1 client is red against it (`client.test.ts` 2 failed of 9 on Task 3's rev 2 tree with rev 1's client). #23 itself does not show the country. — cost if wrong: none.
- **Dry run:** clone `dry/b1d1b-r21`, commit `16b1145` (rev 2.1; rev 2 `138ed8a`; rev 1 `8dcb273`), on Task 3's `54c0b52`. Replaying this part (rev 2) onto `git archive 54c0b52` (7 new files, 18 diffs, `git apply --recount`) reproduces the commit byte for byte (all 25 files compared). Visual shots and the shots page live under `scratchpad/b1d1b-t4/` only (never in the repository); the mutation runner is `b1d1b-t4/runmut.py`.

### Task 5: #20's purchase variant (`presale-confirm`, flow and resume), #10's description of a purchase, a purchase on #21 / #44 / #54 (Q32 and the "Presale" badge, replacing the B1b send words 1a left), #23 again with the amount, and both popup resume paths (App.tsx's hook; the UI tab's `#/send/resume` hand-over) — a purchase whose #10 was proven with the popup closed signs with no second proof

**What #20's purchase variant shows, and what it decides.** Nothing of its own: on every entry it reads `presale.preparedFor` (a flow entry must find the purchase #23 handed over, else a fresh #23 — nothing shown or signed); at the quote's end it re-prepares the same intent once by itself, carrying the challenge, then "Quote expired" [Refresh]; `presale.buy` is called from Buy's click and nowhere else (rule 6: a `LockedButton`, never focused at open; an unproven challenge opens #10 instead, re-reading `presale.preparedFor` once in the same tap for a proof given elsewhere). Its rows are §4.2's, from the prepared purchase: B1b's amount card is the payment (Q08 its eyebrow, "≈ $" from the simulation's `spentCents` — the program's valuation, C36), then "You receive (est.)" (the simulation's NOC, not #23's estimate), Stage, Price, From, To (Q10 over the pinned treasury or vault ATA, whole, in groups of four), Network, the fees card (network less priority, priority, Q09 for the accounts this purchase creates — the simulated rent, C11 — and Total; no Noctura fee, C25), and #19's facts as a "Simulation" receipt block (Q44, C33). Where it goes: #23 is this flow's review — back and Esc keep the purchase and return to #23 with the amount and the challenge (`again`); Cancel discards and opens a fresh #23; a sign-time refusal no re-prepare can lift discards and opens #23, whose own view then says why; one a new review can lift keeps the purchase (C29) and opens #23 with the amount, the refusal's line or notice and the challenge carried; a signature opens #21. #21, #44 and #54 show the record through the slot's words — never from data that does not read back (Q42 then) — and Done returns to #23 (C17), [Try again] to #23 with the amount.
