**What #11 and #50b show, and what they decide.** Nothing of their own (C3). #11 reads `presale.banner` on mount and on focus through the presale entry's slot (the build without presale has no slot and reads nothing): while it answers a banner, the card "NOC Presale · Stage N" / "$ 0.1501 · P% to next stage" sits below the tokens and **Buy** is the third quick action, both disabled offline and in the 403 cool-down as Send is. A tap on either asks the slot where to go — a fresh `presale.view`: an open purchase (C30) or an open sale → #23, the gate closed → #50b, anything else → no route, and the action and its banner hide until the next banner read. #50b asks `presale.view` on every mount ("Re-checked at every presale screen mount"), never on focus, and draws the answer: the gate's closed reason with §4.3's words, the country only for `sanctioned` and a stale list; any other answer was given with the gate open (the gate is asked first) and is the open variant (Q20); a view that did not answer is `no_check` — closed. #23 with the gate's closed answer and no open record replaces itself by #50b (once), so [Got it] — a pop — lands on what was under #23 (#11); from #23's link or 23b's region line #50b is pushed over #23 and [Got it] returns there; ✕ goes home.

The shared country helper (`regionName.test.ts`, new): the English name, " · EU" for the EU-27 only (positive and negative controls), the exact table, and the code itself when `Intl.DisplayNames` throws or has no name.

Create `extension/src/app/__tests__/regionName.test.ts`:

```ts
import {EU_MEMBERS, regionName, regionText} from '../ui/regionName';

// B1d §3.6, §4.3: the shared country helper of #50b and #48's F12 — the browser's English name, the code itself when the
// browser cannot name it, and " · EU" for the 27 EU members only.
afterEach(() => {
  vi.restoreAllMocks();
});

describe('regionName / regionText (§4.3)', () => {
  it('the English name; " · EU" for a member (SI, DE, GR) and for no other country (positive and negative controls)', () => {
    expect(regionName('SI')).toBe('Slovenia');
    expect(regionText('SI')).toBe('Slovenia · EU');
    expect(regionText('DE')).toBe('Germany · EU');
    expect(regionText('GR')).toBe('Greece · EU');
    for (const [code, name] of [
      ['KP', 'North Korea'],
      ['US', 'United States'],
      ['CH', 'Switzerland'],
      ['GB', 'United Kingdom'],
      ['NO', 'Norway'],
    ]) {
      expect(regionText(code as string)).toBe(name);
    }
  });

  it('the EU-27, exactly (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2: Greece is GR)', () => {
    expect([...EU_MEMBERS].sort()).toEqual(['AT', 'BE', 'BG', 'CY', 'CZ', 'DE', 'DK', 'EE', 'ES', 'FI', 'FR', 'GR', 'HR', 'HU', 'IE', 'IT', 'LT', 'LU', 'LV', 'MT', 'NL', 'PL', 'PT', 'RO', 'SE', 'SI', 'SK']);
    expect(EU_MEMBERS.has('EL')).toBe(false);
    expect(EU_MEMBERS.has('GB')).toBe(false);
  });

  it('Intl.DisplayNames throwing → the code itself, never nothing (with " · EU" still from the table)', () => {
    vi.spyOn(Intl, 'DisplayNames').mockImplementation(function () {
      throw new RangeError('no display names');
    });
    expect(regionName('KP')).toBe('KP');
    expect(regionText('SI')).toBe('SI · EU');
  });

  it('Intl.DisplayNames answering undefined or an empty name → the code itself', () => {
    for (const answer of [undefined, '']) {
      vi.spyOn(Intl, 'DisplayNames').mockImplementation(function () {
        return {of: () => answer} as unknown as Intl.DisplayNames;
      });
      expect(regionName('KP')).toBe('KP');
      vi.restoreAllMocks();
    }
  });
});
```

#50b against the real background (`Geo.test.tsx`, new): every gate reason as §4.3's table words it (the copy as literals), the region card only where it names a country, the open variant, a non-geo answer as the open variant, a view that did not answer as `no_check`; the exits; one view per mount; `regionName` falling back on screen; nothing §9 omits.

Create `extension/src/app/presale/__tests__/Geo.test.tsx`:

```tsx
// @vitest-environment happy-dom
import {act, cleanup, fireEvent, screen} from '@testing-library/react';
import {base64} from '@scure/base';
import {renderInWallet} from '../../__tests__/harness';
import {Geo} from '../Geo';
import {GEO_ROUTE} from '../routes';
import {UI_SHEETS, selectorsOf, unstyledClasses} from '../../../__tests__/styled';
import {registerPresale} from '../../../background/presale/api';
import {registerPresaleHandler} from '../../../background/messages';
import {PENDING_KEY} from '../../../background/pendingStore';
import type {GeoAnswer} from '../../../background/geo/gate';
import {fakeDeps} from '../../../background/__tests__/fakeDeps';
import {fakeExt} from '../../../background/__tests__/fakeExt';
import {pendingRecord, signedWire} from '../../../background/__tests__/fixtures';
import {ACCOUNT, TREASURY_ADDRESS, configData, program, userData} from '../../../background/presale/__tests__/chain';
import {firstSignature} from '../../../../../core/solana/broadcast';
import {purchaseWorld} from './world';

registerPresale({ext: fakeExt(), deps: fakeDeps(), handle: registerPresaleHandler});

// B1d §4.3 (C3, C12, C18; §9's #50b rows; Q20–Q30): #50b against the REAL background — presale.view over chain.ts's
// program state with the gate's answer as a dep. Every reason as §4.3's table words it, the region card only where it
// names a country, and nothing §9 omits ("claim_ix", staking, the post-TGE claim line, a date).
const SELECTORS = selectorsOf(UI_SHEETS);
const nav = {onBack: vi.fn(), onClose: vi.fn(), onDone: vi.fn()};
const Q = {
  q20: 'NOC presale is open in your region',
  sanctioned: "NOC presale isn't open in your region",
  q21: "This wallet doesn't offer the presale in your region. You can still hold, send and receive any NOC you already have.",
  q22: 'Checked by this wallet against the restricted-region list',
  q23: "The presale can't be opened right now",
  q24: 'Region check required',
  q25: 'The presale opens only after a successful check against a current list',
  q26: 'Your region could not be determined from your IP.',
  q27: "Noctura's server did not answer requests from this network",
  q28: 'Token sales are restricted by jurisdiction · this wallet checks before every purchase',
  q29: 'If the restricted-region list changes, this screen lifts on its own.',
  q30: 'View balances',
  stale: 'The restricted-region list is out of date.',
  noCheck: 'The region check is unavailable — try again later.',
  refused: 'The presale service refused this network.',
  disclosure: 'Approximated from your IP. No GPS, no device location.',
  geofence: 'Presale geofence active',
  why: 'Why this matters',
  rechecked: 'Re-checked at every presale screen mount.',
};
const text = (sel: string) => document.querySelector(sel)?.textContent ?? null;
const texts = (sel: string) => [...document.querySelectorAll(sel)].map(e => e.textContent);
/** The reason rows, head and sub. */
const reasonRows = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('.app-geo-card .s11-reason-row .body')].map(b => [...b.children].map(c => c.textContent));
/** The region card's lines. */
const regionLines = () => texts('.s11-geo-region .col > *');
/** Boolean, with neutral messages (public CI logs): no date, no countdown, and nothing §9 omits. */
function expectNothingOmitted() {
  const t = document.body.textContent ?? '';
  expect(/\b(19|20)\d{2}\b/.test(t)).toBe(false);
  expect(/\b(Jan|Feb|Mar|Apr|May|Jun|Jul|Aug|Sep|Oct|Nov|Dec)[a-z]*\.? \d/.test(t)).toBe(false);
  for (const v of ['claim_ix', 'Stake', 'stake', 'Claim', 'View portfolio', 'allowlist', "honor the program's"]) expect([v, t.includes(v)]).toEqual([v, false]);
  expect(document.querySelector('.s11-geo-region .flag')).toBeNull();
}
/** #50b over this gate answer, and the presale.view messages it sent. */
type WorldOptions = NonNullable<Parameters<typeof purchaseWorld>[0]>;
async function show(answer: GeoAnswer, o: {before?: WorldOptions['before']; chain?: WorldOptions['chain']; failView?: boolean} = {}) {
  const views: unknown[] = [];
  const w = purchaseWorld({
    ...(o.chain === undefined ? {} : {chain: o.chain}),
    ...(o.before === undefined ? {} : {before: o.before}),
    gate: m => {
      if ((m as {type: string}).type !== 'presale.view') return;
      views.push(m);
      if (o.failView === true) throw new Error('the popup lost its port');
    },
  });
  w.geo.answer = answer;
  const wallet = await renderInWallet(<Geo {...nav} />, w.options);
  await screen.findByText(/^(NOC presale is|NOC presale isn't|The presale can't)/);
  return {w, wallet, views};
}

afterEach(() => {
  vi.restoreAllMocks();
  vi.clearAllMocks();
});

describe('#50b × 6 (§4.3), each reason as the table words it', () => {
  it('sanctioned: the design’s headline, Q21, "Detected region: North Korea" with the disclosure, the geofence row (Q22) and "Why this matters" (Q28), the info banner (Q29) and "What still works"; every class styled', async () => {
    const {views} = await show({open: false, reason: 'sanctioned', countryCode: 'KP'});
    expect(text('.top-bar .title.noc-h1-compact')).toBe('Not available here');
    expect(text('.s11-geo-hero h2.noc-h2')).toBe(Q.sanctioned);
    expect(text('.s11-geo-hero p.noc-body.app-geo-sub')).toBe(Q.q21);
    expect(document.querySelector('.s11-geo-hero .glyph.app-geo-warn')).not.toBeNull();
    expect(regionLines()).toEqual(['Detected region: North Korea', Q.disclosure]);
    expect(reasonRows()).toEqual([
      [Q.geofence, Q.q22],
      [Q.why, Q.q28],
    ]);
    expect(document.querySelectorAll('.app-geo-card .s11-reason-row .ico.app-geo-warn')).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(texts('.app-geo-banner > div > *')).toEqual([Q.q29, Q.rechecked]);
    expect(text('.s11-stillworks .head .noc-overline')).toBe('What still works');
    expect(texts('.s11-stillworks li')).toEqual(['Send / Receive NOC', Q.q30]);
    expect(texts('.sticky-bar button')).toEqual(['Got it']);
    expectNothingOmitted();
    expect(unstyledClasses(document.body, SELECTORS)).toEqual([]);
    // "Re-checked at every presale screen mount": exactly one view for this mount (C12).
    expect(views).toEqual([{type: 'presale.view', account: ACCOUNT}]);
  });

  it('stale_list with a known country: Q23, the approved sub, "Detected region: Slovenia · EU", Q24 · Q25', async () => {
    await show({open: false, reason: 'stale_list', countryCode: 'SI'});
    expect(text('.s11-geo-hero h2')).toBe(Q.q23);
    expect(text('.s11-geo-hero p')).toBe(Q.stale);
    expect(regionLines()).toEqual(['Detected region: Slovenia · EU', Q.disclosure]);
    expect(reasonRows()).toEqual([
      [Q.q24, Q.q25],
      [Q.why, Q.q28],
    ]);
    expect(texts('.s11-stillworks li')).toEqual(['Send / Receive NOC', Q.q30]);
    expectNothingOmitted();
    expect(unstyledClasses(document.body, SELECTORS)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('stale_list with no country known: the disclosure line only', async () => {
    await show({open: false, reason: 'stale_list', countryCode: null});
    expect(text('.s11-geo-hero p')).toBe(Q.stale);
    expect(regionLines()).toEqual([Q.disclosure]);
  });

  it('unknown_country: Q23, Q26, the disclosure line only, Q24 · Q25', async () => {
    await show({open: false, reason: 'unknown_country', countryCode: null});
    expect(text('.s11-geo-hero h2')).toBe(Q.q23);
    expect(text('.s11-geo-hero p')).toBe(Q.q26);
    expect(regionLines()).toEqual([Q.disclosure]);
    expect(reasonRows()).toEqual([
      [Q.q24, Q.q25],
      [Q.why, Q.q28],
    ]);
    expectNothingOmitted();
  });

  it('no_check: Q23, the approved sub, the disclosure line only — even when the check named a country (the list failed) — Q24 · Q25', async () => {
    await show({open: false, reason: 'no_check', countryCode: 'SI'});
    expect(text('.s11-geo-hero h2')).toBe(Q.q23);
    expect(text('.s11-geo-hero p')).toBe(Q.noCheck);
    expect(regionLines()).toEqual([Q.disclosure]);
    expect(reasonRows()).toEqual([
      [Q.q24, Q.q25],
      [Q.why, Q.q28],
    ]);
    expectNothingOmitted();
  });

  it('refused (a 403): Q23, the approved sub, the disclosure line only, Q24 · Q27', async () => {
    await show({open: false, reason: 'refused', countryCode: null});
    expect(text('.s11-geo-hero h2')).toBe(Q.q23);
    expect(text('.s11-geo-hero p')).toBe(Q.refused);
    expect(regionLines()).toEqual([Q.disclosure]);
    expect(reasonRows()).toEqual([
      [Q.q24, Q.q27],
      [Q.why, Q.q28],

  it('open (C18): Q20, no sub, "Detected region: Slovenia · EU" with the disclosure (D22), no reason row, no "What still works"; the default glyph', async () => {
    await show({open: true, reason: null, countryCode: 'SI'});

    for (const chain of [{config: program(configData({active: 0}))}, {user: program(userData({blocked: 1}))}]) {

    const SIGNATURE = firstSignature(signedWire(7n));

describe('#50b’s exits and its re-check (§4.3)', () => {
  it('[Got it] → back to the trigger (onDone), ✕ → #11 (onClose), back → onBack', async () => {
    await show({open: false, reason: 'sanctioned', countryCode: 'KP'});
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', {name: 'Got it'}));
    expect(nav.onDone).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', {name: 'Close'}));
    expect(nav.onClose).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', {name: 'Back'}));
    expect(nav.onBack).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect([nav.onDone, nav.onClose, nav.onBack].map(f => f.mock.calls.length)).toEqual([1, 1, 1]);
  });

  it('every mount is a fresh check — a new mount asks again and shows the new answer; a focus asks nothing (the re-check is per mount)', async () => {
    const {w, views} = await show({open: false, reason: 'no_check', countryCode: null});
    await act(async () => {
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('focus'));
      await Promise.resolve();
    });
    expect(views).toHaveLength(1);
    cleanup();
    w.geo.answer = {open: false, reason: 'sanctioned', countryCode: 'KP'};
    await renderInWallet(<Geo {...nav} />, w.options);
    expect(await screen.findByText(Q.sanctioned)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(views).toHaveLength(2);
  });

  it('the route: exactly {screen: "geo"}; Got it and back pop (to the trigger), ✕ goes home', async () => {
    expect(GEO_ROUTE.screen).toBe('geo');
    expect(GEO_ROUTE.isRoute({screen: 'geo'})).toBe(true);
    for (const extra of [{reason: 'sanctioned'}, {countryCode: 'KP'}, {account: ACCOUNT}]) expect(GEO_ROUTE.isRoute({screen: 'geo', ...extra})).toBe(false);
    const n = {pop: vi.fn(), home: vi.fn(), push: vi.fn(), replace: vi.fn(), reset: vi.fn()};
    const w = purchaseWorld();
    w.geo.answer = {open: false, reason: 'sanctioned', countryCode: 'KP'};
    await renderInWallet(<>{GEO_ROUTE.render({screen: 'geo'}, n)}</>, w.options);
    await screen.findByText(Q.sanctioned);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', {name: 'Got it'}));
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', {name: 'Back'}));
    expect(n.pop).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', {name: 'Close'}));
    expect(n.home).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect([n.push, n.replace, n.reset].map(f => f.mock.calls.length)).toEqual([0, 0, 0]);
  });

  it('regionName with Intl.DisplayNames throwing → the code itself on the screen ("Detected region: KP")', async () => {
    vi.spyOn(Intl, 'DisplayNames').mockImplementation(function () {
      throw new RangeError('no display names');
    });
    await show({open: false, reason: 'sanctioned', countryCode: 'KP'});
    expect(regionLines()).toEqual(['Detected region: KP', Q.disclosure]);
  });
});
```

#11's banner and Buy in the whole App (`homePresale.test.tsx`, new — runs in both vitest runs): the off build shows none of it and sends no presale message over a chain the on build shows it for; in the on build the banner as drawn, Buy's routing for each answer, #50b's [Got it] back to its trigger (#11 from Buy, #23 from #23's link, #11 when #50b replaced #23), the three `presale.banner` null paths, offline, and a tap whose view answers after #11 is gone.

Create `extension/src/app/__tests__/homePresale.test.tsx`:

```tsx
// @vitest-environment happy-dom
import {act, cleanup, fireEvent, screen} from '@testing-library/react';
import {base64} from '@scure/base';
import {renderApp} from './appHarness';
import {drainInFlight, renderInWallet} from './harness';
import {Home} from '../screens/Home';
import {UI_SHEETS, selectorsOf, unstyledClasses} from '../../__tests__/styled';
import {registerPresale} from '../../background/presale/api';
import {registerPresaleHandler} from '../../background/messages';
import {PENDING_KEY} from '../../background/pendingStore';
import {fakeDeps} from '../../background/__tests__/fakeDeps';
import {fakeExt} from '../../background/__tests__/fakeExt';
import {pendingRecord, signedWire} from '../../background/__tests__/fixtures';
import {ACCOUNT, TREASURY_ADDRESS, configData, program, userData} from '../../background/presale/__tests__/chain';
import {purchaseWorld, type PurchaseWorld} from '../presale/__tests__/world';
import {firstSignature} from '../../../../core/solana/broadcast';
import {RequestUnreachable, RpcForbidden} from '../../../../core/solana/rpc';

registerPresale({ext: fakeExt(), deps: fakeDeps(), handle: registerPresaleHandler});

// B1d §4.5 (C30; §9's #11 row): #11's presale banner and Buy quick action in the whole App against the REAL background —
// the program state from chain.ts, the gate as a dep. The banner is `presale.banner`'s (no geo check; null on any failure
// or an inactive sale); Buy asks `presale.view` and goes where it says: an open purchase or an open sale → #23, the gate
// closed → #50b, anything else → nowhere, the action hidden. #50b's [Got it] goes back to its trigger. This file runs in
// both vitest runs: the build without presale shows none of it and sends no presale message (§1.1, D2).
const off = process.env.NOCTURA_PRESALE === '0';
const SELECTORS = selectorsOf(UI_SHEETS);
const BANNER = {title: 'NOC Presale · Stage 1', line: '$ 0.1501 · 12% to next stage'};
const SANCTIONED = {open: false, reason: 'sanctioned', countryCode: 'KP'} as const;
const quick = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('.s-dash .quick .qa .lbl')].map(e => e.textContent);
const buyAction = () => [...document.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>('.s-dash .quick .qa')].find(b => b.textContent === 'Buy') ?? null;
const banner = () => document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('.s-dash button.presale');
const types = (sent: unknown[]) => sent.map(m => (m as {type: string}).type);
/** Every engine call the screen made has answered, and React has rendered what they answered. */
const settled = () => act(() => drainInFlight());
/** The App over this world, and every message it sent (`seen` sees each one before the background does). */
async function app(w: PurchaseWorld, seen?: (m: unknown) => void) {
  const sent: unknown[] = [];
  const wallet = await renderApp({
    ...w.options,
    spy: m => {
      sent.push(m);
      seen?.(m);
    },
  });
  return {wallet, sent};
}
const SIGNATURE = firstSignature(signedWire(7n));
const DATA = {currency: 'SOL', amount: '2000000000', stage: '0', priceTicks: '1501', nocBase: '2643837441705', spentCents: '39684', destination: TREASURY_ADDRESS, referrer: null};
const openPurchase = () =>
  pendingRecord({id: 'b1', account: ACCOUNT, signature: SIGNATURE, wire: base64.encode(signedWire(7n)), createdAt: Date.now(), lastSentAt: Date.now(), intent: null, fee: {networkLamports: '5050', markupLamports: '0'}, extra: {kind: 'presale-buy', data: DATA}});
const setOnline = (value: boolean) => Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'onLine', {value, configurable: true});

afterEach(() => {
  setOnline(true);
  vi.clearAllMocks();
});

describe(`#11 in this build (${off ? 'off' : 'on'})`, () => {
  it(off ? 'off: no banner and no Buy — Send and Receive only — and no presale message, over a chain the on build shows them for' : 'on: the banner and Buy over the same chain (positive control of the off run)', async () => {
    const {sent} = await app(purchaseWorld());
    await screen.findByText('TOKENS');
    await settled();
    if (off) {
      expect(quick()).toEqual(['Send', 'Receive']);
      expect(banner()).toBeNull();
      expect(screen.queryByText(BANNER.title)).toBeNull();
      expect(types(sent).filter(t => t.startsWith('presale.'))).toEqual([]);
    } else {
      expect(await screen.findByText(BANNER.title)).toBeTruthy();
      expect(quick()).toEqual(['Send', 'Receive', 'Buy']);
      // The banner reads no gate (§1.4): #11's mount sends presale.banner, and no presale.view until Buy is tapped.
      expect(types(sent).filter(t => t.startsWith('presale.')).sort()).toEqual(['presale.banner', 'presale.preparedFor']);
    }
  });
});

describe.skipIf(off)('#11’s banner and Buy (§4.5)', () => {
  it('as drawn: the banner below the tokens ("NOC Presale · Stage N" / "$ price · P% to next stage", P floored), Buy third after Send and Receive; every class styled', async () => {
    await app(purchaseWorld());
    expect(await screen.findByText(BANNER.title)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(document.querySelector('.s-dash .tokens + button.presale')).toBe(banner());
    expect([...(banner()?.querySelectorAll('.copy > span') ?? [])].map(e => [e.className, e.textContent])).toEqual([
      ['noc-body-lg', BANNER.title],
      ['sm noc-body-sm noc-numeral', BANNER.line],
    ]);
    expect(banner()?.querySelector('.ic svg')).not.toBeNull();
    expect(quick()).toEqual(['Send', 'Receive', 'Buy']);
    expect(buyAction()?.disabled).toBe(false);
    expect(unstyledClasses(banner()!, SELECTORS)).toEqual([]);
    expect(unstyledClasses(document.querySelector('.s-dash .quick')!, SELECTORS)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('Buy asks presale.view and, the sale open, opens #23 — whose own mount asks again (two views)', async () => {
    const {sent} = await app(purchaseWorld());
    await screen.findByText(BANNER.title);
    expect(types(sent).filter(t => t === 'presale.view')).toEqual([]);
    fireEvent.click(buyAction()!);
    expect(await screen.findByText('Stage 1 of 10 · live')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(document.querySelector('.top-bar .title')?.textContent).toBe('NOC presale');
    await settled();
    expect(types(sent).filter(t => t === 'presale.view')).toEqual(['presale.view', 'presale.view']);
  });

  it('the banner’s tap is Buy’s routing (→ #23)', async () => {
    await app(purchaseWorld());
    await screen.findByText(BANNER.title);
    fireEvent.click(banner()!);
    expect(await screen.findByText('Stage 1 of 10 · live')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('the gate closed → #50b at once (never #23: two views — Buy’s and #50b’s mount); [Got it] → #11, Buy and the banner still there', async () => {
    const w = purchaseWorld();
    w.geo.answer = SANCTIONED;
    const {sent} = await app(w);
    await screen.findByText(BANNER.title);
    fireEvent.click(buyAction()!);
    expect(await screen.findByText("NOC presale isn't open in your region")).toBeTruthy();
    await settled();
    expect(types(sent).filter(t => t === 'presale.view')).toEqual(['presale.view', 'presale.view']);
    expect(screen.queryByText('Stage 1 of 10 · live')).toBeNull();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', {name: 'Got it'}));
    expect(await screen.findByText(BANNER.title)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(quick()).toEqual(['Send', 'Receive', 'Buy']);
  });

  it('#23’s "Not available in your region?" → #50b over #23 (the open variant, Q20); [Got it] → #23 again; ✕ → #11', async () => {
    await app(purchaseWorld());
    await screen.findByText(BANNER.title);
    fireEvent.click(buyAction()!);
    await screen.findByText('Stage 1 of 10 · live');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', {name: 'Not available in your region?'}));
    expect(await screen.findByText('NOC presale is open in your region')).toBeTruthy();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', {name: 'Got it'}));
    expect(await screen.findByText('Stage 1 of 10 · live')).toBeTruthy();
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', {name: 'Not available in your region?'}));
    await screen.findByText('NOC presale is open in your region');
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', {name: 'Close'}));
    expect(await screen.findByText(BANNER.title)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.queryByText('Stage 1 of 10 · live')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('the gate closes between Buy’s view and #23’s: #23 is replaced by #50b (§4.1); [Got it] → #11, not #23', async () => {
    let views = 0;
    const w = purchaseWorld();
    await app(w, m => {
      if ((m as {type: string}).type === 'presale.view' && ++views === 2) w.geo.answer = SANCTIONED;
    });
    await screen.findByText(BANNER.title);
    fireEvent.click(buyAction()!);
    expect(await screen.findByText("NOC presale isn't open in your region")).toBeTruthy();
    expect(views).toBe(3);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', {name: 'Got it'}));
    expect(await screen.findByText(BANNER.title)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.queryByText('Not available here')).toBeNull();
    expect(document.querySelector('.s-pre')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('an open purchase → #23 (23b) whatever the gate says (C30)', async () => {
    const w = purchaseWorld({before: ext => ext.local.set(PENDING_KEY, [openPurchase()])});
    w.geo.answer = SANCTIONED;
    await app(w);
    await screen.findByText(BANNER.title);
    fireEvent.click(buyAction()!);
    expect(await screen.findByText('Order pending')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('no route (a blocked account): Buy and the banner hide, #11 stays; the next banner read (a focus) brings them back', async () => {
    await app(purchaseWorld({chain: {user: program(userData({blocked: 1}))}}));
    await screen.findByText(BANNER.title);
    fireEvent.click(buyAction()!);
    await settled();
    expect(buyAction()).toBeNull();
    expect(banner()).toBeNull();
    expect(quick()).toEqual(['Send', 'Receive']);
    expect(document.querySelector('.s-dash')).not.toBeNull();
    await act(async () => {
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('focus'));
    });
    expect(await screen.findByText(BANNER.title)).toBeTruthy();
    expect(quick()).toEqual(['Send', 'Receive', 'Buy']);
  });

  it.each([
    ['a 403', {read: true}],
    ['a malformed config (369 bytes)', {chain: {config: program(configData({length: 369}))}}],
    ['an inactive sale', {chain: {config: program(configData({active: 0}))}}],
  ] as const)('presale.banner null — %s: no banner, no Buy; #11 otherwise as always', async (_name, o) => {
    const w = purchaseWorld('chain' in o ? {chain: o.chain} : {});
    const reader =
      'read' in o
        ? {
            ...w.options.reader!,
            getAccountsData: async () => {
              throw new RpcForbidden('403');
            },
          }
        : w.options.reader!;
    await renderApp({...w.options, reader});
    await screen.findByText('TOKENS');
    await settled();
    expect(banner()).toBeNull();
    expect(buyAction()).toBeNull();
    expect(quick()).toEqual(['Send', 'Receive']);
  });

  it('offline: Buy and the banner disabled, as Send (B1b D36); Receive stays', async () => {
    setOnline(false);
    const w = purchaseWorld();
    const reader = {
      ...w.options.reader!,
      getBalance: async () => {
        throw new RequestUnreachable('u', 'offline');
      },
    };
    await renderApp({...w.options, reader});
    expect(await screen.findByText("You're offline")).toBeTruthy();
    await screen.findByText(BANNER.title);
    expect(buyAction()?.disabled).toBe(true);
    expect(banner()?.disabled).toBe(true);
    expect([...document.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>('.s-dash .quick .qa')].map(b => [b.textContent, b.disabled])).toEqual([
      ['Send', true],
      ['Receive', false],
      ['Buy', true],
    ]);
  });

  it('a tap whose view answers after #11 is gone routes nowhere; the same tap while #11 is shown routes (positive control)', async () => {
    const onRoute = vi.fn();
    let hold = false;
    let release: () => void = () => undefined;
    const w = purchaseWorld({gate: m => ((m as {type: string}).type === 'presale.view' && hold ? new Promise<void>(r => (release = r)) : undefined)});
    const home = () => <Home onSend={() => undefined} onReceive={() => undefined} onPending={() => undefined} onAccounts={() => undefined} onRoute={onRoute} />;
    await renderInWallet(home(), w.options);
    await screen.findByText(BANNER.title);
    fireEvent.click(buyAction()!);
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(onRoute).toHaveBeenCalledWith({screen: 'presale'}));
    cleanup();
    onRoute.mockClear();
    hold = true;
    await renderInWallet(home(), w.options);
    await screen.findByText(BANNER.title);
    fireEvent.click(buyAction()!);
    cleanup();
    release();
    await act(() => drainInFlight());
    expect(onRoute).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});
```

`regionName.ts` (new, shared — `src/app/ui`, beside `ExtIcon` and `LockedButton`; Task 7's approve window imports it for F12's Q50a):

Create `extension/src/app/ui/regionName.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * B1d §3.6, §4.3: a detected country as the user reads it — shared by #50b (the popup) and #48's F12 banner (the approve
 * window), so the two say the same name. The name is the browser's English one (`Intl.DisplayNames`); when that throws
 * or has no name for the code, the code itself is shown, never nothing. " · EU" follows the 27 EU members (a static
 * table, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes).
 */
export const EU_MEMBERS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set([
  'AT',
  'BE',
  'BG',
  'CY',
  'CZ',
  'DE',
  'DK',
  'EE',
  'ES',
  'FI',
  'FR',
  'GR',
  'HR',
  'HU',
  'IE',
  'IT',
  'LT',
  'LU',
  'LV',
  'MT',
  'NL',
  'PL',
  'PT',
  'RO',
  'SE',
  'SI',
  'SK',
]);

/** The country's English name, or the code itself when the browser cannot name it. */
export function regionName(code: string): string {
  try {
    const name = new Intl.DisplayNames(['en'], {type: 'region'}).of(code);
    return name === undefined || name === '' ? code : name;
  } catch {
    return code;
  }
}

/** #50b's region: "Slovenia · EU" for an EU member, the name alone otherwise. */
export const regionText = (code: string): string => (EU_MEMBERS.has(code) ? `${regionName(code)} · EU` : regionName(code));
```

`Geo.tsx` (new, presale build only) — #50b:

Create `extension/src/app/presale/Geo.tsx`:

```tsx
import {useEffect, useMemo, useState} from 'react';
import {useWallet} from '../WalletContext';
import {TopBar} from '../ui/TopBar';
import {ExtIcon} from '../ui/ExtIcon';
import {SkelLine} from '../ui/Skeleton';
import {regionText} from '../ui/regionName';
import {presaleClient, type GeoReason} from './client';
import {GEO_SUB_TEXT, GEO_TEXT} from './text';

/** What #50b shows: the gate's reason (null: open, C18) and the detected country when the gate named one. */
interface Shown {
  reason: GeoReason | null;
  countryCode: string | null;
}

/**
 * #50b region blocked, presale (B1d §4.3; index.html #50 ix 19612-19906, the 50b phone): one `presale.view` on every
 * mount — a fresh `/geo/check` ("Re-checked at every presale screen mount") — and the gate's answer as drawn: the hero
 * (headline and sub for the reason), the region card (the country for `sanctioned`, a stale list and the open variant
 * (D22), as the gate detected it; otherwise the coarse-geo disclosure alone), the reason row, "Why this matters", the info banner and
 * "What still works". The background decides (C3): a view that is not the gate's closed answer was answered with the
 * gate open (it is asked first, §2.2), so it is the open variant (Q20); a view that failed is `no_check` — closed. The
 * design's flag tile, "claim_ix", "Stake existing NOC" and the post-TGE claim line are omitted (§9).
 */
export function Geo({onBack, onClose, onDone}: {onBack: () => void; onClose: () => void; onDone: () => void}) {
  const m = useWallet();
  const account = m.account?.publicKey ?? null;
  const client = useMemo(() => presaleClient(m.engine), [m.engine]);
  const {reload} = m;
  const [shown, setShown] = useState<{account: string; shown: Shown} | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (account === null) return;
    let alive = true;
    void client.view(account).then(r => {
      if (!alive) return;
      if (!r.ok && r.error === 'locked') {
        void reload();
        return;
      }
      const v = r.ok ? r.data : null;
      const next: Shown = v === null ? {reason: 'no_check', countryCode: null} : !v.open && v.why === 'geo' ? {reason: v.geo.reason ?? 'no_check', countryCode: v.geo.countryCode} : {reason: null, countryCode: v.open ? v.countryCode : null};
      setShown({account, shown: next});
    });
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, [account, client, reload]);

  const s = shown !== null && shown.account === account ? shown.shown : null;
  const close = (
    <button type="button" className="icon-btn" aria-label={GEO_TEXT.close} onClick={onClose}>
      <ExtIcon name="close" size={22} />
    </button>
  );

  let body;
  if (s === null) {
    body = (
      <div className="s11-geo-hero" aria-busy="true">
        <SkelLine width={72} height={72} />
        <SkelLine width={260} height={26} />
        <SkelLine width={240} />
      </div>
    );
  } else {
    const {reason} = s;
    const headline = reason === null ? GEO_TEXT.open : reason === 'sanctioned' ? GEO_TEXT.sanctioned : GEO_TEXT.closed;
    // §4.3: the country for `sanctioned`, a stale list and the open variant (D22) when the gate named one; the disclosure
    // line only otherwise.
    const country = s.countryCode !== null && (reason === null || reason === 'sanctioned' || reason === 'stale_list') ? regionText(s.countryCode) : null;
    const row = reason === null ? null : reason === 'sanctioned' ? [GEO_TEXT.geofence, GEO_TEXT.geofenceSub] : [GEO_TEXT.checkRequired, reason === 'refused' ? GEO_TEXT.refusedSub : GEO_TEXT.checkRequiredSub];
    body = (
      <>
        <div className="s11-geo-hero">
          <div className={reason === null ? 'glyph' : 'glyph app-geo-warn'}>
            <ExtIcon name={reason === null ? 'globe' : 'lock'} size={32} />
          </div>
          <h2 className="noc-h2">{headline}</h2>
          {reason === null ? null : <p className="noc-body app-geo-sub">{GEO_SUB_TEXT[reason]}</p>}
        </div>
        <div className="s11-geo-region">
          <div className="col">
            {country === null ? null : <div className="noc-body app-geo-primary">{GEO_TEXT.region(country)}</div>}
            <div className="noc-caption app-geo-tertiary app-geo-disclosure">{GEO_TEXT.disclosure}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="card app-geo-card">
          {row === null ? null : (
            <div className="s11-reason-row">
              <div className="ico app-geo-warn">
                <ExtIcon name="lock" size={18} />
              </div>
              <div className="body">
                <div className="noc-body app-geo-primary">{row[0]}</div>
                <div className="noc-caption app-geo-tertiary">{row[1]}</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="s11-reason-row">
            <div className="ico">
              <ExtIcon name="file-text" size={18} />
            </div>
            <div className="body">
              <div className="noc-body app-geo-primary">{GEO_TEXT.why}</div>
              <div className="noc-caption app-geo-tertiary">{GEO_TEXT.whySub}</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="banner app-geo-banner">
          <ExtIcon name="info" size={18} />
          <div>
            <div className="noc-body-sm app-geo-primary">{GEO_TEXT.lifts}</div>
            <div className="noc-caption app-geo-tertiary app-geo-disclosure">{GEO_TEXT.rechecked}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        {reason === null ? null : (
          <div className="s11-stillworks">
            <div className="head">
              <ExtIcon name="check" size={18} />
              <span className="noc-overline app-geo-works">{GEO_TEXT.works}</span>
            </div>
            <ul>
              <li>{GEO_TEXT.sendReceive}</li>
              <li>{GEO_TEXT.balances}</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        )}
      </>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="screen">
      <TopBar title={GEO_TEXT.title} titleClass="noc-h1-compact" onBack={onBack} trailing={close} />
      <div className="app-geo-body">{body}</div>
      <div className="sticky-bar">
        <button type="button" className="btn btn-primary" onClick={onDone}>
          {GEO_TEXT.gotIt}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

Each was opened and compared. **Found and fixed (in this commit):** the hero's headline and sub stood apart by their UA margins (the mockup sets none) → `.s11-geo-hero h2, .s11-geo-hero p {margin: 0}`; the region card's two lines stood 28 px apart — web's `design-system.css` defines a layout `.col` (flex column, 28 px gap) that collides with the design's own `.col` → `.s11-geo-region .col {display: block}`. **Departures kept (each in §9 or a Writer note):** the flag tile, "claim_ix", "Stake existing NOC", the post-TGE claim line and "View portfolio" (§9); the open variant's region line (rev 1 named no country; rev 2 adds the detected region, D22 — shot by Task 9's visual spec); Section XI's `.topbar` / `.t-title` / `.sticky-bottom-bar` are the design's aliases of the canonical shell — drawn with `TopBar` (`noc-h1-compact` = `.t-title`'s 600 17/22 −0.01em) and `.sticky-bar`; #11's quick row keeps the design's four-column grid with three actions (Swap stays removed, §4.5); the banner's price is #23's "$ 0.1501" (the program's four decimals, §9) where the mockup draws "$0.025".

Task 9 shoots #48 with F12 (the dry-run shots of Step 5).

**What F12 decides, and where.** Detection is the background's, from the page's bytes: a top-level instruction whose program (a static key) is the presale program and whose first 8 data bytes are one of the six purchase discriminators of `presaleIdl.ts`, whether or not the rest parses (an unparsable one is also F1). Only then is the jurisdiction gate asked — on every simulation (`runSimulation`, beside the recipients, C12) and again at every approval (`decide`, after the pre-section's checks and before the re-authentication gate, so a refusal issues no challenge and burns nothing); a gate that throws is `no_check`. The answer is stored with the simulation (`presaleRegion`) and every transaction carrying a purchase gets F12 `{kind: 'presale-region', severity: 'refuse', word: null, at: <its first purchase>, reason}` when the answer is not open. `refuse` is a third severity: it sorts before every block, `expectedOverrides` never asks a word for it, and `txRefused` answers `presale-region` for any F12 right after the failed-simulation row and before the words — so no word, no re-authentication and no setting approves it. A closed answer at the decision re-simulates the request (awaited) so #48 shows the F12 it now has; the deciding section itself refuses a purchase the gate was not asked open for in that same call (the first, unsectioned read can miss an entry). An open answer adds nothing: the purchase stays B1c's F2 warning. The window computes nothing (C13): it renders F12 first in its transaction's section — Q49, Q50a with `regionName(countryCode)` for `sanctioned` (the country is the stored answer's, carried in `FlagView`), Q50b for every other reason, Q51 — sets the eyebrow "Critical · Blocked transaction", draws no typed field and no Approve, only Reject. All of it is shared code: the off build blocks exactly when the on build does (D15) — the two new test files run in both vitest runs with the same answers.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing tests.**

The background (`presaleRegion.test.ts`, new — runs in both vitest runs): the detection of the six purchases (and of nothing else), redFlagsOf for each purchase × each closed reason × open × not asked, the sort, the stored form; then against the real background (`txScene`) each purchase × the gate closed / unreachable / throwing / open through `dapp.decide`, the row order with every word given and a proven challenge, a batch, `register_referrer`, the decision asking the gate again (a spy), a forged stored simulation, and the deciding section when the first read missed the entry.

Create `extension/src/background/dapp/__tests__/presaleRegion.test.ts`:

```ts
import {base64} from '@scure/base';
import {PublicKey, TransactionInstruction} from '@solana/web3.js';
import type {GeoAnswer, GeoReason} from '../../geo/gate';
import {decodeInstructions} from '../decode/decode';
import {resolveKeys} from '../decode/keys';
import {PRESALE_INSTRUCTIONS} from '../decode/presaleIdl';
import {parseWire} from '../decode/wire';
import {PRESALE_PURCHASES, expectedOverrides, overridesMatch, presalePurchasesOf, redFlagsOf, storedFlagsOf, type RedFlag, type RedFlagInput} from '../redFlags';
import {DAPP_SESSION_KEY, readDappSession, type Entry} from '../store';
import {carriesPurchase, dappAbout, dappDigest, txRefused} from '../signTx';
import {simStateOf} from '../simulate';
import {issueChallenge, satisfyChallenge} from '../../reauthChallenges';
import {ACCOUNT, RECIPIENT} from '../../__tests__/fixtures';
import {ME, assign, presaleIx, transfer, txScene, v0} from './txHarness';

/**
 * B1d §3.6 (D9, D15, C31): F12 — a site's presale purchase is a refusal with no override whenever the extension's
 * jurisdiction gate is closed or unreachable, in both builds (this file runs in both vitest runs, with the same
 * answers). Against the real background: the detection, redFlagsOf, the stored form, txRefused's row, and dapp.decide
 * asking the gate again before `deciding`.
 */
const off = process.env.NOCTURA_PRESALE === '0';
const OTHER = new PublicKey(new Uint8Array(32).fill(91));
const parsed = (instructions: TransactionInstruction[]) => {
  const p = parseWire(base64.decode(v0(instructions)));
  if (p === null) throw new Error('unparsable');
  return p;
};
/** redFlagsOf over one simulated transaction (nothing read before or after), with the gate's answer. */
function flagsOf(instructions: TransactionInstruction[], region?: GeoAnswer | null): RedFlag[] {
  const tx = parsed(instructions);
  const input: RedFlagInput = {account: ME.toBase58(), txs: [{tx, decoded: decodeInstructions(tx, resolveKeys(tx, new Map())), pre: new Map(), outcome: {status: 'simulated', post: new Map()}, firstSend: false}], mints: new Map(), reasons: [], ...(region === undefined ? {} : {region})};
  return redFlagsOf(input)[0] ?? [];
}

const OPEN: GeoAnswer = {open: true, reason: null, countryCode: 'SI'};
const CLOSED: readonly {reason: GeoReason; countryCode: string | null}[] = [
  {reason: 'sanctioned', countryCode: 'KP'},
  {reason: 'stale_list', countryCode: 'SI'},
  {reason: 'unknown_country', countryCode: null},
  {reason: 'no_check', countryCode: null},
  {reason: 'refused', countryCode: null},
];
const closed = (c: {reason: GeoReason; countryCode: string | null}): GeoAnswer => ({open: false, ...c});
const REFUSED = (error: string) => ({ok: false, error});

describe(`F12: detection (${off ? 'off' : 'on'} build)`, () => {
  it('the six purchase instructions of the IDL, by program and discriminator — whether or not the rest parses; no other presale instruction, no other program', () => {
    expect(PRESALE_PURCHASES).toEqual(['presale_purchase_with_sol', 'presale_purchase_with_usdc', 'presale_purchase_with_usdt', 'presale_purchase_and_vest_stake', 'presale_purchase_usdc_and_vest_stake', 'presale_purchase_usdt_and_vest_stake']);
    expect(PRESALE_INSTRUCTIONS.filter(x => x.name.startsWith('presale_purchase')).map(x => x.name).sort()).toEqual([...PRESALE_PURCHASES].sort());
    for (const name of PRESALE_PURCHASES) expect([name, presalePurchasesOf(parsed([transfer(), presaleIx(name)]))]).toEqual([name, [1]]);
    // Every other instruction of the program — claims, the referral, the admin's — is not a purchase.
    for (const x of PRESALE_INSTRUCTIONS.filter(i => !PRESALE_PURCHASES.includes(i.name))) expect([x.name, presalePurchasesOf(parsed([presaleIx(x.name)]))]).toEqual([x.name, []]);
    const sol = PRESALE_INSTRUCTIONS.find(x => x.name === 'presale_purchase_with_sol');
    if (sol === undefined) throw new Error('no presale_purchase_with_sol');
    // The discriminator alone (its argument missing): still a purchase, and the decoder's unknown program (F1).
    const bare = presaleIx('presale_purchase_with_sol', {data: [...sol.discriminator]});
    expect(presalePurchasesOf(parsed([bare]))).toEqual([0]);
    expect(decodeInstructions(parsed([bare]), resolveKeys(parsed([bare]), new Map()))[0]?.program).toBeNull();
    // Seven bytes of it, or the same bytes under another program: not a purchase.
    expect(presalePurchasesOf(parsed([presaleIx('presale_purchase_with_sol', {data: sol.discriminator.slice(0, 7)})]))).toEqual([]);
    expect(presalePurchasesOf(parsed([new TransactionInstruction({programId: OTHER, data: Buffer.from([...sol.discriminator, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]), keys: [{pubkey: ME, isSigner: true, isWritable: true}]})]))).toEqual([]);
    // Two purchases: both indexes; F12 names the first.
    expect(presalePurchasesOf(parsed([presaleIx('presale_purchase_with_usdc'), transfer(), presaleIx('presale_purchase_with_sol')]))).toEqual([0, 2]);
  });
});

describe(`F12: redFlagsOf (${off ? 'off' : 'on'} build)`, () => {
  it('each purchase × each closed reason → F12 with that reason at the purchase, a refusal no word opens; open → no F12, the purchase F2 as before; not asked → no_check', () => {
    for (const name of PRESALE_PURCHASES) {
      for (const c of CLOSED) {
        const flags = flagsOf([transfer(), presaleIx(name)], closed(c));
        expect([name, c.reason, flags[0]]).toEqual([name, c.reason, {kind: 'presale-region', severity: 'refuse', word: null, at: 1, reason: c.reason}]);
        expect(expectedOverrides([flags])).toEqual([]);
        // No word belongs to it: any word given is a mismatch, none is "ok" — which is why txRefused's row precedes the words.
        expect(overridesMatch([flags], [{tx: 0, word: 'PRESALE'}])).toBe('mismatch');
      }
      expect([name, flagsOf([presaleIx(name)], undefined)[0]]).toEqual([name, {kind: 'presale-region', severity: 'refuse', word: null, at: 0, reason: 'no_check'}]);
      expect([name, flagsOf([presaleIx(name)], null)[0]?.kind]).toEqual([name, 'presale-region']);
      // A closed answer without a reason is still closed.
      expect([name, flagsOf([presaleIx(name)], {open: false, reason: null, countryCode: null})[0]]).toEqual([name, {kind: 'presale-region', severity: 'refuse', word: null, at: 0, reason: 'no_check'}]);
      // Positive control: the gate open — no F12; F2 names the purchase, as B1c does today.
      const open = flagsOf([presaleIx(name)], OPEN);
      expect([name, open]).toEqual([name, [{kind: 'non-transfer', severity: 'warn', word: null, at: 0, instructions: [{index: 0, program: 'presale', name}]}]]);
    }
  });

  it('a non-purchase presale instruction (register_referrer) is no F12, whatever the gate says', () => {
    for (const region of [closed({reason: 'sanctioned', countryCode: 'KP'}), null, undefined]) {
      expect(flagsOf([presaleIx('register_referrer')], region).map(f => f.kind)).toEqual(['non-transfer']);
    }
  });

  it('F12 sorts before every block and every warning, wherever its instruction is', () => {
    const flags = flagsOf([assign(), transfer(), presaleIx('presale_purchase_with_sol')], closed({reason: 'no_check', countryCode: null}));
    expect(flags.map(f => [f.kind, f.severity, f.at])).toEqual([
      ['presale-region', 'refuse', 2],
      ['assign', 'block', 0],
      ['non-transfer', 'warn', 2],
    ]);
  });

  it('the stored F12 is read back exactly; a word, another severity, an unknown reason, no index or a key more is not', () => {
    const f12 = {kind: 'presale-region', severity: 'refuse', word: null, at: 2, reason: 'stale_list'};
    expect(storedFlagsOf([f12])).toEqual([f12]);
    for (const reason of CLOSED.map(c => c.reason)) expect(storedFlagsOf([{...f12, reason}])).toEqual([{...f12, reason}]);
    const bad: unknown[] = [{...f12, word: 'PRESALE'}, {...f12, severity: 'block'}, {...f12, severity: 'warn'}, {...f12, reason: 'vpn'}, {...f12, reason: null}, {...f12, at: null}, {...f12, at: -1}, {...f12, countryCode: 'SI'}, {kind: 'presale-region', severity: 'refuse', word: null, at: 2}];
    for (const b of bad) expect([b, storedFlagsOf([b])]).toEqual([b, null]);
  });
});

describe(`F12 through the background (${off ? 'off' : 'on'} build)`, () => {
  /** A queued request of these transactions, simulated with the gate answering `geo` (a spy). */
  async function scene(wires: string[], geo: () => Promise<GeoAnswer>) {
    const c = await txScene({known: [RECIPIENT]});
    const asked = vi.fn(geo);
    c.deps.geo = asked;
    const requestId = String((await c.signTx('t', wires))?.requestId);
    const view = await c.simulated();
    const simulation = String(view.request?.tx?.simulation.id);
    const approve = (overrides?: {tx: number; word: string}[], sim = simulation) => c.decide({requestId, decision: 'approve', account: ACCOUNT.publicKey, simulation: sim, ...(overrides === undefined ? {} : {overrides})});
    const stored = async (): Promise<Entry> => {
      const e = await c.entry(requestId);
      if (e === undefined) throw new Error('no entry');
      return e;
    };
    const signed = () => c.page.answersFor(requestId).filter(a => 'result' in a);
    return {...c, asked, requestId, view, simulation, approve, stored, signed};
  }
  const flagsIn = (view: {request: {tx: Record<string, unknown> | null} | null}) => (view.request?.tx?.transactions as {flags: {kind: string; reason?: string; countryCode?: string | null}[] | null}[] | undefined)?.map(t => t.flags);

  it('each purchase × the gate closed, unreachable or throwing → F12 shown, and dapp.decide refuses `presale-region` — nothing decided, nothing signed; open → no F12, approved and signed', async () => {
    const answers: [string, () => Promise<GeoAnswer>, string, string | null][] = [
      ...CLOSED.map((c): [string, () => Promise<GeoAnswer>, string, string | null] => [c.reason, async () => closed(c), c.reason, c.countryCode]),
      [
        'throws',
        async () => {
          throw new Error('the gate failed');
        },
        'no_check',
        null,
      ],
    ];
    for (const name of PRESALE_PURCHASES) {
      for (const [label, geo, reason, countryCode] of answers) {
        const c = await scene([v0([presaleIx(name)])], geo);
        expect([name, label, flagsIn(c.view)]).toEqual([name, label, [[{kind: 'presale-region', severity: 'refuse', word: null, at: 0, reason, countryCode}, {kind: 'non-transfer', severity: 'warn', word: null, at: 0, instructions: [{index: 0, program: 'presale', name}]}]]]);
        expect([name, label, (await c.stored()).sim]).toMatchObject([name, label, {status: 'ok', sim: {presaleRegion: {open: false, reason, countryCode}}}]);
        expect([name, label, await c.approve()]).toEqual([name, label, REFUSED('presale-region')]);
        expect([name, label, (await c.stored()).state, (await c.stored()).challengeId, c.signed()]).toEqual([name, label, 'queued', null, []]);
      }
      const c = await scene([v0([presaleIx(name)])], async () => OPEN);
      expect([name, flagsIn(c.view)?.[0]?.map(f => f.kind)]).toEqual([name, ['non-transfer']]);
      expect([name, await c.approve()]).toEqual([name, {ok: true}]);
      expect([name, c.signed().length]).toEqual([name, 1]);
    }
  });

  it('txRefused: `presale-region` with every word given and a proven re-authentication — the row stands after `simulation-failed`, before the words', async () => {
    // F12 beside F3's block in one transaction: the block's word and a challenge proven for exactly this request.
    const c = await scene([v0([assign(), presaleIx('presale_purchase_with_sol')])], async () => closed({reason: 'sanctioned', countryCode: 'KP'}));
    expect(await c.approve([{tx: 0, word: 'ASSIGN'}])).toEqual(REFUSED('presale-region'));
    expect((await c.stored()).challengeId).toBeNull();
    const e = await c.stored();
    const about = dappAbout(e, 'dapp.test', 10_000);
    if (about === null) throw new Error('no description');
    const id = await issueChallenge(c.ext, c.deps, dappDigest(e), about);
    expect(await satisfyChallenge(c.ext, c.deps.now(), id)).toBe(true);
    const s = await readDappSession(c.ext);
    await c.ext.session.set(DAPP_SESSION_KEY, {...s, queue: s.queue.map(x => (x.requestId === c.requestId ? {...x, challengeId: id} : x))});
    expect(txRefused({...(await c.stored()), challengeId: id}, c.simulation, [{tx: 0, word: 'ASSIGN'}], c.deps.now())).toBe('presale-region');
    for (const words of [[{tx: 0, word: 'ASSIGN'}], [], [{tx: 0, word: 'PRESALE'}]]) expect(await c.approve(words)).toEqual(REFUSED('presale-region'));
    expect([(await c.stored()).state, c.signed()]).toEqual(['queued', []]);
    // The row order: a failed simulation is still `simulation-failed` beside an F12; a stale id still `stale`.
    const failed = await c.stored();
    if (failed.sim?.status !== 'ok') throw new Error('not simulated');
    const sim = failed.sim.sim;
    expect(txRefused({...failed, sim: {status: 'ok', sim: {...sim, outcomes: [{ok: false, error: 'failed', detail: 'x'}]}}}, c.simulation, [], c.deps.now())).toBe('simulation-failed');
    expect(txRefused(failed, 'N'.repeat(22), [], c.deps.now())).toBe('stale');
    // Positive control: the gate open, the same block — its word and the proof sign it.
    const ok = await scene([v0([assign(), presaleIx('presale_purchase_with_sol')])], async () => OPEN);
    expect(await ok.approve([{tx: 0, word: 'ASSIGN'}])).toEqual(REFUSED('reauth-required'));
    expect(await ok.reauthOk(String((await ok.stored()).challengeId))).toEqual({ok: true});
    expect(await ok.approve([{tx: 0, word: 'ASSIGN'}])).toEqual({ok: true});
    expect(ok.signed().length).toBe(1);
  });

  it('a batch with one purchase among other transactions: F12 on that transaction only, the whole request refused; open → approved as a whole', async () => {
    const wires = [v0([transfer(1)]), v0([transfer(2), presaleIx('presale_purchase_usdt_and_vest_stake')]), v0([transfer(3)])];
    const c = await scene(wires, async () => closed({reason: 'refused', countryCode: null}));
    expect(flagsIn(c.view)?.map(l => l?.filter(f => f.kind === 'presale-region').map(f => f.reason))).toEqual([[], ['refused'], []]);
    expect(c.asked).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(await c.approve()).toEqual(REFUSED('presale-region'));
    expect(c.signed()).toEqual([]);
    const ok = await scene(wires, async () => OPEN);
    expect(await ok.approve()).toEqual({ok: true});
    expect((ok.signed()[0]?.result as {signed: string[]}).signed).toHaveLength(3);
  });

  it('a non-purchase presale instruction (register_referrer): the gate is never asked, no F12, approvable', async () => {
    const c = await scene([v0([presaleIx('register_referrer')])], async () => closed({reason: 'sanctioned', countryCode: 'KP'}));
    expect(flagsIn(c.view)?.[0]?.map(f => f.kind)).toEqual(['non-transfer']);
    expect(carriesPurchase(await c.stored())).toBe(false);
    expect(await c.approve()).toEqual({ok: true});
    expect(c.asked).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect((await c.stored())?.sim).toMatchObject({status: 'ok', sim: {presaleRegion: null}});
  });

  it('the decision asks the gate again: open at the simulation, closed at the approval → `presale-region` before `deciding` (no challenge, nothing signed), re-simulated with the F12 it now has; open again → signed', async () => {
    let answer: GeoAnswer = OPEN;
    const c = await scene([v0([presaleIx('presale_purchase_with_usdc')])], async () => answer);
    expect(flagsIn(c.view)?.[0]?.map(f => f.kind)).toEqual(['non-transfer']);
    expect(c.asked).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    answer = closed({reason: 'stale_list', countryCode: 'SI'});
    expect(await c.approve()).toEqual(REFUSED('presale-region'));
    // Asked at the decision, then by the re-simulation; the entry never left `queued`.
    expect(c.asked).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3);
    const e = await c.stored();
    expect([e.state, e.decidedBy, e.challengeId, c.signed()]).toEqual(['queued', null, null, []]);
    expect(e.sim?.status === 'ok' ? [e.sim.sim.id === c.simulation, e.sim.sim.flags[0]?.[0]] : null).toEqual([false, {kind: 'presale-region', severity: 'refuse', word: null, at: 0, reason: 'stale_list'}]);
    // The refresh's answer is what the window now shows; the old simulation's id is stale.
    const view = await c.pend();
    expect(flagsIn(view)?.[0]?.[0]).toEqual({kind: 'presale-region', severity: 'refuse', word: null, at: 0, reason: 'stale_list', countryCode: 'SI'});
    const fresh = String(view.request?.tx?.simulation.id);
    expect(await c.approve(undefined, fresh)).toEqual(REFUSED('presale-region'));
    // The gate opens again: the next simulation drops F12, and the decision (asking again) signs.
    answer = OPEN;
    c.deps.clock.t += 30_000;
    const reopened = await c.simulated(fresh);
    expect(flagsIn(reopened)?.[0]?.map(f => f.kind)).toEqual(['non-transfer']);
    const calls = c.asked.mock.calls.length;
    expect(await c.approve(undefined, String(reopened.request?.tx?.simulation.id))).toEqual({ok: true});
    expect(c.asked).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(calls + 1);
    expect(c.signed().length).toBe(1);
  });

  it('a forged approval of a stored simulation that lost its F12: refused — read back invalid, or the decision’s own gate', async () => {
    const c = await scene([v0([presaleIx('presale_purchase_with_sol')])], async () => closed({reason: 'no_check', countryCode: null}));
    const e = await c.stored();
    if (e.sim?.status !== 'ok') throw new Error('not simulated');
    // The F12 dropped but the closed answer kept: the stored simulation does not read back (simulated again).
    const dropped = {...e.sim.sim, flags: [e.sim.sim.flags[0]?.filter(f => f.kind !== 'presale-region') ?? []]};
    expect(simStateOf(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify({status: 'ok', sim: dropped})))).toBeNull();
    // The F12 kept beside no answer, or beside an open one: the same.
    for (const presaleRegion of [null, OPEN]) expect([presaleRegion, simStateOf(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify({status: 'ok', sim: {...e.sim.sim, presaleRegion}})))]).toEqual([presaleRegion, null]);
    // An F12 whose reason is not the stored answer's, or a stored answer of another shape: the same.
    const other = {...e.sim.sim, flags: [e.sim.sim.flags[0]?.map(f => (f.kind === 'presale-region' ? {...f, reason: 'sanctioned' as const} : f)) ?? []]};
    expect(simStateOf(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify({status: 'ok', sim: other})))).toBeNull();
    for (const presaleRegion of [{open: true, reason: 'no_check', countryCode: null}, {open: false, reason: null, countryCode: null}, {open: false, reason: 'no_check', countryCode: 'si'}, {open: false, reason: 'no_check'}, undefined]) {
      expect([presaleRegion, simStateOf(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify({status: 'ok', sim: {...e.sim.sim, presaleRegion}})))]).toEqual([presaleRegion, null]);
    }
    expect(simStateOf(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify({status: 'ok', sim: e.sim.sim})))).toEqual({status: 'ok', sim: e.sim.sim});
    // Both rewritten (no F12, an open answer) — what the window then shows approvable — and the gate still closed:
    // the decision asks it and refuses.
    const forged = {...e.sim.sim, flags: [dropped.flags[0] ?? []], presaleRegion: OPEN};
    const s = await readDappSession(c.ext);
    await c.ext.session.set(DAPP_SESSION_KEY, {...s, queue: s.queue.map(x => (x.requestId === c.requestId ? {...x, sim: {status: 'ok', sim: forged}} : x))});
    expect(await c.approve()).toEqual(REFUSED('presale-region'));
    expect([(await c.stored()).state, c.signed()]).toEqual(['queued', []]);
  });

  it('the decision’s own section refuses a purchase the gate was not asked open for — even when the first read missed the entry', async () => {
    const c = await scene([v0([presaleIx('presale_purchase_with_sol')])], async () => OPEN);
    // The gate closes; the decision's first, unsectioned read (the peek) misses the entry, so neither the pre-section
    // nor the gate runs before the deciding section.
    c.deps.geo = async () => closed({reason: 'sanctioned', countryCode: 'KP'});
    const get = c.ext.session.get.bind(c.ext.session);
    let hide = true;
    c.ext.session.get = async (k: string) => {
      if (k === DAPP_SESSION_KEY && hide) {
        hide = false;
        return undefined;
      }
      return get(k);
    };
    expect(await c.approve()).toEqual(REFUSED('presale-region'));
    expect([hide, (await c.stored()).state, c.signed()]).toEqual([false, 'queued', []]);
  });
});
```

The approval window (`presaleRegion.test.tsx`, new — runs in both vitest runs): against the real background, Q49 / Q50a (the country's name) / Q51 for a sanctioned region, Q50b for every fail-closed reason, `Intl.DisplayNames` throwing → the code, the gate open (positive control), a refresh that changes the answer, a batch; and as the window reads it: `pendingOf`'s F12, F12 beside a failed simulation, a lookalike origin.

Create `extension/src/approve/__tests__/presaleRegion.test.tsx`:

```tsx
// @vitest-environment happy-dom
import {cleanup, render, screen} from '@testing-library/react';
import {UI_SHEETS, selectorsOf, unstyledClasses} from '../../__tests__/styled';
import type {GeoAnswer} from '../../background/geo/gate';
import {readDappSession} from '../../background/dapp/store';
import {ACCOUNT, RECIPIENT} from '../../background/__tests__/fixtures';
import {presaleIx, transfer, v0} from '../../background/dapp/__tests__/txHarness';
import {pendingOf, type Flag, type RequestView} from '../client';
import {Tx} from '../Tx';
import {FLAG_HOLD_MS} from '../useArmed';
import {acted, elapse, onHarnessClock, openWindow, settled} from './windowHarness';

/**
 * B1d §3.6 (D9, D15, C31): #48 with F12 — the background's refusal of a site's presale purchase while the jurisdiction
 * gate is not open, rendered as stored: Q49's head, Q50a (the country's name) or Q50b, Q51; the eyebrow "Critical ·
 * Blocked transaction"; no typed field and no Approve — only Reject. Runs in both vitest runs (D15).
 */
const off = process.env.NOCTURA_PRESALE === '0';
const SELECTORS = selectorsOf(UI_SHEETS);
const Q49 = 'Presale purchase blocked';
const Q50A = (country: string) => `This transaction buys NOC in the presale, which this wallet doesn't allow from your region (${country}).`;
const Q50B = "This transaction buys NOC in the presale. The wallet's region check did not succeed, so it can't be approved — try again later.";
const Q51 = 'Only Reject is available · no override';
const OPEN: GeoAnswer = {open: true, reason: null, countryCode: 'SI'};
const banners = () =>
  [...document.querySelectorAll('.app-tx-item .s9-flag-banner')].map(b => ({
    tone: b.className.replace('s9-flag-banner ', ''),
    head: b.querySelector('.head')?.textContent,
    body: [...b.querySelectorAll('.body')].map(e => e.textContent),
    meta: [...b.querySelectorAll('.meta')].map(e => e.textContent),
  }));
/** The sticky bar's CTAs (the top bar's ✕ is not one). */
const buttons = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('.sticky-bar button')].map(b => b.textContent);
const F2 = (name: string) => ({tone: 'warn', head: 'Instructions that are not transfers', body: ['Each can do more than move a balance. Check what it does before approving.'], meta: [`#1 noctura_presale::${name.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}${name.slice(1)}`]});
onHarnessClock();

async function shown(geo: () => Promise<GeoAnswer>, shows: string, instructions = [presaleIx('presale_purchase_with_sol')]) {
  const w = await openWindow();
  await w.ext.local.set('v1_known_recipients', [{address: RECIPIENT, at: 1}]);
  w.deps.geo = geo;
  const r = await w.signTx('https://presale.example', [v0(instructions)]);
  w.show();
  await settled(async () => expect((await readDappSession(w.ext)).queue[0]?.sim ?? null).not.toBeNull());
  await acted(() => window.dispatchEvent(new Event('focus')));
  await settled(() => screen.getAllByText(shows));
  return {...w, ...r};
}

describe(`#48 F12 (${off ? 'off' : 'on'} build)`, () => {
  it('sanctioned: Q49, Q50a with the country’s name, Q51 — first in the section, before F2; the eyebrow; no typed field, no Approve; Reject rejects', async () => {
    const w = await shown(async () => ({open: false, reason: 'sanctioned', countryCode: 'KP'}), Q49);
    expect(banners()).toEqual([{tone: 'danger', head: Q49, body: [Q50A('North Korea')], meta: [Q51]}, F2('presale_purchase_with_sol')]);
    expect([document.querySelector('.top-bar .title')?.textContent, document.querySelector('.top-bar .title')?.className]).toEqual(['Critical · Blocked transaction', 'title noc-overline noc-danger']);
    expect(document.querySelector('.s9-typed-confirm')).toBeNull();
    expect(document.querySelector('.s9-origin-pill')).toBeNull();
    // Past every hold: still nothing but Reject.
    await elapse(FLAG_HOLD_MS);
    expect(buttons()).toEqual(['Reject']);
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', {name: /Approve/})).toBeNull();
    expect(unstyledClasses(document.querySelector('.app-approve')!, SELECTORS)).toEqual([]);
    screen.getByRole('button', {name: 'Reject'}).click();
    await settled(() => expect(w.closed.n).toBe(1));
    expect(w.page.answersFor(w.requestId).map(a => a.error)).toEqual(['rejected']);
  });

  it('every fail-closed reason — a stale list (a country known), an unknown country, no check, a refusal, the gate throwing: Q50b, the country never named; only Reject', async () => {
    const answers: (() => Promise<GeoAnswer>)[] = [
      async () => ({open: false, reason: 'stale_list', countryCode: 'SI'}),
      async () => ({open: false, reason: 'unknown_country', countryCode: null}),
      async () => ({open: false, reason: 'no_check', countryCode: null}),
      async () => ({open: false, reason: 'refused', countryCode: null}),
      async () => {
        throw new Error('the gate failed');
      },
    ];
    for (const geo of answers) {
      await shown(geo, Q49);
      expect(banners()[0]).toEqual({tone: 'danger', head: Q49, body: [Q50B], meta: [Q51]});
      expect(document.body.textContent?.includes('Slovenia')).toBe(false);
      await elapse(FLAG_HOLD_MS);
      expect(buttons()).toEqual(['Reject']);
      cleanup();
    }
  });

  it('the country’s name when Intl.DisplayNames throws: the code itself (B1d §6.1, the window half)', async () => {
    const real = Intl.DisplayNames;
    vi.spyOn(Intl, 'DisplayNames').mockImplementation(() => {
      throw new RangeError('no display names');
    });
    try {
      await shown(async () => ({open: false, reason: 'sanctioned', countryCode: 'KP'}), Q49);
      expect(banners()[0]?.body).toEqual([Q50A('KP')]);
    } finally {
      vi.mocked(Intl.DisplayNames).mockRestore();
    }
    expect(Intl.DisplayNames).toBe(real);
  });

  it('the gate open: no F12 — F2 as before, Approve drawn and signing (positive control)', async () => {
    const w = await shown(async () => OPEN, 'Instructions that are not transfers');
    expect(banners()).toEqual([F2('presale_purchase_with_sol')]);
    await elapse(FLAG_HOLD_MS);
    expect(buttons()).toEqual(['Reject', 'Approve']);
    screen.getByRole('button', {name: 'Approve'}).click();
    await settled(() => expect(w.closed.n).toBe(1));
    expect(w.page.answersFor(w.requestId)).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('a refresh that changes the gate’s answer re-evaluates: open → Approve; closed at the 30 s refresh → F12, only Reject; open again → Approve', async () => {
    let answer: GeoAnswer = OPEN;
    const w = await shown(async () => answer, 'Instructions that are not transfers');
    await elapse(FLAG_HOLD_MS);
    expect(buttons()).toEqual(['Reject', 'Approve']);
    const refresh = async () => {
      const before = (await readDappSession(w.ext)).queue[0]?.sim;
      w.deps.clock.t += 30_000;
      await acted(() => document.dispatchEvent(new Event('visibilitychange')));
      await settled(async () => expect((await readDappSession(w.ext)).queue[0]?.sim).not.toEqual(before));
      await acted(() => document.dispatchEvent(new Event('visibilitychange')));
    };
    answer = {open: false, reason: 'sanctioned', countryCode: 'IR'};
    await refresh();
    await settled(() => screen.getByText(Q49));
    expect(banners()[0]).toEqual({tone: 'danger', head: Q49, body: [Q50A('Iran')], meta: [Q51]});
    await elapse(FLAG_HOLD_MS);
    expect(buttons()).toEqual(['Reject']);
    answer = OPEN;
    await refresh();
    await settled(() => expect(screen.queryByText(Q49)).toBeNull());
    await elapse(FLAG_HOLD_MS);
    expect(buttons()).toEqual(['Reject', 'Approve']);
  });

  it('a batch: F12 in the purchase’s own section; the request has only Reject', async () => {
    const w = await openWindow();
    await w.ext.local.set('v1_known_recipients', [{address: RECIPIENT, at: 1}]);
    w.deps.geo = async () => ({open: false, reason: 'no_check', countryCode: null});
    await w.signTx('https://presale.example', [v0([transfer(1)]), v0([presaleIx('presale_purchase_usdc_and_vest_stake')])]);
    w.show();
    await settled(async () => expect((await readDappSession(w.ext)).queue[0]?.sim ?? null).not.toBeNull());
    await acted(() => window.dispatchEvent(new Event('focus')));
    await settled(() => screen.getByText(Q49));
    const sections = [...document.querySelectorAll('.app-tx-item')];
    expect(sections.map(s => [...s.querySelectorAll('.s9-flag-banner .head')].map(h => h.textContent))).toEqual([[], [Q49, 'Instructions that are not transfers']]);
    await elapse(FLAG_HOLD_MS);
    expect(buttons()).toEqual(['Reject']);
  });
});

describe(`#48 F12 as the window reads it (${off ? 'off' : 'on'} build)`, () => {
  const f12: Flag = {kind: 'presale-region', severity: 'refuse', word: null, at: 0, reason: 'sanctioned', countryCode: 'KP'};
  const request = (flags: unknown[], site: RequestView['site'] = {kind: 'verified', name: 'Jupiter', imitates: null, rule: null, idn: null, international: false}) => ({
    requestId: 'f',
    type: 'signTransaction',
    origin: 'https://jup.ag',
    host: 'jup.ag',
    site,
    offerBlock: false,
    connect: null,
    sign: null,
    mismatch: null,
    tx: {
      kind: 'signTransaction',
      account: {index: 0, name: 'Main', publicKey: ACCOUNT.publicKey},
      simulation: {status: 'ok', id: 'AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA', slot: 1, elapsedMs: 1, at: 1},
      reauth: null,
      labels: [],
      transactions: [{version: 0, feePayer: ACCOUNT.publicKey, unitLimit: null, feeLamports: null, outcome: {ok: true, changes: [], unitsConsumed: 1, unitLimit: 200_000, feeLamports: null}, instructions: [], flags}],
    },
  });
  const read = (flags: unknown[]) => pendingOf({state: 'request', request: request(flags), waiting: 0, windowNotice: false});

  it('pendingOf reads F12 exactly; a word, another severity, an unknown reason, a lower-case or missing country, a key more: the detail refused (Q26)', () => {
    const view = read([f12]);
    expect(view?.state === 'request' ? view.request.tx?.transactions[0]?.flags : null).toEqual([f12]);
    expect(read([{...f12, countryCode: null}])).not.toBeNull();
    const bad = [{...f12, word: 'PRESALE'}, {...f12, severity: 'block'}, {...f12, reason: 'vpn'}, {...f12, countryCode: 'kp'}, {...f12, countryCode: 'KPX'}, {kind: 'presale-region', severity: 'refuse', word: null, at: 0, reason: 'sanctioned'}, {...f12, extra: 1}, {...f12, at: null}];
    for (const b of bad) {
      const v = read([b]);
      expect([b, v?.state === 'request' ? v.request.tx : 'unread']).toEqual([b, null]);
    }
  });

  it('F12 beside a failed simulation: "Couldn’t simulate" and the F12 banner, the eyebrow still "Critical · Blocked transaction", only Reject', () => {
    const raw = request([f12]);
    const v = pendingOf({state: 'request', request: {...raw, tx: {...raw.tx, transactions: [{...raw.tx.transactions[0], outcome: {ok: false, error: 'failed', detail: '{"InstructionError":[0,"Custom"]}'}}]}}, waiting: 0, windowNotice: false});
    if (v?.state !== 'request') throw new Error('not read');
    render(<Tx request={v.request} waiting={0} notice={false} busy={false} onDecide={() => Promise.resolve(undefined)} />);
    expect([document.querySelector('.top-bar .title')?.textContent, document.querySelector('.top-bar .title')?.className]).toEqual(['Critical · Blocked transaction', 'title noc-overline noc-danger']);
    expect([...document.querySelectorAll('.s9-flag-banner .head')].map(h => h.textContent)).toEqual(["Couldn't simulate", Q49]);
    expect(buttons()).toEqual(['Reject']);
  });

    const site: RequestView['site'] = {kind: 'lookalike', name: 'jup', imitates: 'jup.ag', rule: 'edit', idn: null, international: false};
    const v = pendingOf({state: 'request', request: request([f12], site), waiting: 0, windowNotice: false});
    if (v?.state !== 'request') throw new Error('not read');
    render(<Tx request={v.request} waiting={0} notice={false} busy={false} onDecide={() => Promise.resolve(undefined)} />);
    expect(buttons()).toEqual(['Reject and report', 'Reject']);
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', {name: /Approve/})).toBeNull();
    expect(banners()[0]?.head).toBe(Q49);
  });
});
```

```diff
+export function presaleIx(name: string, o: {data?: number[]} = {}): TransactionInstruction {
+  const row = PRESALE_INSTRUCTIONS.find(x => x.name === name);
+  if (row === undefined) throw new Error(`no presale instruction ${name}`);
+  const args = row.args.flatMap(a => (a.type === 'u64' || a.type === 'i64' ? u64le(1_000_000n) : a.type === 'pubkey' ? [...TO.toBytes()] : typeof a.type === 'object' ? new Array<number>(a.type.bytes).fill(1) : [0]));
+  return new TransactionInstruction({
+    programId: new PublicKey(PRESALE_PROGRAM),
+    data: Buffer.from(o.data ?? [...row.discriminator, ...args]),
+    keys: row.accounts.map((a, i) => (a === 'user' ? {pubkey: ME, isSigner: true, isWritable: true} : {pubkey: new PublicKey(new Uint8Array(32).fill(100 + i)), isSigner: false, isWritable: i < 3})),
+  });
```

#### Dry-run notes (Task 7)

- **Ruling: detection is from the raw bytes, not the decoder's name** — the program a static key equal to the presale program and the first 8 data bytes one of the six discriminators, taken by name from the generated `PRESALE_INSTRUCTIONS` (`PRESALE_PURCHASES`; a test pins the six equal to the IDL's `presale_purchase*` rows). §3.6: "whether or not the rest of it parses strictly". A program id cannot come from a lookup table, so static keys are complete. Cost if wrong: none for funds (a purchase is never missed; a non-purchase is never flagged).
- **Ruling: F12 does not suppress F2** — B1c's "an instruction a more specific flag names is not repeated" covers F3–F6/F8; F12 is a refusal, and F2 still lists the purchase among the non-transfers (as it does with the gate open). Cost if wrong: one redundant warning under a Reject-only screen.
- **Ruling: the country reaches the window in F12's `FlagView` (`countryCode`), not in the stored flag** — the stored flag is §3.6's exact shape (`reason` only); the stored `presaleRegion` carries the country, and `flagView(f, sim.presaleRegion)` adds it for #48 (like F10's `step`). `typeParity.test.ts` pins the background view equal to the window's `Flag`. Cost if wrong: one field moved.
- **Ruling: Q50a names the country with `regionName` (no " · EU")** — §3.6 says "the country name"; a sanctioned country is never an EU member, and #50b's " · EU" is a region-card detail. Q50a is shown only for `sanctioned` with a country; a `sanctioned` answer without one (the gate never gives it) falls back to Q50b. Cost if wrong: one call.
- **Ruling: `simStateOf` requires `presaleRegion` and checks it against the flags** — an F12 exactly beside a closed answer, each with that answer's reason; an answer of any other shape (an open one with a reason, a closed one without, a lower-case country, a missing key) makes the stored simulation invalid (simulated again). A simulation stored before this update has no `presaleRegion` and is simulated again once (fail closed). Cost if wrong: one re-simulation per queued request across the update.
- **Ruling: the decision asks the gate after the pre-section's checks and BEFORE `reauthGate`** — §3.6 says "before the entry moves to `deciding`"; asking before the re-authentication gate also means a closed answer never issues a challenge. The re-simulation is awaited before the refusal is answered, so the window's next read shows the F12. The deciding section refuses a purchase this same call did not find open (`regionOpen`) — the B1c pattern for a first read that missed the entry (fix round 1 item 1); a test hides the entry from that first read. Cost if wrong: one extra `/geo/check` per approval of a purchase (C12 asks for it).
- **Ruling: `dappAbout` skips F12 and `FLAG_ROW` is keyed without it** — a request with F12 is refused before any challenge is issued, so #10 never describes one and the vault page needs no F12 row (it names F1–F10). Cost if wrong: none (unreachable; the type makes a challenge row for F12 impossible to add by accident).
- **Ruling: the window's `refused` state** — after the existing expired / failed checks (the background's row order), any F12 makes the screen Reject-only (B1c's failed-simulation bar; "Reject and report" stays for a lookalike); the balance card and the decoded instructions stay visible; the origin pill and the re-authentication line are not shown (both belong to an approvable screen). The eyebrow "Critical · Blocked transaction" and the danger tone follow any F12 shown, including beside a failed simulation. Cost if wrong: markup only.
- **Ruling (gate lists): `BOTH_BUILDS` + `src/app/ui/regionName.ts`** (the approve window imports it in both builds — a positive control that the off build kept it), and **`MUST_STAY` + Q49, Q50a's literal part before the country, Q50b, Q51** (§6.2 item 3). No marker: Q49–Q51 are "both". Cost if wrong: a gate row.
- **Not built here (stated):** E2E 9 (Task 8) and the committed #48 F12 shots (Task 9). A purchase reached by a CPI from another program is not F12 (§3.6, §8.1 — it is F1's unknown program).
- **For Task 8:** E2E 9's literals are in `presaleRegion.test.tsx` (`Q49`, `Q50A('North Korea')`, `Q50B`, `Q51`); `dapp.decide` answers `{ok: false, error: 'presale-region'}`; the fake coordinator's `/geo/check` must answer per test and the restricted list must be fresh for the open control. `txHarness.presaleIx` builds any IDL row (E2E copies what it needs — no core imports in e2e).
